articleTitle: Study on Thermodynamic Optimization of Seawater Source Heat Pump System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper carries out the thermodynamic and thermoeconomic optimization of seawater source heat pump(SWHP) system. Through the optimization program the system components and operating parameters are obtained to make the system exergy loss minimum or the annual production cost lowest. In this procedure, this article uses the polynomial function fittings to solve the thermal parameters of the state equation of refrigerant R410A reference Cleland model.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Control of Electromagnetic Spacecraft Formation Flying in Near-Earth Orbits
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A sliding mode control for six-degree-of-freedom electromagnetic spacecraft formation flying (EMFF) in near-Earth orbits is presented. By using terminal sliding mode technique, the output tracking error can converge to zero in finite time, and strong robustness with respect to disturbance forces can be guaranteed. Illustrative simulations of EMFF are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Optimal Choice of Parameters for Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The firefly algorithm (FA) is a novel metaheuristic algorithm inspired by the social behavior of fireflies and the phenomenon of bioluminescent communication. The effects of the major parameters on FA were systematically investigated based on some benchmark functions. The step size factor, absorption coefficient and population size all have significant impact on the performance of FA. The absorption coefficient and step size factor have optimal values in practical application, and improper choice of these factors will lead to bad results. Increasing population size can improve the solution quality, although the computing time will be longer. In this paper, the characteristics of FA parameters are discribed and guidelines for determining parameter values are given.

articleTitle: A Bi-Directional Buck/Boost Voltage Balancer for DC Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A bi-directional Buck/Boost voltage balancer required in DC distribution system is proposed in this paper. Compared with the existing voltage balancer, the proposed balancer is unique in adding a bi-directional Buck/Boost converter, so that it cannot only balance the positive and negative rail voltages of the load side, but also regulate the total load voltage for fluctuating supply voltage. Theoretical analysis is performed to establish the model of this bidirectional Buck/Boost voltage balancer. For meeting the characteristic of the proposed voltage balancer, based on the complementary PWM method the control strategy has been proposed and analyzed. And the simulations have been carried out to verify the validity of the circuit topology.

articleTitle: Study on Prediction of Atmospheric PM2.5 Based on RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Because of the varying concentration of atmospheric PM2.5 have strong nonlinear characteristics, the traditional forecast methods are difficult to make accurate prediction. In this paper the parameters included PM10, SO2, NO2, temperature, pressure, humidity, wind direction, wind speed are selected as the influence factors, and the prediction models based on RBF neural network are constructed. Then the model is used to predict the concentration of PM2.5 and compared with the classic BP network model. The result shows that the RBF neural network model has more advantages in the prediction of PM2.5.

articleTitle: Application of Internet of Things to the Monitoring System for Food Quality Safety
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The rapid development of internet of things results in the application in the field of food quality and safety monitoring. In this paper, the architecture of the food quality and safety monitoring system based on internet of things is introduced. The characteristic, laered structure and key technologies are expressed in details. Application of internet of things to monitor food quality safety are bound to realize the functions of intelligent monitoring and controlling, accurate prediction and disposing food safety incidents efficiently.

articleTitle: Integrated Monitoring System for Rail Damage in High Speed Railway Turnout
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Turnout is a weak link in railway track and its structure is complex, so it is necessary to use advanced technology to monitor rail damage of the turnout zone. This paper studied on various existing monitoring methods, and integrated three methods to realize the compound monitoring of rail damage, i.e. fiber grating, optical imaging and Lamb guided wave. Both the relation between parameters of these monitoring technologies and the interaction between them were considered, data obtained from different information sources are proceeded comprehensively to get the accurate estimation and evaluation of the state of the detected object. Based on the workflow of this monitoring system, it is divided into five functional modules: 1)video detection systems, fiber optic detection system, Lamb guided wave detection system, 2) comprehensive analysis, 3) management of maintenance plan, 4) knowledge base/expert database, 5) reporting system. This monitoring system is installed at railway field and preliminarily tested to verify its feasibility and reliability.

articleTitle: Groundwater Pollution in and Around a Paper Wastewater-Irrigated Area, Northwest China
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Groundwater samples were collected from 87 monitoring wells in and around a paper wastewater-irrigated area. The monitored parameters include pH, COD, Cl<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>, SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup>, F-, TDS, TH, NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>-N, NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-N. Water quality variation was examined by graphical approach and R mode cluster analysis. The study shows that groundwater in the study area has been contaminated. Most physiochemical parameters usually have high variations in concentration. Groundwater pollution in the forest area is mainly caused by CODMn, NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-N, NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N and F<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>, while groundwater pollution in the alluvial plain may be attributed to excess TDS, TH, F<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-N. Elevated concentrations of COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Mn</sub>, NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-N, NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N is due to anthropogenic intervention, while TDS, TH, pH and Fmay be influenced more by natural processes.

articleTitle: Selecting Proper Method for Groundwater Interpolation Based on Spatial Correlation
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Interpolation technique is often used in analyzing groundwater flow and physiochemical parameter distribution. In order to select an optimal interpolation method to describe the spatial distribution of groundwater properties, the spatial correlations of parameters such as groundwater level, salinity and nitrate were studies, based on which the inverse distance weighting (IDW) and Kriging interpolation methods were compared by the semivariable function of ArcGIS. The results show that when the data of samples have high spatial correlation, Kriging is a reliable method for interpolation, IDW method is more suitable for data of weak spatial correlation. Furthermore, IDW focuses on the values of neighboring locations with special distance while Kriging puts emphasis on the whole trend.

articleTitle: Real-Time Spectrum Analyzer Based on All Phase FFT Spectrum Analysis
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The estimated accuracy of phase and frequency of all phase FFT spectrum analysis and its correction techniques are high[1-3], for its perfect characteristic of inhibiting the spectrum leakage. The phase isn't influenced by frequency shift, so there is no need to correct it. In this paper, a spectrum analyzer with self-adaptive sampling frequency is designed on the basis of all phase FFT spectrum analysis techniques, using TI's 32-bit floating-point DSP. It is shown that the frequency measurement error of the design with high frequency-resolution is 0.01%. It is suited for high-precision, intensive spectrum analysis and non-synchronous sampling harmonic analysis.

articleTitle: The Study of Network Security Event Correlation Analysis Based on Similar Degree of the Attributes
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper studied the related theories of the network security event correlation analysis methods, and proposed the network security event correlation analysis method based on similar degree of the attributes. a detailed description and analysis of the method is gived in this paper, the method can realize the classification and merge of network security events according to the attributes similar degree of network security events. The similar degree of security events are identified by the similar degrees of characteristic attributes. It can not only remove redundant safety incidents, but also can compress security event number. Thus, it can effectively improve the network administrator's security incident analysis efficiency. The experimental results show that: the method is suitable for the massive security event information analysis and aggregation, can effectively reduce the number of security incidents, has a certain value.

articleTitle: Fine-Grained Mining and Classification of Malicious Web Pages
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With the World Wide Web expanding continuously, more and more malicious web pages including phishing, malware and spamming spread rapidly, we are facing a great threat. The work of detecting malicious web pages and identifying their threat types has some shortcomings. In existing studies of malicious webpage detection, most are just for detecting a single attack type. In this paper, we extract a variety of webpage features and use machine learning algorithms to build an efficient classifier. By the classifier, we can detect malicious web pages and identify all the popular threat types. The features extracted in our method are derived from the HTML contents, the associated JavaScript code, and the corresponding URL. We collected 1000 benign web pages and 1500 malicious web pages as experimental data sets. The experimental results show that our method achieves a superior performance: the accuracy was over 95% in detecting malicious web pages and over 88% in identifying threat types.

articleTitle: Power System Reactive Power Optimization Based on Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Aiming at the control variables of reactive power optimization are discrete, and some parameters in the standard particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm need to be predefined by test, so the algorithm's practicability is restricted. For these reasons, an adaptive particle swarm optimization (APSO) algorithm is proposed by the authors. APSO introduces the self-adaptive tuning strategy and boundary constraint conditions can find the global optimal solution and solve the discrete variables. The reactive power optimization results of the standard IEEE-30-bus power system show that APSO is efficient than standard PSO. The global convergence accuracy and convergence stability is obviously improved compared with that of PSO.

Author Keywords: Power system; Reactive power optimization; Particle swarm optimization;Self-adaptive tuning strategy

articleTitle: SAR Automatic Target Recognition Based on Shadow Contour
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Due to special imaging mechanism, shadow contour of SAR image is not as clear as that of optical image. Aiming at target recognition, this paper presents a SAR image segmentation method based on Partial Differential De-noising and Marker-Controlled, and carries out automatic target recognition on result of image segmentation. Experimental results show that, using the method of this paper, segmentation result of SAR image can classify target effectively.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Ultra Low Power Health Monitoring Node for Wireless Body Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The human body consists of many complicated physiological signals such as blood pressure, electrocardiograph (ECG), respiratory rate, electroencephalograph (EEG), arterial oxygen saturation (SpO2), body temperature and so on, which, to some extent, reflects the health conditions of the people. Long term and continuous monitoring of these signals are of much importance for the detection and treatment of many diseases such as heart failure, hypertension, diabetes mellitus, etc. Wireless body sensor network is developed in this context and soon become very popular for its convenience and inexpensiveness. In this paper, we introduced the basic knowledge and techniques for low-power health monitoring nodes design, and then we described the design and implementation of an ultra low power ECG (LPECG) monitoring node for wireless body sensor network. We mainly discussed the hardware and software design of the low-power ECG monitoring node, and then we test the power consumption of the node when it working at different modes and the monitoring function of the node is tested and the results are presented, at last, we get the conclusion and pointed out the future development of the node.

articleTitle: Dynamic Path Planning for Underwater Vehicles Based on Modified Artificial Potential Field Method
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Because it requires less change frequency of heading angle, path planning is a special and crucial issue to autonomous underwater vehicles in contrast to robot in land. The solution described in this paper firstly employs global path planning based on geometric method, then carries out local path planning based on one new artificial field potential function, which uses sector as the parameter. In order to ensure real-time, the information of sonar is combined to the static global map. The performance of simulation shows that the algorithm can avoid inherent limitations of artificial potential field method before the problem happening, the frequency of heading angle change is fewer, new detected obstacles can be real-time avoided.

articleTitle: A Decision-Making Method for Fire Detection Data Fusion Based on Bayesian Approach
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper introduces a method for fire alarm information fusion in feature level by means of Dynamic Bayesian Network (DBN), the method is effective to reduce the interference of environmental factors and to improve the accuracy of fire detection. With CO content, environment temperature and smoke concentration as input fire characteristic information of DBN, the DBN output for the probability of the naked flame, smoldering fire and no fire. A variety of fire scenarios were built for the training and validation of DBN by using the Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS), the curve of the CO content, temperature and smoke concentration were fitted. The results show that the method can better identify fire characteristics between naked flame and smoldering fire.

articleTitle: Influence of Regulation of OLTC Transformation Ratio on Voltage Stability
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The self-regulation of on-load tap changer (OLTC) transformation ratio is an important factor causing voltage instability. This paper introduces OLTC simulation models and their characteristics. Based on the sensitivity information, this paper deduces the voltage-regulating effect of OLTC in different load models with usage of the analytic method. The voltage-regulating effect of OLTC is very complicated. For different system operating conditions, different load types and different transformation ratios, the voltage-regulating effect may be different. At last, this paper summarizes the current OLTC control strategies to prevent voltage collapse.

articleTitle: A Resource Allocation Strategy Based on Particle Swarm Algorithm in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Allocating the resources efficiently in cloud computing environment is not only an important issue and but also a research focus. A strategy of resource allocation and price adjustment based on particle swarm algorithm is proposed in this paper. According to the workload characteristics, a utility function is designed to evaluate QoS. According to the resource demand from all workloads, the resource prices are dynamically adjusted by the corresponding resource agents in order to obtain maximum profits for each workload. The results of the simulation experiment show that our strategy has effectiveness and robustness.

articleTitle: Design of a Subway Station Crossing Urban Trunk Road by Open Cut and Tunneling Method
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The design of a subway station that crosses an urban trunk road for automobiles in Chengdu city is summarized in this paper. In view of its special location and structural design, the subway station is built in combination with open cut and tunneling method, its structure consists of three different parts, which includes two reinforced concrete frame structures and a bored tunnel with side platforms. The frame structure is built with open cut method, but the bored tunnel with platform is built by means of tunneling method. The structure and construction process are both summarized in the paper. The scenario may provide guidance for the design and construction of such peculiar subway station under similar circumstances.

articleTitle: Calculating the Optimum Tilt Angle for Parabolic Solar Trough Concentrator with  the North-South Tilt Tracking Mode
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This article briefly introduces the construction of parabolic solar trough concentrator and the tracking modes, and the optimization of the north-south tilt tracking mode used for this condenser in practical applications has been studied. According to the solar radiation theory and Hottel Model, solar radiation of the concentrator adopting the north-south tilt tracking mode has been calculated in different tilt angles by using numerical stochastic algorithm. Optimum tilt angles for parabolic solar trough concentrator which utilizes this tracking mode have been got from the annual direct sun radiation in Shanghai, Beijing, Haikou, Hohhot, and Lhasa.

articleTitle: System Service Restoration of Distribution Network Based on Multi-agent Technology
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper, power system restoration was performed by changing the status of the switchers on feeders. Based on Multi-Agent technology, a Multi-Agent Service Restoration System for distribution systems was designed, which consists of two substations on JADE development platform. A Feeder-Agent was set for each feeder and was developed to act as a manager for decision process. At the same time, a Bus-Agent was set for each bus and corresponded to customer loads. Through the interaction and negotiation between Bus-Agents and Feeder-Agents, the proposed Multi-Agent System can complete the task of service restoration in the distribution system, and it is able to restore the original structure of the system when the fault is cleared.

articleTitle: Identifying Potential Pollution Sources in River Basin via Water Quality Reasoning Based Expert System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Indentifying potential pollution sources from the monitoring water quality data is desirable for water quality management. A simple expert system module was developed in this paper to infer the latent pollution sources and explain variation in water quality parameters. It contains three parts. The first part is water quality mining and analyzing component implemented by multivariate statistical techniques such as cluster analysis and factor analysis. The second part is knowledge base constructed by 53 emission standards for water pollutant of particular industries. The last part is the inference mechanism designed through calculating the similarity between a specific pollution factor and these particular industry emission standards. The Songhua River Harbin Region case study demonstrated the goodness of the expert system module. Three main pollution source factors in low pollution area were mainly related to organic pollution and nutrients (some point industry or animal husbandry and agriculture activities), heavy metal pollution (point sources: industries) and toxic pollution (point sources: pharmaceutical industries). The module will help managers make decisions with more strong confidence to improve the water quality.

articleTitle: Intelligent Identification of Bearing Faults Using Time Domain Features
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: An approach is proposed for fault diagnosis of rolling element bearings using time domain features as inputs to the artificial neural network (ANN). The time domain features are extracted from the segments of the experimental dataset for known machine conditions. The dataset has been subjected to somewhat preprocessing previous to feature extraction. The ANN consists of five input nodes, one hidden layer with five nodes and four output nodes. Each of five input nodes represents root mean square, variance, skewness, kurtosis and normalized sixth central moment of the time domain vibration signals, respectively. Four binary nodes in the output layer specify the bearing condition: normal, outer race defect, inner race defect or ball defect. The ANN is trained using back propagation algorithm with a subset of the time domain features. The ANN is tested using the remaining set of the time domain features. Training and test success are used to evaluate efficiency of the presented method. The results indicate the effectiveness of the time domain features in diagnosis of bearing failures with high accuracy and low computation.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research of the Campus Network User's Behavior Based on k-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This thesis introduces the status and methods of data mining, aiming at the Nantong University campus network users access data preprocessing analysis, using the K-means clustering algorithm combined with SQL Server 2008 and Visual Studio 2008 business intelligence project function for data mining analysis, and the mining experimental results are analyzed and studied. The research indicates that the campus network users of Internet time has a positiver relevance with the rate of student's failing grades and a negative correlation with getting schlolarship and CET4(College English Test 4) achievements. What's more, it not only has a positive effect on school leaders fully understand the behavioral characteristics of students and campus network users of campus network usage, timely feedback and guiding the students to form a good habit of learning, but also plays an important role in improving the campus network bandwidth, performance and application efficiency.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Electric Vehicle Charging Station Sitting Based on Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The construction of charging station is a major component of electric vehicle market operation and the comprehensive evaluation of a location is an important part for the construction of charging station. In this article, on the basis of analyzing the traditional site selection program evaluation method, fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is proposed to evaluate the electric vehicle charging station sitting programs, also the evaluation model algorithms are given, wishing to achieve the optimal program. The judgment hierarchy of electric vehicle charging station sitting is constructed, divided into three levels, including 4 first-class factors of evaluation and 14 second-class factors of evaluation. The example analysis results indicate that this fuzzy analytic hierarchy process method can make charging station sitting more reasonable and scientific.

articleTitle: Analysis of Palm Vein Image Quality and Recognition with Different Distance
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: It is normal that the distance between palm and camera lens is different in contactless recognition systems. Most of the prior work has only emphasized on issues of preprocessing, feature extraction and match. But the recognition affect due to the different distance of image is very few concerned. This paper presents the relationship between palm distance and the palmvein recognition performance from image clarity of ROI(Region of Interest), image structural difference and match results based on low-resolution palmvein images. Experimental results show that, differences of image clarity and structure are larger while distance of palmvein distance becomes large, also show that the match results becomes large, which will to some extent increase the false rejection.

articleTitle: The Smartphone GUI Design Research Based on the User Experience
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The smartphone GUI design principles based on the user experience are researched from three aspects of interface design, icon design and interactive effects with a thorough and multi-angle research. Combined with the new requirements raised on GUI design in the era of the digital identification technology era, this article sums up the smartphone GUI design strategies and methods in order to enhance the smartphone user experience.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Automobile ASPs Using TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The TOPSIS (Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution) method using entropy weight is presented for performance evaluation of after-sales service providers (ASPs) of automobile company. The selection of performance criteria and implementation steps of the TOPSIS method in automobile after-sales service management system are presented. Application on an example demonstrates feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: The Research on the Finite Element Seepage Calculation of Earth Dam Considering the Effect of Unsaturated Region
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In the traditional earth dam seepage calculation, the permeability coefficient of saturated soil is considered as fixed value. Actually, the seepage of earth dam carries out unsaturated characteristics. The permeability coefficient of unsaturated soil is a nonlinear function which is closely related to volumetric water content and pore water pressure. Based on the saturated-unsaturated soil seepage calculation theory and considering the effects of unsaturated region on the seepage field, seepage finite element calculations and researches of one earth dam have been done in this paper. The results show that the study of the earth dam finite element calculation which considers the effects of unsaturated soil seepage can get more accurate and reasonable seepage field calculation results.

articleTitle: Improved Artificial Fish Swarm Algorithm for Fault Diagnosis of Dry-Type Transformer
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Real-time fault diagnosis of dry-type transformer plays a crucial role in the safe operation of power grids. In order to improve the accuracy of the fault diagnosis of dry type transformer, Based on artificial fish swarm optimization algorithm, this paper proposes an improved artificial fish-swarm rear-end clustering algorithm, defines the similarity factor and cluster discriminated factor, and introduces the improved algorithm to the dry-type transformer fault diagnosis, eventually established the simulation of artificial fish-swarm rear-end behavior of dry-type transformer fault diagnosis model. Experimental results show that this method has fast convergence, high accuracy in the dry-type transformer fault diagnosis, and confirmed the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Energy Consumption Monitoring Platform Oriented to Public Green Buildings
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Public green buildings have the characteristics of energy-saving, emission reduction, green initiative, and sustainable development. This paper introduces an energy consumption monitoring platform oriented to public green buildings in order to determine whether the buildings meet the energy-saving requirement. The platform has been designed and implemented to collect, transmit and store the monitoring data, and shows the results of data analysis. The platform is flexible and robust to different kinds of green buildings. At present, the platform is successfully applied to an S&T university in Chongqing.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Monopolar Three-Phase Solar Grid-Connected Current Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Article review the importance of the renewable energy system using solar energy. And the monopolar three-phase on current inverter model is established based the analysis of solar grid-connected inverter. With a work frequency period of power source, have been divided the 7 mould forms of 6 fan district and a switch period to alternate course with 0 ~ 1/3 π interval the method that describes control strategy specificly for example, for with I interval ( 0 ~ 1/3 π ) 7 alternate mould form is example specificly analysis system the realization of control method have gone on analyse comparatively in detail. Simulation results show that the system has the same performance comparing with theory analysis.

articleTitle: Mechanism and Application of a New Guard Rail for Improving the Stability of Small Radius Curve Tracks with Continuous Welded Rails
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper studied an effect of a new guard rail on the stability of curve tracks with CWR, and revealed a mechanism of the new guard rail for improving the stability of small radius curve tracks with CWR, and also analyze the degree of the new guard rail for enlarging the pave range of small radius curve tracks with CWR. In order to achieve these, an improved load-deformation method for calculating the stability of tracks with continuous welded rails (CWR) is suggested and verified. The results indicate that the improved load-deformation method not only has the same accuracy as the improved unified formula in specification, but also has the same clear and simple characteristics as the original load-deformation method. The mechanism of the new guard rail for improving the stability of small radius curve tracks with CWR is that the CWR stability can be greatly improved by increasing the stiffness of the track framework under conditions of maintaining the same cross-sectional area of the rails. The CWR with the new guard rail can allow the minimum laying radius from 300 m down to 230 m, i.e. the current specification limit can be relaxed 23.3%. If combined with the roadbed strengthening measures, the new guard rail can allow the minimum laying radius from 300 m down to 140 m, i.e. the current specification limit can be further relaxed 53.3%.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Reducing Leakage Power Based on Dual-Threshold Voltage Technique
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: To reduce the static power of the circuit, a dual-threshold voltage assignment algorithm has been proposed in this paper. This algorithm uses static timing analysis to get the timing information of all nodes by double traverse and assigns the threshold voltage of each node through initial optimization and accurate optimization. Under given timing constraint, the goal of our algorithm is to replace a maximum number of high-Vt gates from low-Vt in the circuit and maximize the reduction of the static power. Our dual-threshold voltage assignment algorithm and traditional method are compared based on the embedded CPU CK610 of TSMC 55nm process. The results show that our algorithm can reduce the static power of the chip by 60.07%.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Slope Stability Analysis: The Case Study of a Deposit Slope in Hydropower Reservoir
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The effects of uncertainty due to the variability of soil properties, pore pressure, and earthquake forces on the stability of a deposit slope in the hydropower reservoir are investigated. The spatial variability of soil properties is incorporated in the probabilistic slope stability analysis by a random field model, and a sensitivity analysis is conducted considering spatial variability of soil properties. Cutting the slope can reduce the risk of slope failure, which has been corroborated by the probabilistic slope stability analysis. The sensitivity analysis shows that additional measures such as drainage and toe protection can help stabilize the slope before reservoir filling.

articleTitle: Study of Micro Power Ultrasonic Wave Flow Meter
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Introduces the advantage of ultrasonic wave flowmeter in measurement of oil, gas and water during the production of oil, analysis the structure, principle, the reason of error of ultrasonic wave flowmeter, and the problem should be pay attention to during the process of development of the ultrasonic wave flowmeter, introduces the method of signal communication, measurement and micro power between chip TDC-QP2 and MCU MSP430. The coordination of TDC-QP2 and MSP430 has its strong advantage in development of micro power portable ultrasonic wave flowmeter. In comparison with the electromagnetic flow meter of 0.5 precision grade of Siemens company, The error of DN50 ultrasonic wave flow meter used in the test of water injection in Tuha oilfield is less than 2.5%, when the flow is in range of 1~30m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/h.

articleTitle: An Optimal Method for Costas Loop Design Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The Costas Loop is often used to extract the coherent carrier. In this paper, an optimum method is proposed to realize the Costas Loop based on FPGA. Firstly, the Costas Loop is detailed analyzed, and used the simulink tool to model and simulate the Costas Loop, finally, the hardware realization register transmission logic (RTL) principle chart was presented. Under the condition of saving the FPGA resources as much as possible, the experimental result shows that the method has a good performance.

articleTitle: Reliability Prediction of Machining Center using Grey System Theory and GO Methodology
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: According to the fact that the existing reliability prediction technology cannot well reflect the effect of processes under different operational conditions on reliability due to neglecting changes of reliability and failure rate with using time, a practical reliability prediction analysis model considering various operating conditions of the components of machining center is proposed by combining the grey system theory and the GO methodology. This method is used in reliability prediction of hydraulic system of tray automatic exchange device (TAED) in machining center. Firstly, through a systematical analysis of hydraulic system of TAED in machining center, its basic structure model is summarized, and the model of GO chart for the hydraulic system is established. Then, the grey dynamic prediction for the hydraulic system is derived based on GM(1, 1) model combining the GO methodology. Finally, the availability and precision of this method in the analysis and reliability prediction of the hydraulic system of TAED in machining center is verified by comparing the calculated result of this method with that of the traditional static GO methodology and the FTA. This approach provides a theoretical basis for the prevention of failures of the hydraulic system of TAED in machining center, the improvement of the system reliability and security, and the development of security controls.

articleTitle: Efficient Cooperative Spectrum Sensing Methods for Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Cognitive radio (CR) is efficient method for wireless application environment short of radio spectrum resource. Spectrum detection for primary idle spectrum sensing is essential for cognitive radio networks. The ability that cognitive users detect the primary spectrum is restricted due to multi-path effect and shadow fading, resulting in the lower spectrum detection probability. In this paper, a cooperative spectrum detection scheme using the cooperative mechanism of five cognitive users is proposed. The mathematical formulations of global false alarm probability and detection probability using two merging rules, OR rule and AND rule are deduced. The relationship between detection probability and signal-noise rate is obtained using two merging rules. The performance of the proposed detection scheme is demonstrated by simulation results that show the proposed cooperative detection is able to improve the primary spectrum detection efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on Structural Design and Construction Procedure for a Triple Arch Railway Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In consideration with geological and hydrogeological conditions of a four track railway tunnel in the new railway line from Lanzhou to Chengdu in China, A scenario of triple arch railway tunnel is presented in the paper. Curved side wall, vault and invert are adopted in its composite lining. Two intermediate concrete walls are set in the tunnel lining structure. In order to support rock pressure induced by rock mass above crown, two pilot drifts and bench cut method are utilized to build the triple arch tunnel. As for its portal section, pipe roof protection and advance grouting pipes are efficient measures to resist rock pressure and keep the stability of rock mass during its excavation. The method to excogitate the triple arch railway tunnel in this paper may guide the design and construction of such kind of triple arch tunnel under similar conditions.

articleTitle: Analysis of Bulk Temperature in High-Speed Gears Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Previous research revealed that gear tooth failure is close related with tooth surface and bulk temperature. In this paper, the bulk temperature of high-speed gear tooth is analyzed using finite element method. The analytical approach and procedure for estimating frictional heat flux and heat transfer coefficients of gear teeth in high-speed operational conditions is developed and accounts for the effects of pressurized oil jet cooling. The bulk temperature under oil jet and oil mist lubrication are compared and results show that oil jet lubrication is more effective in reducing gear bulk temperature than oil mist lubrication.

articleTitle: A Temperature and Humidity Monitoring System Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Temperature and humidity monitoring is very important in many fields. In this paper, A temperature and humidity monitoring system is constructed. A set of software by LabVIEW language is compiled. The program is operated in a circular manner and automatically. It can display real-time data curve of nodes and record it. When the data exceeds the limit, the alarm indicating lamp will be bright. Temperature and humidity is monitored automatically. This system is convenient to use, good interface, intuitive operation.

articleTitle: Function Signal Generator
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This system design a function signal generator, with MSP430 as control core, based on DDS chip AD9850, first of all produced 100 Hz ~200 KHZ to 1 MHZ (extensible) adjustable frequency of the sine wave signal, and then through waveform transform circuit, produce square wave and triangular wave signal, Through the use of voltage amplification, can be in 1 k Ω load resistance on the 100 hz ~200 KHZ sinusoidal signal in the range of the output voltage amplitude values of peak to peak VP - P is adjustable within 0 ~5 v. Control system adopts LCD display and voice prompt, convenient.

articleTitle: Research on the Feasibility of the Application of Multimedia Technology in Teaching of Martial Arts of College
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The teaching experiment of martial arts of public physical education in college was conducted for a period of 15 weeks, a total of 30 hours through the methods of teaching experiments, literature, and mathematical statistics. The experiment is divided into two parts, that is, multimedia assisted teaching and delay measurement, intends to solve such questions as 'difficult to get start', 'difficult to grasp', 'difficult to use', which students feel in the course of studying martial arts, thus proving the feasibility of multimedia-aided teaching in skill teaching of public physical education of college. The research results show that: the basic results of skill evaluation, compliance achievements and level of skill regression of the experimental group, are obviously better than the control group, and there are significant differences in teaching result.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of Aerodynamic Noise of a High-Speed Pantograph
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The aerodynamic noise of pantograph is one of the most important noise sources of high speed trains. Therefore, the reduction of the aerodynamic noise of pantograph becomes very important for reducing the total noise level of the high-speed trains. In this paper, the distribution of dipole sound sources at the surface of a single-arm pantograph and the noise radiation from it are predicted numerically by the combination of incompressible fluid flow analysis using the finite element method (FEM) and acoustic analysis using the boundary element method (BEM) at speed of 300km/h. The objectives of this calculation are to locate the noise sources on the surface of this type of pantograph and to understand the mechanism of the aerodynamic noise radiation. The analysis results indicate that: the aerodynamic noise of the high-speed pantograph is induced by the vortex shedding, the main noise sources of this single-arm pantograph are the pantograph head, knee, arms around knee and foot region, the aerodynamic noise of this type of pantograph is mainly the low-frequency and mid-frequency noises.

articleTitle: An Integrated Fault Detection Scheme for the Federated Filter
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Using the common failure detection reference provided by the federated Kalman filter (FKF), an integrated fault detection scheme for the FKF is developed by checking the consistency between the output of each local sensor and that of a fusion state predictor. With this scheme the state chi-square test and residual chi-square test are integrated together and applied to the fault detection of the FKF. Simulation shows this integrated method is effective and has high sensitivity of fault detection.

articleTitle: Constant Temperature Control System Design Based on Digital Temperature Sensor
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Constant temperature control system is studied in this paper, which is based on AT89S51 produced by ATMEL company as the control core. The characteristic of this system is small volume, low cost, strong function, simple and widely used. The design through the microcontroller control DS18B20 uptake real-time temperature information, the keyboard set temperature, time and state, LCD1602 display method of relevant information, which realizes the design of constant temperature control system based on single chip microcomputer. Finally, experimental results show that the design can realize temperature display, timing system and according to the temperature activate the corresponding functional circuit and other function, which has certain creativity and usability.

articleTitle: Reliability Model for Control Center of Railway Signalling System Based on SRN
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Among the subsystems of railway, signalling system is the most important and key equipment of the automation system. Railway signalling system is responsible for directing and used to ensure the safety of train operation, to improve the efficiency of transport and other important tasks, thus the system has an irreplaceable role and high requirements of reliability. The graphical modeling ability of Stochastic Reward Net (SRN) for system reliability analysis can make the model intuitively described, at the same time, SRN can automatically generate a continuous time Markov chain, which has strong ability in mathematics. In this paper, firstly, the function and equipment structure of the railway signalling system is carried out, and then the reliability model of the system is established based on SRN to provide a reliable basis for the design and analysis of railway signalling system.

articleTitle: The Study of Undergraduate Mentorship System Based on the Fuzzy Comprehensive Assessment Method
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The undergraduate mentorship evaluation is the key of booting the implement of undergraduate mentorship system in colleges, and of cultivating innovative practice talents. This paper, through analyzing the existing problems in current undergraduate mentorship system, constructs the evaluation indicators system of undergraduate mentorship from five aspects, which are personal quality, working attitude, mentoring method, mentorship effect, and student evaluation. By applying the Fuzzy Comprehensive Assessment Method, we quantify the evaluation indicators of undergraduate mentorship so as to make the evaluation more scientific and rational.

articleTitle: An Intelligence Monitoring System for Abnormal Water Surface Based on ART
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Classing object is an important step for the high-level visions processing tasks, such as security managing, and abnormality event analysis. In this paper, we address these challenges of abnormal water surface monitoring in real-world unconstrained environments where the background is complex and dynamic. In the algorithm proposed, we extract the moment features of water surface in a color space, and a technique is developed to monitor the abnormal surface of water based on ART. Experimental results show that our algorithm works efficiently and robustly.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Residential Parking Spaces Management and Information Issuing System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The orderly parking of Vehicles is an important measure to ease traffic congestion. The management and information dissemination system for residential parking spaces is to design a computer control and management system, in which electronic parking information is displayed by using MCU technology, and the records, update of vehicle access management and parking information and other functions are achieved by using database technology, in order to make the effective use of residential parking spaces to solve parking problems around the area. This paper analyzes the functional requirements of the system, providing the architecture, the database logic structure and main code of the system.

articleTitle: Research and Prospects of Vacuum Heat Treatment Technology
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper researched several common methods of vacuum heat treatment, discussed vacuum heat treatment's advantages, came up with the common problems and its solutions. At last this paper discussed the prospects for the development of vacuum heat treatment.

articleTitle: The Design of Embedded Video-Based Vehicle Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: According to the need of distributed intelligent video surveillance in intelligent transportation system (ITS), a design based on S5PV210 microprocessor and embedded Linux operating system is proposed for real-time dynamic video target tracking and display. The scheme of the whole system design and the technical solutions of software and hardware are given. The system makes full use of the efficient video processing capability of S5PV210. The algorithm extracts moving vehicle foreground by Gaussian mixture model and background difference approach, if the vehicles are blocked, both the perspective characteristics and contour characteristics of the vehicles are used to segment the blocked foreground. Camshift and Kalman filtering algorithm are used in combination to track moving vehicles, the tracking result will be displayed on the LCD panel of the embedded system and uploaded to the information center. Details of the system realization are introduced in this paper.

articleTitle: Internet of Things RFID Anti-Collision Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper, the the analyte networking architecture and technical characteristics on the basis of in-depth study of the key technologies of the Internet of Things, and the perception of Things layer as the starting point, focus on the RFID technology in the context of Internet of Things, presented anew anti-collision algorithm, and passed to set up the experimental platform to prove that the new algorithm is feasible.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Embedded Web Computer Remote Control System based on MSP430
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In view of the problem that the large room switches and other network equipment were damaged by lightning and other disasters for lack of timely protection, so the remote control system based on Embedded Web server has been put forward. The system connects the ultra low power consumption microprocessor MSP430 SCM with CS8900A Ethernet network control chip, based on C programming language by transplanting the open-source uIP embedded TCP/IP protocol stack, so that the users can use the browser to login webpage embedded Web remote control system, and realize the remote control of network equipment room. What's more, the system has been put into use in Nantong University network and server computer room, and its practical application has shown that the system is stable and reliable. Thus, it has good application value.

articleTitle: Study on the River Water Quality Improvement Featuring Deficient Upstream in Flow -- A Case Study of Nanfei River in Hefei City
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The largest tributary of Chao Lake located in Hefei City, the Nanfei River, is a river lack of upstream water inflow and receives water mainly from wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) discharge and polluted tributaries. In this study, a mathematical model comprising a hydrodynamic module and a water quality module was developed to simulate water quality improvement schemes. The model was calibrated with the data of local hydrological and water quality monitoring at 18 stations. Using the calibrated model, it was found that even if the discharged water from WWTPs is improved to grade IV (1.5 mg/L for ammonia), the ammonia concentration is still too high for the river to reach a water quality of grade V (2.0 mg/L). Considering water augmentation can only be used as an emergency measure to improve the water quality of the river, priority actions should be taken to reduce the pollution from the tributaries.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Relationship between Highest Fire Temperature and Change of Microstructure in Concrete
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The blocks are made with C40 concrete and tested in the specified temperature curve. The thermocouples are used to measure the temperature field of the internal blocks. After fire test, the samples derived from different locations of the concrete block are observed in the scanning electron microscope (SEM) and analyzed by X-ray diffraction (XRD) to extrapolate maximum temperature of the samples. The temperature extrapolated by SEM and XRD is in good agreement with the temperature measured by thermocouples. This proves it is feasibility that the maximum temperature of the concrete beam, column, wall and other components after fire extrapolated by SEM and XRD, which can provide reliable data to support Post-disaster assessment work.

articleTitle: Research on Characteristic of Rockburst and Rules of Microseismic Monitoring at Headrace Tunnels in Jinping II Hydropower Station
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper, the characteristics and laws of rockburst at headrace tunnels in Jinping II hydropower station are summarized basing on a mass of rockburst incidents recorded during tunneling, including the law of rockburst distribution with mileage, the way of failure of rock surrounding tunnel, the relationship of rockburst and distance, the laws of position of rockburst on cross section, etc. According to relationship of the microseismic incidents and rockburst, the availability of application of microseismic monitoring technique to prediction of rockburst is argued, and the accuracy and reliability of it are proved.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Bond Performance of Near-Surface-Mounted CFRP Strips-Concrete Interface
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The key of the technique to strengthen RC structures with near-surface-mounted CFRP strips lies in the bond performance of different interfaces (including CFRP-epoxy interface and epoxy-concrete interface), which may subject to the effect of many factors. It is presented here an experimental study on the bond performance of CFRP strips-concrete interface using a simple shear test set-up. The effect of different factors, including concrete strength, groove width, distance between the groove and edge of the specimen and bond length etc., are examined. Data obtained and phenomena observed during the test are all analyzed.

articleTitle: The Inter-Cluster Routing Algorithm in Wireless Sensor Network Based on the Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In the resource constraint Wireless Sensor Network(WSN), link quality and node residual energy are the key factors that need to be considered in the routing problem. This paper proposes a routing algorithm based on game theory. Firs it sets up the game model based on the Quality of Service(QoS) and node residual energy. Then it shows that the game has a unique Nash equilibrium solution, and analyses the feasibility of the algorithm. The simulation results show that the proposed model could optimize the QoS, reduce the energy consumption of nodes and prolong the network life time.

articleTitle: Research on IEC 61968 Standard Oriented Function Framework of Adapter in Smart Distribution Grid
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The ordered and unblocked information flow is an essential characteristic and goal for smart grid whilst the adapter is a key technology for heterogeneous system integration and information exchange. With the rapid development of IEC 61968 and Information Exchange Bus (IEB), the current adapter implementation profile can't fulfill the requirement of inter-operation in smart distribution grid. This paper illustrates the concept of adapter and its role in information exchange model of IEC 61968 standard, and proposes a six-layer function framework for IEB and heterogeneous systems. In the facet of heterogeneous systems, it proposes the three-layer function framework and implementation profile including adaption for web services, adaptation for business interfaces and adaption for IEC 61968 messages. In the facet of IEC 61968 standard based IEB, it proposes another three-layer function framework and implementation profile consist of adaptation for asynchronous exchange pattern, adaptation for plug & play and adaption for information flow control.

articleTitle: A Study on Animal by-Products Risks Prediction Model Based on Limited Dominance Rough Sets
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Animal by-products safety is one of the most concerned problems that production enterprises and consumers care about. To make sure the safety of animal by-products plays an important role in the whole society security. Therefore, the construction of animal by-products risks prediction model is of great significance. In this paper, a prediction model based on limited dominance rough sets is proposed to predicting the animal by-products risks. The paper analyzes predicting technologies, adopts optimized rough sets technologies, points out predicting rules, and sets up the corresponding animal by-products risks prediction model. It proves that the prediction model works efficiently in reality.

articleTitle: A Wireless Sensor System-Based Teaching Platform in Vocational College
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper, the system structure and Features of wireless sensor networks are introduced, visual Instrument and its advantages are introduced. A Wireless Sensing System Teaching Platform is constructed. It is a good platform and testing tools for sensor signals of real-time data acquisition, analysis, processing. This experiment platform can be used not only as a teaching experiment instrument, but also can be used for general measurement.

articleTitle: Petri Nets Based Test Case Selection Model for Service Composition in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Cloud computing has attracted much interest recently from both industry and academic. More and more Internet applications are moving to the cloud environment. This paper proposes a Petri nets based test case selection model for service composition in cloud, Petri nets are used to establish testing model for basic services, components, test cases and other components. Aspect-orientation is used to weave testing crosscutting concerns of cloud application, which includes component testing concern and testing concern of service composition. Based on this, the test cases selection model for service composition is given, and the operation semantics and related theories of Petri nets help prove its effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: Development of Heat Meter Based on the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The paper introduces the working principle and the method of measurement of the remote data transmission heat meter. Achieve the function of Remote data communication of the heat meter by using the technology of M-Bus networks and GPRS wireless data transmission, given the construction of the interface circuit of heat meter with the M-Bus and the networks of remote transmission of data of household meters. Achieve the communications of the data transmission networks of the household meters of community with the company of charges, management and operation by using the modern computer communications technology of the internet of things.

articleTitle: Wireless Digital Water Level Sensor Smart Transmitter Based on Wap300c
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper introduced a specific implementation plan of High-precision Low-power Consumption wireless digital water level sensor transmitter which based on WAP300C, the design uses MCU MSP430F2013 which has a multi-channel 16-bit A / D converter as the core controller and WAP300C as wireless transmitters and receivers. it is mainly to solve the problem of hard wiring and inconvenient replacement energy in Yellow River Diversion Project culvert, and with Simple structure, high precision, low power consumption, easy to use.

articleTitle: Airborne SAR - ATI - GMTI Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The actual airborne dual-channel data is disposed to indicate the moving target by ATI. The paper presents the method to compensate the interference phase base on calculate the phase centroid of every sub-image. Besides, this paper simplifies some data processing to realize the real-time GMTI and improves the efficiency. With this method, the actual SAR data is proceeded to get the target's position and movement parameter. Results prove the validity of the approach.

articleTitle: An Embedded Remote Temperature Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The traditional contact-type temperature measurement in some areas will be limited to the specific conditions. In this paper, we introduce an embedded remote temperature measurement system, which realize local area network (LAN) by Wife. We transplant the Linux operating system on the platform and configure Boa server building embedded Web server, by using temperature sensor, we can collect temperature data, by wife, we can send data to the client, and the client can monitor the real-time data monitoring through PC, mobile phones and other devices.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis and Operation Simulation of Low Pressure Economizer System in 135 MW Thermal Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Low pressure economizer play an important role in reducing exhaust temperature and enhancing the thermal efficiency. This paper combines with 135MW power plant, in order to ensure its safe operation and the optimal economic conditions, the cost was considered. We put forward three designs, and considering the overall economic efficiency for low pressure economizer in different inlet temperature of the flue gas. According to the equivalent enthalpy drop method the thermal economies of the designs are calculated, and the results show that the second design low pressure economizer in 150°C entering flue gas temperature is better than the other two. And simulation of this design under different flue gas temperature is taken place. We get the operation programs in different flue gas temperature. These regulation programs can provide some theoretical reference for production.

articleTitle: Cumulative Electricity Sale Forecast Based on Least Squares Curve Fit
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: We consider one method based on least squares curve fit in this paper. We use the method to forecast the cumulative electricity sale of State Grid Corporation and the method take the function of aided decision. The disposal result of real data tells us that the method has good practicability and veracity to the problem of cumulative electricity sale.

articleTitle: Night Vision Image Contrast Enhancement Base on Adaptive Dynamic Histogram
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Night image enhancement is an active research area nowadays. There have been a lot of techniques proposed in this area. In this paper, we present a contrast enhancement method base on Adaptive Dynamic Histogram Equalization (ADHE) for night vision image. The ADHE firstly decomposed an input image into two subimages based on the energy threshold of the input image. One of the subimage is the set of samples less than or equal the energy threshold T whereas the other one is the set of samples greater than the energy threshold T. Then the ADHE equalizes the subimages independently base on their respective histograms with the constraint that the samples in the formal set are mapped into the range from the minimum gray level to the twice input energy threshold 2T and the samples in the latter set are mapped into the range from 2T to maximum. Thus, the resulting equalized subimages are bounded by each other around the input energy threshold T, which has an effect of preserving brightness. The proposed technique is compared with other present techniques and is better than those due its computational simplicity and fast processing.

articleTitle: Based on Tabu Search and Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithms Solving Job Shop Scheduling Optimization Problems
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Solving the Job shop Scheduling problem, the design is based on Particle Swarm Optimization and Taboo Search which is a fast algorithm, And in this algorithm, bring in particle swarm strategy and taboo search strategy, A hybrid intelligence algorithm based on Particle Swarm algorithm and the taboo Search algorithm(TS-PSO) is designed. It overcomes particle swarm optimization algorithm in solving combinatorial optimization problem, and better to avoid the tabu search algorithm falling into local optimum, and convergence speed has also been increased. Through particle swarm and taboo search algorithm combined, the results show that this algorithm has very good accuracy of convergence, and is feasible, and compared with the traditional scheduling algorithm, Embodies the obvious superiority.

articleTitle: A High-Linearity Energy-Efficient CMOS PA for Wireless Environment Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: For power amplifier in wireless sensor network (WSN) nodes used for environment monitoring, there are three important factors, i.e. maximum output power, power efficiency and linearity. In this paper, two techniques are proposed to achieve good linearity, i.e. a negative feedback path with 180 degree phase shift, and a capacitance compensation technology to keep the overall input capacitance of driver stage constant. Furthermore, bond wire inductors with a high quality factor are proposed as chock inductors, which enhance both efficiency and linearity by raising drain voltage of common-gate transistors and cutting down the power loss in chock inductors. Simulation results demonstrate the PA achieves a maximum output power of 23.5 dBm with 42 % power added efficiency (PAE) and a 23 dBm output 1-dB compression point with 35% PAE. The two-tone test shows 5-10 dBc improvement in the third-order intermodulation distortion (IMD3) compared to a PA with on-chip chock inductors.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Seepage Field in the Tailing Dam with Draining Seepage System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Numerical seepage model of tailing dam based on finite-element method is established. By constructing special grid system and intermediate boundary conditions, combined drain seepage system (horizontal drain pipe + transverse- longitudinal blind drainage ditch) is well achieved in the model and the results of model analysis are verified by the results of experiments. Through the numerical simulation of the seepage in the tailing pond, seepage velocity field and seepage surface and water head distribution in both the transverse and longitudinal directions in different filling period and different drain seepage conditions have given. Analysis shows that water head change in slag accumulative area is relatively small and the local seepage slope is big in the dam-toe in the initial stage. As the increase of the filling height, the seepage slope increases correspondingly. The changing of the seepage field in three drain-seepage conditions is analyzed. After setting the combined drain seepage system, the seepage face is basically distributed along the drainage pipe. The seepage slope reduces obviously and meets requirements of the dam stability.

articleTitle: Research of Pedestrian Traffic Characteristics in University Campus
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Pedestrian traffic as an important component of urban traffic has been get more and more attentions from researchers, managers and participants of traffic. In the urban road traffic when vehicles and pedestrians interfere with each other, it will result in both delays. In the past we often consider pedestrian as a interference factors of motor vehicle, little consider that the pedestrian is vulnerable groups in traffic, need to give priority. This paper was based on the pedestrian characteristics on the general pedestrian crossing, combined with the traffic characteristics of university campus, the surrounding environment and physiological and psychological characteristics of college students. Real-field investigate the traffic both inside and surround the campus (Xihua University)to obtain the various experimental data, including walking speed, stride length, etc., thus, attributed a substantial proportion of university student pedestrian traffic flow, speed and street crossing characteristics of behavioral, psychological and security.

articleTitle: Rockburst Behaviors of Beishan Granite Subjected to Instantaneous Unloading
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Deep geological disposal is an internationally accepted way to deal with high-level radioactive waste. A better understanding of mechanical characteristics of host rock is very important for the stability of underground excavation and its long-term safety during operation. In the present study, tests have been performed using a true triaxial rock test system in combination with acoustic emission monitoring technique to investigate the rockburst process of the Beishan granite under the instantaneous unloading condition. When the rock specimen is loaded in three directions, the minimum principal stress in one direction is unloaded suddenly and the intermediate principal stress is kept constant and subsequently the maximum principal stress is increased. The rockburst phenomenon is successfully simulated in the laboratory. The experimental results show that occurrence of rockburst is attributed to the gradual energy accumulation and sudden energy release in the rock. This study provides an experimental basis for further investigating the influence of rock mechanics properties on underground construction and safe assessment in the Beishan area.

articleTitle: Transit Network Optimization for Feeder Bus of BRT Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Effectively integrating the feeder bus lines along the main BRT line can advance the operation efficiency and service level of the public transit system. In order to obtain the planning method of the feeder bus network of BRT system, based on the passenger OD data of five peak values, a route generation optimization model is developed to minimize the number of feeder bus routes and to maximize the passenger intensity by introducing the conception of station importance. Then, the simulation anneal genetic algorithm is formulated to solve the proposed planning model. Finally, the proposed model and algorithm are used in the case of the BRT line 2 along Beijing Chaoyang Road. The results show that the simulation anneal genetic algorithm can calculate effectively the optimization model and the bus network optimization model based on the passenger OD of five peak values can be applied in the practice.

articleTitle: Design of a Small Parallel-Plate Bounded-Wave Simulator
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Based on the parallel-plate bounded-wave simulator design principle, this paper give a kind of small parallel-plate bounded-wave simulator model with typical structure, and do some simulation on its inner space electric-field distribution. Firstly, a small parallel-plate bounded-wave simulator with typical structure is designed. By using the double exponential pulse source as the drive signal and the electromagnetic simulation software, the inner space electric-field distribution of the simulator was analyzed. The simulation result shows that this designed simulator can be used to simulate the ideal single plane wave environment effectively, and has certain instructional significance to kinds of electromagnetic effect experiments.

articleTitle: Analytical Modeling and Optimization for a Microvalve Actuated by Magnetic Fluid
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A microvalve actuated by magnetic fluid and electromagnets drive is presented. The working principle of this microvale is using a volume of magnetic fluid driven by four electromagnets as a spool. By changing the on/off order of the electromagnets, the direction of liquid flow can be changed, and the flow rate can be controlled by adjusting the electricity. A detailed description of the design has been introduced and modeled by ANSYS software. The influence of magnetic field strength to sectional area is analyzed, the simulated result shows that 40mT of magnetic field is optimization. The influence of magnetic field strength to flow rate is analyzed both, the simulation result shows that with the change of magnetic field strength, the size of channel formed by magnetic fluid and the wall of pipeline is changing instantly, and the flow rate of liquid will also be changed.

articleTitle: The Research of the Knowledge Structure Optimization for the Virtual Reality Teaching Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: According to the teaching and learning with virtual reality system, it is a problem that to have extensive and professional knowledge is needed. This paper has proposed a new method of knowledge structure optimization based on the genetic algorithm. Through analyzing the relationship between the correct rate of student answer, correct score rate and total score rate, the mathematical model of student knowledge structure has been constructed. The selection operator has dynamically been adjusted by genetic algorithm, which is used to optimize the structure of knowledge. Through the experiment it has been proved that the method is the feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Method of Electronic Equipment Fault Prediction
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
