abstract: As the new intelligent method was applied constantly to the fault predication field, the technology of fault predication has already become the key direction of electronic equipment support studies. On the basis of summarizing several kinds of more common fault predication method modernly, Support Vector Regression (SVR) was introduced. To avoid the blind establishment of the parameter, this study proposes intelligent genetic algorithms for optimizing the SVR's parameters, then the SVR model which had been set up was apply to a type of electronic equipment fault prediction. Finally, we adopt the number of a set of equipment condition monitoring data to verify the SVR model. The experimental result demonstrated that SVR model can predict the radar fault effectively.

articleTitle: MEMS Inertial Switch for Power Management of Environmental Vibration Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Power management technology is a fundamental issue in environmental vibration monitoring. In this paper, we propose a power management scheme using a MEMS inertial switch to minimize power consumption and maximize lifetime of environmental vibration monitoring system. The MEMS inertial switch integrates detecting and controlling systems with no power consumption. A prototype with unidirectional sensitivity is designed and fabricated based on bulk micromachining technology. The switch die (5.8×5.8×0.55mm3) is packaged and tested. As an 80g half-sine-wave acceleration was applied, the response time and contact time are about 0.37ms and 49ms, respectively. The contact resistance is no more than 6& Omega;. These indicate the switch has the advantages of miniature, high sensitivity and good contact effect which are suitable for the applications in power management of environmental vibration monitoring.

articleTitle: Aged Submarine Pipeline Failure Analysis Based on Accident Tree and Fuzzy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Study the causes of submarine pipeline failure and divide into two types, human and natural factors, establish the submarine pipeline failure accident tree. Combine the experts' judgments and fuzzy algorithm to calculate the probability of elementary event. In the course of qualitative analysis, 26 minimum cuts are found out. The results of quantitative analysis indicate that the probability of submarine pipeline failure is 0.2197 and the conclusion of risk ranking is in accord with the qualitative analysis.

articleTitle: Synchronization and Parameters Identification of Uncertain Fractional-Order Chaotic System Using Integer-Order System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The synchronization and parameter identification problem of the uncertain fractional-order chaotic system is investigated. Based on the Lyapunov stability theory and adaptive control theory, a method for Synchronization of uncertain fractional-order chaotic system using integer-order system is proposed, a novel adaptive controller and parameter updating rule are designed. Synchronization fractional-order chaotic Chen system using integral-order chaotic Chen system is realized, by which the uncertain parameters of Chen system are identified. Simulation results also verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Groundwater Level Variation Effects on Nitrogen Fate and Transport Under Simulating Rainfall

articleTitle: Discussion on Calculation Methods for Load Bearing Capacity of Concrete Arch Bridges
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: It has been suggested that the two codes which are commonly used in bridge engineering practice in China, Code for design of highway masonry bridges and culverts and Code for design of highway reinforced concrete and prestressed concrete bridges and culverts, sometimes give a contradictory in-plane load bearing capacity of concrete arch. In this study, we calculated and compared the load bearing capacities of three arch rings and two straight bar members using the formulas specified in both codes. It shows that in some instances, reinforcement results are in a lower load bearing capacity as compared with that without reinforcement. It would be reasonable to suggest that reinforcement can improve the bearing capacity of concrete members. But the results mentioned above are contrary to what might be expected. Based on the results, some implications are suggested for future research.

articleTitle: Studies on Lightweight High-Strength Shotcrete
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With small deadweight, light-weight shotcrete can avoid the shotcrete lining from falling off, which benefits the bolt-shotcrete support of the roadway better under same bond strength. Light-weight shotcrete can be made by using clay ceramsite, polystyrene particles and fly-ash ceramsite to replace some gravel and sand. The experiments show that the characteristic of fly-ash ceramsite shotcrete is superior to that of clay shotcrete, while by replacing part of gravel and sand with polystyrene particles and fly-ash ceramsite, light-weight high strength shotcrete will have excellent combination properties.

articleTitle: Guan-tian Economic Zone Talent Competitiveness Present Situation
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Guan-tian economic zone in the west of China is regional economic foundation, natural condition is superior, cultural history, the deep development potential larger area. To speed up the economic construction and development, to strengthen regional economic strength, support and promote formation of the western region to speed up the development the important growth pole. Therefore, research shut day economic zone talents competence status to the national economic development, the personnel training has important significance. This paper uses data measurement and performance analysis method to shut day economic zone for empirical research, and to promote economic shut day talents competence puts forward the corresponding countermeasures.

articleTitle: Real-Time Target Detection Algorithm Based on Background Modeling
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Identifying moving objects from sequence video is a fundamental and critical task in intelligent surveillance applications. In this paper, we design an intelligent video surveillance terminal based on DSP+FPGA structure. Considering the hardware resources, the real-time target detection algorithm is the most important factor. In fact, the common approach which identified moving objects from the portion of a video frame for static camera is background modeling algorithm. However, this paper introduces and simulates five background modeling algorithms, analyzes the simulation results, tests the real-time nature of each algorithm, and selects the best algorithm transplant to hardware platform to achieve a real-time intelligent video surveillance.

articleTitle: The Safety Evaluation of Steel Tubular Scaffold with Couplers Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process-Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In the water conservancy and hydropower project construction site, the scaffolding plays an important role in the construction site and the characters of the construction are a long period, complexity and frequent operation and so on. In the traditional methods, we uses qualitative and simple quantitative research methods to make the safety evaluation of the scaffolding. Those quantitative methods are affected by subjective judgment, having no scientific evidence. In accordance with the real example, this article makes the scaffolding as a whole to analyze, using the AHP-fuzzy comprehensive safety evaluation method and verifying the former method by fuzzy pattern recognition in the ending of the passage and hoping that it has reference for the project practice.

articleTitle: A Algorithm for Detecting Concept Drift Based on Context in Process Mining
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In the field of process mining, we require certain techniques that can detect process changes in dynamic systems automatically. Through detecting changes in the process we can adjust and optimize the overall process timely. These technologies are named concept drift detection of process mining. The traditional concept drift algorithm in process mining domain mostly have high time complexity, high space complexity and low recognition rate of concept drift and without using the context in process. We arises a new algorithm that based on context has high recognition rate of concept drift, low time complexity and low space complexity. The algorithm reduces the extraction and calculation of sample properties by using the stability of the processes before and after the changes. The using of the time parameter and staff parameter could enhance the sensitivity of process's change.

articleTitle: Study of EMU Auxiliary Inverter Double-Loop Control Strategy with PR Controller in Nonlinear Load Condition
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: As the main nonlinear load of EMU auxiliary inverter, battery charger has a great impact on the quality of inverter's output voltage. Based on the nonlinear load harmonic model, this paper analyses the theory of AC side voltage distortion caused by 3-phase uncontrolled rectifier load, and proposes a double-loop control strategy with load current voltage reference feed-forwards. The strategy is established from 3-phase SVPWM inverter in synchronous rotating reference system. Furthermore, output voltage distortion is eliminated with a proportional resonant (PR) controller. Finally, it turns out to be reliable and feasible to apply the control strategy after being tested with virtual DSP simulation model set with MATLAB, and on a 3KVA experimental prototype.

articleTitle: Arterial Signal Timing Optimization Considering Speed Variation
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Ideally, actual travel speed should be used in developing signal timing plans. However, actual travel speed could be affected by existing signal timing and presence of other traffic. This study examines impact of travel speed variation on a signal timing operation of an arterial. Actual travel times and travel speeds of links were collected using GPS tools. GPS trajectories can be drawn on the top of the time-space diagram with a GPS tool developed in our research. In GPS trajectory, actual travel speed between intersections can be clearly seen for three types of study runs. When actual travel speed is significantly different from the speed that is used for developing the timing, expected progression based on the time-space diagram would not be achieved. Offsets and phasing sequences were adjusted according to new speed data, with an improved bandwidth optimization algorithm from our previous study. Fine-tuning of initial signal timing plan was done to get optimal arterial and link progression bandwidth, generally link by link. The evaluation results of a case study about an arterial in Reno show that a rather significant improvement is achieved after the fine-tuning of initial signal timing plan with actual travel speed is done from simulation.

articleTitle: DA-MAC: A Duty-Cycled, Directional Adaptive MAC Protocol for Airborne Mobile Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Airborne mobile wireless sensor network, which is composed of lots of sensor nodes installed on vehicles, is introduced into many aerial tasks, such as environmental surveillance, airborne enemy target tracking, disaster warning. However, due to the intrinsic motion characteristics, most of the existing MAC protocols perform poorly in end-to-end delivery latency and energy consumption caused by high retransmission rate, especially in multi-hop and requiring high real-time responding airbornemobile wireless sensor networks. We present DA-MAC-a novel duty-cycled, directional adaptive MAC protocol. It utilizes: (I) a stochastic wake-up schedule, anycast MAC scheme minimizes collisions and reducing coordination overheads, (II) adaptive duty-cycles based on the local network connectivity and topology to locally reduce idle listening, (III) directional adaptive forwarder sets selection mechanism, each sensor node can transmit message to the one-hop neighbor node with the optimal properties. In the end then converges gradually from route-suboptimal anycast with unsynchronized duty cycling to route-optimal unicast with synchronized scheduling. DA-MAC fully considers the adverse impact of movement, and chooses node with the optimal properties as forwarders, achieves good endto- end latency. Our simulation results by NS-2 show DA-MAC performs well in end-to-end delivery latency and energy savings in mobile wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: The Steady Temperature Field Analysis of the High Speed Rolling Bearing
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Because of large amounts of heat generation, rolling bearings of heavy load and high speed can have a severe effect on the temperature field of the whole transmission system. Meanwhile, the excessive deformation caused by high temperature can badly affect the bearings' working reliability and lifetime. With the theory of friction and thermal conduction, heat flux and heat transfer coefficient for different areas of the bearing are precisely calculated. The three-dimensional finite model of the bearing is built up in ANSYS, and the steady temperature field is obtained, which provides the basis for thermal deformation of the bearing. The effect of different speeds and radial forces on the steady temperature field is also analyzed.

articleTitle: Study on Engine Fault Diagnosis Based on the Abnormal Sound Analysis in Transformation Domain
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Engine fault diagnosis based on abnormal sound signal analysis is a non-contact fault diagnosis methods, It has advantages that judge fault fastly and accuratly, convenient operation, high degree of automation. Based on this background. This paper research on the transform domain feature extraction of the engine abnormal sound signal and recognition problems. Mainly using the homomorphism analysis method to extract cepstrum features of different sound channel signal, using linear spectrum pairs analysis method to establish full pole model to the different sound channel, using the template matching method to the simulation results, that shows in this paper the cepstrum and the characteristic parameter can effectively identify various abnormal sound signal.

articleTitle: EnHTM: Exploiting Hardware Transaction Memory for Achieving Low-Cost Fault Tolerance
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Fault-tolerance has become an essential concern for processor designers due to increasing transient fault rates, even for the processors used in the mainstream computing. As the mainstream commodity market accepts only low-cost fault tolerance solutions, traditional high-end solutions are unacceptable due to their expensive overheads. This paper presents EnHTM, a hybrid software/hardware implemented low-cost fault tolerance solution for the serial programs running on commodity systems. EnHTM employs light-weight symptom-based mechanism to detect faults and recovers from faults using a minimally-modified Hardware Transactional Memory (HTM) which features lazy conflict detection, lazy data versioning. Compile-time analysis approach is also exploited to support larger transaction size, so that transient faults detected within long latency can be recovered. The evaluation experiment result shows that EnHTM can recover from 89.4%of catastrophic failures caused by transient faults, with a performance overhead of 2.6% in error-free executions on average.

articleTitle: Non-steady-state Conditions Control of the Non-linear Model-Based Engine
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A non-linear model is set up for engine transient operating condications. Both sliding model controller and PID controller are designed to realize adaptive regulation of throttle opening and ignition timing respectively. The results of simulation on engine idling show that the amplitude of engine speed fluctucation is less than 6 r/min, indicating that the non-linear model built is appropriate for the control over the transient operating conditions of engine.

articleTitle: Basic Research on Evaluation Method of Hydrophobicity of Composite Insulator Exposed to the Atmospheric Environment
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Composite Insulators exposed to atmospheric environment with pollution and ultraviolet rays for long-term would become aging. Hydrophobic was an important parameter of the composite insulator characteristics. Under the impetus of the STRI laboratory, the static contact angle evaluation method had been changed by receding angle evaluation method internationally. China could not be directly used, the two method needed to be compared. On this basis, the receding angle method and the static contact angle method were compared which was focus on the evaluation of the operability of this method, the selection of the evaluation criterion and the reasonableness of evaluation criterion. The results show that the receding angle in the three aspects is not mature. The receding angle method should not be used to replace the static contact angle method at this time.

articleTitle: Research on Chaotic Block Cipher Algorithm Applied to Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: We designed a cryptographic algorithm to fit the wireless micro sensor network in this paper. The coupled extended integer tent maps, which to generate the key sequence, one byte plain text block, one byte Feistel structure, and bit confusion are used to construct the algorithm. Since It has not only the time pad property but also the high speed confusion and diffuse, the security capability of the algorithm is excellent. Moreover, there will not be multiplication, division or floating-point calculation in the computation process of the algorithm, it's suitable for the application in the WSN nodes, of which the computing power is limited.

articleTitle: Analyses on the Sliding Characteristics of the Landsliding in Nine Long Jiang
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The study of unsaturated slope stability is one of issues in Geotechnical Engineering. The stability of the unsaturated soil slope in the land sliding of the middle section of the Jiulongjiang River is analyzed and evaluated on the basis of the improved Sarma's method which can be used for stability analysis of unsaturated soil slopes. Research results show that the slope has a visible whole sliding tendency and that the unsaturated soil slope tends to whole sliding after the matric suction is lost. At the same time, two sliding cracks in front of the slope are validated to be swelling ones, which indicates that the landslide is a type of thrust load caused landslide.

articleTitle: Damping Control Study on Concrete Frame Structure with Viscous Damping Walls
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With the progress of science and technology, seismic design method cannot meet the need of safety of architectural structure, therefore this new vibration controlling technology to be researched and developed. Viscous damping wall is a new concept of vibration damping technology, it has a damping force, flexible layout, good damping effect, etc. This paper analyzes the viscous damping walls in high-rise concrete frame structure damping using SAP2000 software, and plans the number and arrangement of the viscous damping walls in high-rise concrete frame structure reasonably, providing a scientific basis for the theoretical analysis and engineering application of the framework structure of the viscous damping walls.

articleTitle: Renewal Strategy of the Traditional Streets Based on Wind Environment Simulation
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Wind environment is closely related to human comfort. Yet, during the process of modern society's development, traditional urban streets are easily ignored. This thesis, takes the case of traditional streets of Lichuan, Jiangxi Province, had been quantified numerical simulation of wind environment of its local center streets both in winter and summer. In order to reach after wind environment inside traditional urban streets, and upon which, logical renewal strategy is proposed via collecting related meteorological data. Disposal and analysis of those data brings out the strategy which includes 3 parts, protecting, updating and planning traditional urban streets under circumstance of wind environment. The aim is to keep continuity of traditional streets culture to better adapt to modern society's requirement.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Ontology Automation Generation Framework for field of Indoor Environment
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Aimed at the features of the indoor environment influence factors diversification, dynamic, the comfortable concept fuzzification and the currently ontology construction methods have the problem of shortage in real-time construction, this paper puts forward a fuzzy ontology automatic construction method that faces the field of the indoor environment. Firstly, using formal concept method to analyze the objective physical space and form the abstract description model, secondly, make the physical space map to the information space depend on the model constructed in the first step, thirdly, structure a fuzzy ontology automation generation framework for this space with the help of the thought of fuzzy ontology, lastly, prove the method is feasible and effective through an example with the Jena as a tool.

articleTitle: A New Descent Method for Solving Ill-Posed Bilevel Programming Problems via Maxmin Model
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The results of optimistic model and pessimistic model are always not efficient for practical application because they are two extreme possibilities for ill-posed bilevel programming problem. This paper presents a new model by transferring Minmax model to a Maxmin model to solve above shortcoming. And we prove, by this transformation, a more practical value between the optimistic value and the pessimistic value can be achieved. Then, a new descent algorithm is developed to solve this new model by considering the satisfying degree of the lower level. Finally, an illustrated numerical example is demonstrated to show the proposed new model and algorithm are feasible and we can get a better result from all the iterated points by this Maxmin model than by the two extreme models.

articleTitle: Study on Load Bearing Capacities of Single Pile and Single Pile with Cap
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: To determine the bearing characteristic value of loading transfer, we investigated the bearing capacities of single pile and single pile with cap. The main results were shown as followed: The axial force attenuated slowly because of the effect of the rigid cap of single pile, The load on pile top was decreased along with the raise of the total load, For the presence of the cap, the distribution of axial force became gentle and the lateral friction resistance was decreased, meanwhile the pile end bearing was increased greatly. To conclude, the settlement value of the single with cap was more than that of the single pile.

articleTitle: Estimate SOC Capacity of Power Battery on the Dynamic Working Voltage
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper takes the VRLA battery cell as the research object, to solve real-time estimation problem of the electric vehicle power battery's state of charge(SOC) in working status, proposes a new estimation method. Through the measurement of a periodic constant current load's work battery, get a series of working voltage, using phase-slope calculation method based on the working voltage at this time, calculating the battery's time remaining and SOC. This method proved the feasibility of the dynamic working point can be mapped to the static working point, and the largest relative error is no more than 7%. Through the software implementation can compensate temperature, aging and other interference factors. Error analysis results show that this method has small error, high measurement precision.

articleTitle: Study on Simulation and Arithmetic of the Hydro-Pneumatic Pile Hammer
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Firstly, analyzing the hammerhead parameters of the hydro-pneumatic pile hammer, and then, combining the realities and taking the wave theory for base to establishing the mass-elastic model of the pile driving system, what's more, writing the programs which were used for dynamic simulation, Finally, simulating the mass-elastic model and comparing the key parameters, giving the configuration of the technological parameters to enhance the pile efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Water-Related Stability of Cement-Improved Completely Weathered Granite
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Considering the water-weakening properties of completely weathered granite, a lot of tests were done to study its water stability, and the regularity between water-related stability coefficient, a notion which is introduced, and compactness, the content of cement the water content and cu ring time were discussed. Besides, the rule and mechanism of strength in the dry -wet cycles were researched by simulating the condition of underground water and rain waster. The result shows that the content of cement and curing time conform to hyperbolic curve, the compactness conforms to exponential curve, and the water content conforms to multinomial curve. As long as the strength of improved cement-soil arrived at some degree, the corresponding water-related stability goes unchanging as the microcrack growing under water-soil interaction. So it can provide the most economical way to improve the water stability for engineering by controlling the compactness, the content of cement, the water content and curing time.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Heat-Transfer in Fracture Rock Based on Fluid-Solid Coupling
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: By analyzing the heat-transfer and seepage of fracture rock, the coupling model of heat-transfer is developed. Temperature field distribution of fracture rock is described by using heat-transfer differential equation. At the same time, the heat-transfer equation is discretized by using weighted residual Galerkin finite element. Combined with boundary condition and parameters, the numerical solution is obtained. The results of numerical simulation show that the heat transportation resulted from fracture flow has major impact on the temperature field distribution of fracture rock. Under the action of fracture flow, the difference in temperature of water and rock wall is gradually reduced. Heat-transfer is increasing as the increase of the velocity of seepage, and the time of reached thermal equilibrium is cut down. The rate of temperature isoline is decreased along the fracture flow. The fluid-solid coupling had evident effects on temperature field distribution of fracture rock, and fluid temperature may influence temperature gradients. The contrast of flow velocity and fluid temperature shows that the effect of the former to temperature field distribution is bigger.

articleTitle: The Teaching Design of Analog Electronic Technology Information on the Basis of Professional Courses
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to improve the teaching quality, promote students' learning ability, with students as the center, expand the courses of teaching design. Theory teaching with traditional writing on blackboard, auxiliary electronic courseware demo, emphasizes the key points and difficulties in study, Intuitive demonstration EDA simulation, virtual environment to verify theoretical content, The actual connection circuit operation experiments in the experimental box, combined with the actual environmental performance index test.

articleTitle: The Development of Transient Film Compensator Based on MotoTron Development Platform
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Gasoline engine transient conditions oil film dynamic would effect on air fuel ratio. The Elman neural network was used to identify the parameters of oil film, and the gasoline engine oil film transient compensator model was established by Simulink. Based on MotoTron rapid prototyping Development Platform, oil film compensator model strategy transplantation, download and calibration test that were finished. Finally, the development of the oil film compensator for transient conditions air-fuel ratio control effectiveness was proved through the simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Research and Design of an Amplified-Filter Circuit Based on UHF Reader
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The paper introduces the design ways of Amplified-filter Circuit in receive loop about RFID reader, three amplifier is present. The main parameter of the circuit is calculated, at the same time, the software simulation of the circuit is provided. Practice has proved that this Amplified-filter Circuit has good stability, reliability and extensive.

articleTitle: Research of Online Monitoring System of COD inWaste Water Based on the Light Absorption Method
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper introduces an on-line monitoring system of COD in waste water based on the optical absorption method. The system uses advanced processor STM32F103, advanced sequential injection platform, accurate optical measurement structure, efficient pressure digestion method, high resolution colorimetric module. Besides, the system combines with GB detection method, so it can provide reliable, accurate monitoring result of COD. In addition, the apparatus has the advantages of compact structure, low maintenance, long-term unattended automatic monitoring of COD in water, so it can be widely used in the sewage treatment plant, the pharmaceutical industry, the environmental protection department and monitoring department.

articleTitle: A Landslide Case Along a Loess Plateau
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present a landslide case along a high loess plateau by field investigation, laboratory tests and numerical analysis. The factors of the high loess slope terrain and environmental that induced the landslide are investigated. Based on the information of field investigation and laboratory testing results, a three-dimensional model of the high loess slope prior to the landslide is created, and the influences of the variation of ground water level and the seepage flow on the slope stability are analyzed. The numerical results of ground water level variation suggest that the slope reaches an equilibrium state when the displacement on the top of slope reaches a certain value. However, the displacement increases significantly and the sudden failure may occur more easily when the seepage flow is taken into account. This study may be used for reference of the research of high loess slope stability.

articleTitle: A New Pseudo-Coloring Coding Method for DPX Image
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: It is important to grasp the spectrum's state within a period of time in electronic reconnaissance of modern times. Digital phosphor technology (DPX) is a recent crucial innovation of real-time spectrum analysis technology. It can show the spectrum's state of a period of time intuitively by images and highly enhances the capability of capturing and observing signals and it can be applied to radar reconnaissance appropriately. We have designed a DPX system. Signals are sampled directly in RF in this system. The sample frequency is 1.2 GHz, the bandwidth is 500M, 1.85GHz-2.35GHz. The digitized data is sent though an FPGA that computes very fast spectral transforms of FFT, and the resulting frequency domain waveforms are saved and accumulated to create the bitmaps. 65, 535 FFT was continuously processed and accumulated to create a DPX image to display the state of real-time spectrum during about 100 ms. The image is 3D that is composed of pixels representing x, y, and z values for frequency amplitude, and hit count. The z values are displayed by different colors, and so we need pseudo-coloring coding for the DPX image. The traditional Pseudo-color coding method is mainly for the following 256 gray image. The DPX image in our system is high resolution of 0-65535. To improve the display of the DPX image, a new method of pseudo-coloring coding based on RGB tricolor which named "take-bit from binary number" (TBFBN) was brought forward. This method focused on the scope of 0-65535, coded every value, and overcome the lack of traditional method that coded within 0- 255. To select the method and the parameter, several experiments was carried through, and by contrast, the best display was chosen. The results of practice have shown that the technology of DPX can show the sate of spectrum directly and the method of TBFBN boosted up the effect of DPX display and improved the ability of observing and resolving.

articleTitle: Study on Supporting Ability of Cultivated Land Based on Integrated Food Security in Huayuan County
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This research study on evaluation ways and connotation of supporting ability of regional cultivated land based on integrated food security. After comprehensive analysis, this research established evaluation method for supporting ability of grain production of regional cultivated land and bound risk of regional cultivated land resources. Taking Huayuan County as an Example, this research forecasted county's supporting ability of grain production of cultivated land and bound risk of cultivated land resources in 2020, based on grain production datas. The conclusion comes as follows: Supply ability of grain production of regional cultivated land of Huayuan County in 2020 is 97%.

articleTitle: Residual Fatigue Life Evaluation of the Engine Crank Shaft Based on the Cumulative Fatigue Damage Theory
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With the cumulative fatigue damage theory, the residual fatigue life assessment model of crankshaft was built and its residual life was evaluated based on the history statistical working conditions. First, the three-dimension solid model of the crankshaft was formed by Pro/E software, and then imported into finite element analysis software ANSYS to perform dynamic response calculation under typical working conditions, the high stress area of structure, namely that of the most severe cumulative fatigue damage, was obtained. Then the stress-time history was carried out rain-flow counting by the finite element analysis, and the fatigue load spectrum was established based on history statistics record. The fatigue residual life assessment model was built with nominal stress approach and one application example was given at last.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Research on the Springback in Drawing Forming of the Complex Auto Body Panels Based on LS-DYNA
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The simulation technology of the finite element has been applied widely in many industrial departments. It predicts wrinkling, cracking, springback and prevents them happened in the forming simulation of the complex Auto-body Panels. And we all know that the control of springback is the most difficult. Numerical simulation and its application are introduced in the springback of sheet metal forming. A new simulation method has been used to simulate the springback of the Auto-body Panels of the benchmarks of Numisheet'05 in this paper because the forming of the panels which are composed of complex space curves produces the heterogenous stress distribution. So it improved the blank forming quality and springback accuracy after using blankholding simulation. It was introduced that the simulation process of blankholding, drawing, trimming and springback in detail.

articleTitle: The Visualization of 3D Geometry of the Fractures Around Wellbore Underground
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Due to its unobservability, randomness and staggered complexity, we cannot well understand the real form and distribution of the natural fracture of the rock in the deep strata, leading to a series of construction problems in the exploration and development of oil. At present, the geometry of fractures is displayed by the form of two-dimensional graph or data table, which cannot be performed more visually. In light of this finding, through the data analysis of fractures collected from the engineering practice, using the Monte Carlo method and a variety of programming languages, this paper has performed three-dimensional visualization of macroscopic fractures around wellbore underground. The data collected from Keshen block in Tarim oil field is simulatedand its results show that the simulation of the three-dimensional geometry of the fractures has achieved a good visual effect and provided a visualization of platform for further research such as wellbore stability about fractureformation.

articleTitle: On Drag Reduction Effect of Contour Bump of Supercritical Airfoil
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The effect of contour bumps on transonic drag reducing at off-design conditions of a supercritical airfoil have been examined in the paper. Research focuses on two-dimensional flow condition with Mach number of 0.78 and chord Reynolds number of 2.5 million. Different contour bump airfoil configurations are examined using numerical method. Recent tests on these models are conducted in 0.6m×0.6m transonic wind tunnel at CARDC to validate the drag reduction effect. The computational results indicate that a surface contour bump is capable of reducing transonic drag for moderate to high lift conditions, but raises the drag remarkably for lower lift condition due to the second shock wave generated near the aft of the bump. The experimental research shows a good agreement with the computational. With the computational and experimental evidences, the mechanism of contour bump's effect on transonic drag reduction has been further analyzed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Interface Fracture on Piping Welded Joint with Continuous Material Properties
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Based on a numerical simulated approach of the continuous change of material mechanical property, a pressure piping welded joint with semi-elliptical surface crack is studied, the effect of the welded mechanical heterogeneity on the stress-strain fields and J-integral along the interface crack fronts at different locations are simulated. The results of this investigation show that the maximal stress, strain and J-integral are located at the crack front center point, the minimal stress and strain are located at the piping inner surface. Crack lies in the weld metal is more susceptible to propagate, and the propagating tending direction of the crack near the line dividing the weld metal and heat affect zone is the weld metal.

articleTitle: Analysis of Terrain Roughness Based on Statistics
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A method based on statistics was proposed. A distance laser sensor equipment was used to obtain digital surfaces of three kinds of rough terrains, which were prepared with three particle sizes of quartz. The results of analyzing the discrete data of digital surfaces indicated that there was a good relationships between average root mean-squared height, average terrain energy and average particle size dav, which meant that terrain energy can be as a standard to evaluate the roughness of a terrain. Double logarithmic auto power spectrum density curves of rough terrains were drawn and the linear equations of double logarithmic auto power spectrum density of curves were given. The slopes of fitting linear equations lg(b) had a increasing relation with the roughness of terrain, which indicated that the positions of fitting straight lines of double logarithmic auto power spectrum density curve can also evaluated the roughness of a terrain.

articleTitle: Inverse Eigenvalue Problems in the Conveyor Based on Surrogate Model
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The design of the conveyor with dynamic properties can be classified as the solution to inverse eigenvalue problem. In order to deal with non-linear mapping function between structural parameters and mechanical properties. the optimization strategy using BP neural network surrogate model is proposed. The surrogate model is constructed with initial sampling points generated by orthogonal experiment design. A strategy of combining genetic algorithm(GA) and BP neural network was proposed, Optimization solution can be solved using the nonlinear approach capability of BP neural network and the nonlinear search operation of GA by employing the individual fitness value coming from the forecast evaluation based on the BP neural network system to the optimization of a genetic algorithm. which deal with the defects between genetic algorithm and structural reanalysis. This method is effective to structural inverse problems.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a MVB Network Controller for Coal Mine Environment Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper introduces the design and implementation of a Multi-function Vehicle Bus (MVB) controller card. MVB was originally designed for railway vehicles, but its advantages in real-time data transmission and relatively high noise immunity make it possible for coal mine environment monitoring applications. In this work, we propose a MVB controller architecture that can serve as the controller of a set of networked sensors. The proposed architecture is implemented as a circuit card firmware running on FPGA. The experiment results demonstrate that the MVB controller delivers superior performance.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Trust Storage System Based on TCM
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Currently, most of the file encryption systems are implemented in software for the foundation. Once the key was cracked, the encryption system fails completely. With hacking techniques becoming more sophisticated, traditional software encryption alone cannot guarantee the security of sensitive data. This paper introduces a trust storage system based on a security hardware, which implements the disk encryption based on partition, utilizing the device mapper mechanism. Meanwhile, a secure hardware, Trusted Cryptography Module (TCM) [1], provides security support from the hardware layer, greatly increasing the crack difficulty. As a result, effectively enhance the security of sensitive data.

articleTitle: Risk Identification for Collapse of Tunnel During Construction and the Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: According to the point that the risk during construction of karstic tunnels is often happened, this paper, based on a highway tunnel, identified the potential risk in construction through using the GPR (Ground Penetrating Radar) geological forecast to detect the surrounding rock. On the basis of the risk identification, the risk can be ascertained, and countermeasures can be taken so as to guarantee the construction safety and reduce the construction risk. The practical engineering situation shows that the utilization of GPR geological forecast to identify the potential risk can provide specific guidance for what countermeasures should be taken so as to avoid the blindness, and can reduce the loss caused by the risk, so the construction needs can be met and the target to provide effective guidance for construction can be achieved.

articleTitle: A Novel Method of Induction Motor Stator Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Based on Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy observer, present a new type fault diagnosis method for induction motor stator. The residuals using observer estimation output error generated, constitute effective criterion for fault diagnosis. At first, use the Lyapunov stability theory analysis the observer's stabilities, then set the observer pole configuration in the S plane of the designated area, The simulation results show that the method has stronger performance of fault diagnosis, and have good identification performance in full speed range.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Automotive Gasoline Engine Exhaust Gas Recirculation
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> is one of the three main pollutants emissions of automotive gasoline engine, it is the most difficult to reduce and control too, the technology of exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) is the most effective method to reduce the NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>. This method has been widely used in abroad, but most domestic research on the technology of EGR is insufficient, so in this paper, I design a set of exhaust gas recirculation system, by connecting with the practical condition in our country, starting with experiment. At the same time make a system research to influence by the exhaust gas returning system on the gasoline, such as exhaust gas, fuel economy, and power, which obtained under different working conditions by adopting the EGR integrated effect on emission rules.

articleTitle: Study on the Cost Management of the Construction Project's Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The cost management of the construction project's life cycle starts with the construction project's life cycle, and lays emphasis on investment decision phrase. It considers the cost of construction and the cost of operation and destruction comprehensively, and then achieves the cost optimization and saving of the construction project's life cycle, and minimize the resources consumption.

articleTitle: Observing Experiment and Analyzing Research of CO Occurrence in Original Coal Seam
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Coal has a strong adsorption capacity, adsorbed gas in coal seam is mostly CO2, CH4 and N2, only a little is CO. In upper corners and some other spots of mining face of some mine CO often transfinite, but due to being unclear about its source, fire preventing and controlling measures are often inefficient which directly threat safe production of coal mine. through determining and analyzing data of four site experimental boreholes in eastern 31 mining face of CUIJIAZHAI coal mine, content of CO contained by raw coal itself is found to be 0%~0.0019%, and with time develops, producing rate of CO slow down gradually, and concentration of CO increase with depth of borehole increase, so part of CO in mining face is concluded to stem from occurrence of original coal seam.

articleTitle: Thermal Error Compensation System for Linear Feeding System of Machine Tool
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper presents one thermal error compensation system for linear feeding system of machine tool. On the basis of testing the temperature of key components and the thermal error of linear feeding system of machine tool, the leading screw temperature coefficient is forecasted through a linear regression model by ordinary least squares. The independent variable of the regression model is the mean change of two key components temperature, and the dependent variable is the actual temperature coefficient. Then, combined with the theory of thermal expansion of metal, the thermal error compensation model for linear feeding system is set up. This compensation model is already integrated in LT-GJ410 CNC system and tested with good compensation accuracy and real-time performance.

articleTitle: Titanium Alloy Deep Hole Jacking Processing Mechanics Characteristic Experimental Research
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Taking TA1 titanium alloy deep hole trepanning mechanical properties as the research object, in view of the titanium alloy material physical and mechanical processing properties, this paper develop of a outside chip discharge trepanning drill of a diameter 117mm, choose different cutting parameters to conduct trepanning processing, separately measure the axial force and torque on the drill pipe. Through the analysis of test data, we can obtain that when the spindle rotational speed is constant, the axial force and torque with the feed rate increases, and when the feed rate is constant, the axial force and torque will increase with the feed rate, while the feed rate is constant, the axial force still increase with the spindle speed increase, but the torque decrease with the spindle speed increase and tool wear and tear aggravate with the increase of cutting parameters.

articleTitle: A Trajectory Planning Algorithm for Highly Automated Driving in Complex Environment
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper tries to present an trajectory planning algorithm applied in an intelligent driver model to control an unmanned ground vehicle in complex environment. The proposed trajectory planning algorithm takes into account of the surrounding environment, including lanes and road geometries, surrounding obstacles, including static obstacles and moving obstacles, and traffic infrastructure, and a decision making process determines an optimum trajectory to follow safely and comfortably based on the analysis of the travelable region and traffic rules. The concept presented in this paper is demonstrated through simulation and the results are discussed.

articleTitle: Factors Influencing the Thermal Behavior of Adhesive Anchor in Steel-to-Concrete Connection at Elevated Temperature
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: As an effective tool for post-installed anchorage adhesive anchor is widely used in steel-to-concrete connection for structural retrofit, however the bond strength of adhesive would have significant reduction at elevated temperature. Therefore this paper proposed a numerical analysis of 3D FE model to investigate the performance of steel-to-concrete connection exposed to fire. Variables that affect the thermal response of adhesive anchor including fire resisting coating's thickness, edge distance, fire protection area and embedment depth of anchor have been studied. The results show that thicker fire resisting coating can provide better protection for inner anchor and control the anchor temperature in a lower level, the maximum temperature of anchor in the case of edge distance 40mm would reach above 600°C after a fire exposure of 90 minutes. Compared with the total coating protection on concrete surface, partial protection measurement tends to lead to disuniform temperature distribution on concrete surface in the early stage of heating. The increase of embedment depth has slight effect on temperature gradient of anchor at elevated temperature.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Auxiliary Teaching Course Study about MCU
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: As a new mode of thinking, three-dimensional auxiliary teaching course about MCU has been put forward, aiming at problems existing in the teaching course. It has extended to single-chip microcomputer extra-curricular class teaching. Teaching mode based on the project type teaching and CTE mode of student-centered is implemented. By online teaching resources, modular development, three-dimensional auxiliary materials and the project teaching to built. It has been reformed the MCU teaching contents and teaching methods. Because the original MCU teaching mode change, and students' interest in learning is stimulated and teaching quality of the MCU is improved.

articleTitle: Optimizing Design on Emergency Power Supply of Large Dynamotor Unit
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Diesel generator unit as the emergency power of the plant has an important effect that whether the generator unit can stop safely or not in the accident conditions. In order to optimize the design of an emergency power for the large dynamotor unit, the 2*600MW aircooling unit emergency load is taken as an example, four kinds wring schemes of the emergency power are designed and constructed by the ETAP software. The reliability, power flow, short-circuit current and economic data of the four schemes are evaluated. Through the comparison, the optimal, economic, and reasonable scheme of the alternating emergency power and diesel generator unit could be put forward, the Option IV is recommended as satisfying emergency power for the 600MW air-cooling unit. The simulation results of 600MW alternating emergency power can also provide a reference for the 1000MW unit design of emergency power.

Author Keywords: Analysis of Emergency Power Wring Scheme

articleTitle: Traffic Control Classification Standard of Expressway Incident Section
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The article first proposes the criteria of the severity of the incident in the standard and plan is only for delimiting the severe grades of the incident itself, is not suitable for judging the impact of incident on the road traffic in the first scene. To this end this article first proposes the concept of traffic control level. Number of lanes occupied, lane closure time and saturation are as the three indicators to determine the incident's impact on traffic. The three-lane expressway as the research object simulated one and two-lane occupied when incident occurred by VISSIM simulation software. Obtained the maximum queue length at different saturation and event duration, and theoretically calculated queue dissipation time. Traffic control level was classified at the section where incident occurred, and corresponding control measures were put forward for each level.

articleTitle: Analysis on Seismic Property of Steel Frame-Steel Plate Shear Wall with Slit
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The finite element analysis on steel frames-steel plate shear wall with slit on the seismic waves, EL Centro, 400cm/ are conducted. The results showed that the thickness of steel plate has a significant impact on seismic performance on the steel frame-steel plate shear wall with slit. With the thickness decreasing, the vertex displacement and base shear increase, and the size of hysteresis curves become larger.

Author Keywords: steel frames-steel plate shear wall with slit

articleTitle: Kinematics Research of Sealing Mechanism of GT4B2 Can-Sealing Machine
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Based on the principle of can-sealing machine, this paper analyzes in detail velocity of each component, movement track of sealing roller and main parameters. It provides theoretical basis for can-sealing machine in design.

articleTitle: The Overlay Network Optimization for Environmental Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With the monitoring rang expanded increasingly, the topology of the network environmental monitoring system needs to be developed from the single-layer structure to the multi-layer structure, which branch node function setting and optimization problems are very important. The structure of the overlay network currently being used in the environmental monitoring system is complex, and its communication modes vary, there are also differences in reliability and accuracy. Only proper management can avoid sending the wrong message, improving the overall environmental monitoring system performance. When the monitoring node reaches a certain magnitude, we can assume that all nodes are the same in statistical sense. Bayesian Network probabilistic graphical models generated by the algorithm can fast correct the data as a whole. The simulation data show that the task of collation of data and uncertain data discrimination given to the branch node in accordance with the Bayesian network model algorithm, can effectively improve system reliability and validity.

articleTitle: Seismic Responses Study of Pile-Groups Foundation
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The pile foundation is a widely used form of the basis, and its mechanical behavior under static action has been basically clear, but has yet to be a more detailed study of response pattern under dynamic action. A group pile foundation for the study, with the dynamic finite element analysis method to explore the seismic response law of pile groups. The study considered the nonlinear soil, pile - soil interaction, pile side resistance and end resistance action. Calculated dynamic response results of the cap - Piles - foundation system, and it's research findings have reference value to the dynamic design of the pile foundation.

articleTitle: Design of Force Loading Monitor and Control System Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Effective monitor and control to tension loading, pressure loading, system pressure, temperature, positive stop, travel speed, proportional regulation of hydraulic proportion valve are the preconditions that can ensure force loading system working normally force loading monitor system based on the preconditions is developed. The monitor system takes MITSUBISHI PLC controller as core. As remote part, computer system remote control is realized by RS485 communication. While filed part adopts touch screen communicated by RS232 and wireless control device to achieve the control of solenoid valve, electric motor, proportion valve and transducer and the acquisition of signals of pressure, temperature and torque. System lower computers, remote upper computers and upper computers use MITSUBISHI PLC, LabVIEW and HITECH touch screen to programming, respectively. The test results show that the monitor system can achieve the monitor of field and remote independent control and realize the monitor and control of force loading signals accurately and quickly.

articleTitle: Management Strategies of Corporate Crisis Public Relations in the New Media Era
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Since the beginning of the 21st century, with the development of communication technologies and internet applications, new media, as represented by networks, digital mobile channels and others, leads to a fundamental change of the relationship between the audience and the media. How to adapt to and take advantage of the development of the new media, effectively prevent the occurrence of crisis, and properly handle crisis events are important management challenges facing enterprises. This article analyzes the effects of new media on crisis events, as well as problems existing in current crisis management, and presents corresponding management strategies.

articleTitle: Feasibility of Shield Junction using Freezing Method in Qiongzhou Strait Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Qiongzhou strait cross-sea project has attracted a lot of attention. of all the plans discussed, the tunnel scheme is a potential one. Because of the long distance and great depth, Qiongzhou strait tunnel has many engineering problems. AGF (artificial ground freezing) has been widely used in many tunnels as a ground strengthening method. The feasibility of AGF in construction of Qiongzhou strait tunnel was studied by using finite element numerical simulation method. The simulation was conducted to compare different freezing plans, i.e., single-row-piped freezing and the double-row-piped freezing. In the simulation, different length of cutter head in circumferential direction was demolished, affecting the mechanical behavior and deformation of the frozen soil umbrella. The research demonstrates that the double-row-piped freezing is superior to the single one on safety. The length of cutter head demolished in circumferential direction has great influence on the mechanical behavior and deformation of the frozen soil umbrella. Guidance on construction can be obtained from the layout of this paper.

articleTitle: Parameter Estimation of Modified Cambridge Model in Soft Soil Area
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Modified Cambridge model has widely applications in analysis of soft soil, and the parameters are always obtained with some extra soil mechanics experimental. Here we summarizes some methods to estimate the parameters of modified Cambridge model without extra experiment. With these methods we could estimate every parameter of modified Cambridge model just through the general geotechnical investigation report. The conversion equation of modified Cambridge model in the software of ABAQUS. is also given in this paper.

articleTitle: Physical Design and Verification for Embedded CPU under Deep Submicron Technology
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: To overcome the challenges brought by the scale down of feature size, a flow of physical design and verification for embedded CPU under deep submicron technology is put forward in this paper. New problems are encountered in timing closure, signal integrity, IR drop and antenna effect, so we must select the effective EDA tools and develop new flow of physical design and verification combining with the characteristics of circuit under deep submicron technology. New challenges are analyzed, especially the interconnect line effect, and how to prevent the crosstalk and ensure the timing performance has been discussed. The embedded CPU CK610 using 0.13um 1P4M CMOS process technology has been completed by this new flow and the result indicates this chip complies with all requirements.

articleTitle: The Method of Pattern Recognition Based on Weighted Intuitionistic Fuzzy Relative Entropy
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: On the difficulty for the current pattern recognition to deal with fuzzy uncertain information, in this paper, the author tries to give a definition of intuitionistic fuzzy relative entropy, and meanwhile introduces the weighted thought into fuzzy pattern recognition, putting forward the method of Pattern Recognition based on Weighted Intuitionistic Fuzzy Relative Entropy. The new method accurately describes and shows the uncertainty of historical information, effectively realizes the quantitative analysis of pattern recognition, and improves the reliability, accuracy, and the robust performance of the system. Finally, through the examples, the effectiveness and superiority are proved.

articleTitle: The Post-Processing Custom Technology of MasterCAM for HNC-22M 5-Coordinate Machine
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: On the basis of analysing the central Huazhong HNC-22M system, the most widely used in our country with independent intellectual property rights, using the CNC code characteristics and the MasterCAM X6 5- axis general post processor file format, we detect MasterCAM X6 post-processing documents related processing information, so we propose 5-coordinate machine post-processing documents' special machine tool axis type selection, axis address allocation, axis rotation vector plane, spindle pendulum length and axis offset Settings dialog processing method, in order to obtain suitable for HNC- 22M CNC system 5- axis machining program output. Not only this software MasterCAM X6 5-coordinate post-processing documents setting skills, have specific aim, but also have a universal significance.

articleTitle: Semantic Search Technology Based on Cloud Computing Research
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this Paper, on the basis of introducing the search technology and cloud computing, the deficiencies and shortcomings of traditional search technology and inadequate has been discussed. From research and design point of view, a distributed semantic cloud based search method has been proposed and a cloud-based distributed storage system has been researched.

articleTitle: Design of the Sustainer for Electric Bicycle Based on the MSP430
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Aimed at the motor stalling problem of electric bicycle for the battery under voltage, an automatic sustainer for electric bicycle based on the MSP430 is designed in this paper. The sustainer can monitor and forecast the speed and mileage of the electric bicycle by Hall sensor in real-time, then regulate the voltage and speed to avoid the stalling and extend the driving once the battery becomes under voltage. The experimental result shows that the design is reasonable, universal, easy to operate and worthy of promotion.

articleTitle: Research on Insurance Strategy Simulation Model of Engineering Project
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With the development of social economy and technology, the scale of engineering project enlarges continuously, and the risk is growing gradually. As a kind of effective way to share engineering risk, the engineering insurance is becoming the important tool of engineering project risk management, and choosing the efficient engineering insurance strategy is becoming the main emphasis of engineering project risk management. This paper presents that forecasting the risk loss of engineering project to estimate insurance claim amount is the key of engineering insurance strategy choice by insurance operation system analysis of engineering project. Based on this idea, this paper structures engineering project insurance strategy SD simulation model, and proves it with the simulation example of A bridge construction projects.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model for Low-Velocity Flow of Coal Bed Methane in Low-Permeability Reservoirs
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A mathematical model for transport of coal bed methane(CBM) was presented, taking into account low-velocity non-Darcy flow behavior and coupling of methane desorption from coal matrix and diffusion from matrix into cleats. Under several simplifying assumptions, a simple calculation method for control area of single wells was proposed. Low-velocity non-Darcy flow behavior was characterized by pseudo threshold pressure gradient (PTPG). Numerical results show that both PTPG and desorption rate have a significant impact on determination of control radius. PTPG has a negative effect on the deployment of the peripheral reserves. Increasing PTPG would result in fewer control area. In the contrast, increasing desorption rate would lead to larger control area. The calculation method would provide engineers a better understanding of development of CBM.

articleTitle: Adaptive Analysis of Filter Methods for Magnetic Resonance Sounding
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: There is no targeted strategy for different noises for the Magnetic Resonance Sounding detecting underground water at present, in order to improve the filtering effects, save the measure time, and then ensure the accuracy of inversion result, the targeted strategy are provided in this paper. The signal measured from Magnetic Resonance Sounding (MRS) instruments needs to process by the digital filter. There are three methods to be used in MRS instruments, include adaptive north filter, moving average filter and FIR low-pass filter. Through building the ideal model adding several normal noises in MRS signal analyses what kind of method adapts what kind of noise. According to the value of SNR, the decay situation of spectrum amplitude, the adaptabilities of various filtering methods are summed up. At the same time, the actual measurement data also proves the strategy basing on the ideal model, at final, adaptive filter methods for several noises is put forward.

articleTitle: "Flexibility" of Software Development Method
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Contraposing the complex and fickle development tendency of software development process in recent years, "Flexibility"" of software development method is put forward. The basic conditions supporting "flexibility" is discussed. Last it is discussed that how to structure software development method possessing "flexibility".

articleTitle: Study on Water-Oil Flow Characteristics in Low Permeability Porous Media
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In serious vertical heterogeneity reservoir, the injected-water along the high-permeability layer break fastly into the production well, while in low-permeability layer there are many death oil region that the injected-water does not spread. For injected-water did not affect crude oil within a low permeability layer, displacement efficiency significantly reduced [1][2]. Further spread of the injected water to the low permeability regions, improvement of vertical sweep of injected-water, creating equilibrium displacement front can raise oil recovery, prolong water-free production period and reduce volumes of injected-water. In view of this, theoretical study on water flooding characteristic in heterogeneous plane models of sandstone in this article has been done. The main conclusions are as follows: (1) establishes a vertical exchange of oil-water relationship, exchange capacity is related mainly to capillary force, gravity, start-up pressure and flow cross-sectional area. (2) water-bearing saturation gradients makes injected-water flow from high water to low water areas. For water-wet reservoir, the injected-water flows from the higher layer to low-permeability layers, and for oil-wet reservoirs, precisely the opposite. (3) as the density of the injected water was increased, the efficiency of water flooding didn't change obviously in anti-prosodic models of sandstone and ultimate recovery rates was little difference between the two. And with increasing the density of injected water, vertical flowing cross-sectional area and oil displacement efficiency increased all.

Author Keywords: Mathematical model of vertical exchange of oil-water

articleTitle: GIS Application in Civil Engineering
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Geographic Information System (GIS) technology is more and more used even in the technical practice of a construction industry. In the preparatory phase of the construction, the problems of a spatial positioning (location) of the construction have to be solved jointly with the checking of the feasibility and purposefulness, the traffic projects are worked out, and the alternative. More detailed solutions of technical problems are designed. At project development there are used various forms of initial documents, results of the actual data gathering and surveys, map sheets, photographs, previous documents referring to the problems solved, and appropriate legal and technical standards. The article presents the experience with the issue of GIS in construction in preparation of buildings, in the implementation phase of the construction in GIS. It presents a model of information system construction and technology of mobile GIS for data collection and use of mobile GIS in water management.

articleTitle: Vibration Modal Analysis of Centrifuge Pipe-Die for Pre-Stressed Concrete Square Pile
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: 3D modeling of pipe-die for pre-stressed concrete centrifugal square pile is conducted basically using CATIA software in this paper. The developed digital model is imported to ANSYS software for vibration modal analysis, thus gaining natural vibration frequency of each order of pipe-die and the corresponding vibration mode. Finally, valuable suggestions on the structure design of centrifuge have been proposed.

articleTitle: Post-Occupancy Evaluation of Information Intelligent System in Guangzhou Three University Campus
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Choose three different administrative property in Guangzhou campus, to make the use present situation questionnaire survey of information intelligent system, and find out the existing problems in information intelligent systems, the collected data by using frequency analysis, mean analysis and single factor variance analysis method of statistical analysis, to obtain the user satisfaction evaluation index, and to explore the future development trend of the campus information intelligent system.

articleTitle: Application of Adaptive Interference Suppressor to Gimbal of MSCMG
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: To eliminate ill effects of the disturbance torque on the stability of output angular rate of the gimbal servo system, an adaptive disturbance torque compensation method with no modeling is presented. An interference suppressor for selfadaption compensation is designed using invariance principle of output angular rate of the gimbal servo system to disturbance torque. Different disturbance torque is added into the system to test the role of the interference suppressor. The MATLAB simulation shows that the interference suppressor has the same significant effect in suppressing different kind of disturbance torque.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of the Steel Roof of the Tianjin Grand Theater in the Unloading Process
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The structure system of the steel roof of Tianjin Grand Theater is complex, and the stress distribution changes constantly in the unloading process. Through the simulation analysis of the whole unloading process, the stress distribution and deformation of the structure in different unloading steps were obtained. Besides, member configuration was predicated and preset in order to satisfy the target configuration when the project is completed. The simulation analysis verifies the feasibility of the unloading plan and provides a reference for the design and construction of long-span space steel structures in the future.

articleTitle: Spatial Model for Optimal Management of In-Bin Stored Grain
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper presents a GIS-based spatial-variable model for the optimal management for in-bin stored grain and our new advances in the research of the model. The spatial variables are defined by a number of coverages. Each coverage includes a number of vector curves to present spatially the temperature, moisture and other status of stored grain. Thus, the status of stored grain at any time can be described by a series of coverages. The optimal management for grain drying and storage in a number of steel bins can be changed into the optimal management for the related spatial variables. In the management, the geographic information system (GIS) is powerful tool to solve the spatial-analysis problem, which provides a good environment to implement the optimal management system for in-bin stored grain.

articleTitle: Research on Intensity Measure Selection for Response Estimation of Reinforced Concrete Pier
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
