abstract: For estimating seismic response of pier-structure under near-fault ground motion, The typical pulse-type near-fault ground motion records were chosen to establish a record base, and three pier models with different natural period were established, the effect of structural response estimation by using the non-elastic response spectral displacement of ground motion was studied by using nonlinear time history analysis, and the influence of parameters of the nonlinear oscillator on seismic response estimation was observed. The study is important for structural seismic response estimation under near-fault ground motion and the probability-based seismic performance evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on Molding and Design of Waterfront Space from the Perspective of Region Culture -- A Case Study on the Water System Renovation of Chaohu City
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The paper intends to probe into the molding and design of waterfront space from the perspective of region culture. In this article, the author takes the renovation project of river system around Chaohu City as a study case. By comparing the designs of waterfront spaces at home and abroad, the author comes to their different designs methods and tourist development strategies and analsizes historic background and times characters in innovating river system around Chaohu City. Basing on the above-mentioned study, the author concludes that the design of city waterfront space has to embody the ideology of "region, history, space and transition".

articleTitle: Aerodynamic Optimization Research on External Shape for a Sedan Based on Numerical Simulation
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The aerodynamics characteristics of sedan model were researched by simulation, the drag coefficient and the aerodynamic characteristics around model were achieved with analysis of velocity and pressure distribution. Based on results, the below transition radius of rear-view mirror, the angle of back window and trunk lid and back trunk were optimized. The drag coefficients were reduced. The conclusions provide reference for how to reduce aerodynamic drag coefficient of sedan when developing the external shape of a new sedan.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Aeration Control for In-Bin Stored Grain
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper, we discuss mainly a new method for building the fuzzy controller for controlling aeration devices in the grain-storage system. This new fuzzy-control method is used for designing a special fuzzy-control strategy for the aeration management or in-bin drying stored grain. First, the method defines the fuzzy-control base variables which consist of the fuzzy-control membership function. Then, it constructs the fuzzy-control rule base which supports the fuzzy rule inference. Next, it implements the fuzzy rule inference, so that the rules in the rule base can determine the trace of action that the aeration devices must follow. Finally, it translates the result of the fuzzy inference from a linguistic concept to a crisp output value to drive the aeration devices. Thus, the aeration devices are automatically operated at suitable times to implement the scientific management for in-bin drying stored grain.

articleTitle: Supercritical Airfoil Data Corrected for Sidewall Boundary-Layer Effects in Transonic Wind Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: It is necessary to correct data of supercritical airfoil for sidewall boundary-layer effects in transonic wind tunnel, thus investigating the aerodynamic characteristics of supercritical airfoil perfectly. In this paper, NASA SC (2)-0714 airfoil was numerically simulated with chosen grids, and compared with corrected EFD results. The Barnwell-Sewell(B-S) method was applied to correct sidewall boundary-layer effects of supercritical airfoil CH in NF-6 wind tunnel. It is shown that there was large disparity between CFD and uncorrected EFD results, while CFD and EFD results compared well after correction. The B-S method for sidewall boundary-layer effects correction of NF-6 wind tunnel is validated.

articleTitle: Tensile Capacity and Anchorage Length Experiment of Chemically-Planted Steel Bar Member
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Post-installed fastenings (chemically-planted steel bar) technology of stressed steel bar is widely adopted in structural transformation and reinforcement project, and researching anchoring section of post-installed reinforcing bars is of great significance. Through the tensile capacity experiment of chemically-planted steel bar member, failure modes was observed in static limit state, and the damage reasons and influence factors were analyzed. The strain change along the length direction of post-installed reinforcing bars was determined, and the change discipline of steel stress and corresponding stress-strain curves were obtained. Through the anchorage length experiment of chemically-planted steelbar member, steel strain and ultimate uplift bearing capacity change in concrete structure under different planting bar length was determined, and the optimal anchorage length was obtained.

articleTitle: Preliminary Study on Distribution and Iodine's Origin of Iodine-Rich Groundwater in North China Plain
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The North China Plain is a major area in China where thyropathy occurs. As an important water-supply source, the groundwater of the North China Plain deserves more concern in its iodine content. In this article, the iodine distribution and origin of groundwater in the North China Plain are preliminarily analyzed based on plenty of sample data.

articleTitle: Application of BP Neural Network Embankment Settlement Prediction in Seasonal Frozen Areas
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Considering the function of temperature in Freeze-thaw cycle of seasonal frozen area, temperature is an important factor as BP neural network input layer. The settlement in Season frozen area is predicted based on actual measurements, which will enable the prediction results more in line with the actual engineering of the seasonally frozen ground region, and at the same time improve the prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: The Research of the Sichuan Concentrated Poverty Area Traffic Localization of Talents Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In Sichuan concentrated contiguous poor areas, thequantity and overall quality of transportation industryprofessionals have a huge gap to modern requirements oftransportation construction & management and to the overallgoal of transportation construction demand. This articlesurveys the basic structure of the transportation personnel, analysis the main problems of traffic personnel teams andpersonnel needs, proposed contiguous poor areas centralizedcontiguous poor areas in Sichuan traffic Talent Localizationculture approach to alleviate traffic personnel shortageseffective measure in Sichuan centralized contiguous poor areas.

articleTitle: Diesel Engine Fault Diagnosis and Denoising Disposal of the Vibration Signals Based on EMD Method
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With characteristics analysis of the vibration signal from the diesel engine, a new method for identifying the characteristic frequency band is put forward by adopting its IMF component. The diesel engine vibration signals are disposed by using EMD method and the IMF components with respond to the main interference factors is eliminated. Then, the true vibration signal from diesel engine could be gotten by reconstructing the remaining IMF components, and the working state could be estimated combing with the history condition of the diesel engine. The test results showed that the being reconstructed signal can reflect the true trend of the fuselage vibration for the diesel engine.

articleTitle: SROSE: A Reconfigurable Publish Subscribe on Large Scale Dynamic Overlay Management
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper presented a complete approach to the reconfiguration of content-based publish/subscribe(Pub/Sub) systems. A sparse ROSE(SROSE) model was defined and a reconfiguration strategy for subscription tables was proposed, which was based on the notion of composition and decomposition of SROSE. The results show that reconfiguration strategy on large scale dynamic overlay management is feasible.

articleTitle: Double Degree of Freedom Attitude Adjustment and Stability System Design and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper designed an attitude control system which is based on the attitude detection and feedback and mainly for the application of intelligent electric wheelchairs' stability control. And the effectiveness of the system is verified through the simulation experiment.

articleTitle: Research on Micro-Doppler Feature of Precession Target Based on Bistatic Radar
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The micro-motion feature extracted form micro-Doppler is an important basis for target recognition in BMD. The micro-Doppler information in bistatic radar has many differences because of its spatial complexity compared with the monostatic radar. In this paper, micro-Doppler effect of precession warhead is derived in the bistatic radar system with LFM signals and the micro-Doppler signatures are analyzed. The micro-Doppler extracted from the echoes of warhead by means of time frequency representation is consistent with that of the theoretical value, which indicates the correctness and effectiveness of analysis in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Nonlinear Synthetic Controller for Marine Diesel Engine Generator
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to improve the marine power system robustness for varying parameters, and attenuate the persistent disturbances effect on power system stability. In this paper, based on the nonlinear robust model of the power system including static load, the storage functions of the system are constructed by integrating nonlinear L2 gain disturbances attenuation theory smoothly into backstepping design methodology. A nonlinear robust controller law are obtained. The controller reflects the nonlinearity of the system and decreases the impact of the disturbances. The simulation results show that the closed-loop system has the ability to attenuate the disturbance using the controller and can resume stable state rapidly when large disturbances happen.

articleTitle: Modified Wilson-theta Method under State Feedback and Its Calculation Stability
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper, using system's dynamic equilibrium equation to determine the imbalance component of calculation acceleration in Wilson-θ integration algorithm, then react to original system as feedback to revise the computational movement state. Two approaches are presented: to revise in lagged time step, it would retain the unconditional stability of original method; to revise in real time, it would be conditional stability in case of θ≥1.37 and Δt ≥ 1 / √2π . As a contract, the situation of Newmark method is discussed also.

articleTitle: An Application of Stochastic Control Theory in Premium Policy of an Insurance Firm
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper, we study the optimization problem with stochastic interest rates faced by an insurance firm who can control its cash-balance dynamics by adjusting the underlying premium rates. Our objective is to minimize the total deviation of the cash-balance process in an insurance firm to some pre-set target levels by selecting an appropriate premium policy.

articleTitle: The Application of Algorithms for Fire-Fighting Search Operations within Buildings
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Fire departments already make use of geographic information systems (GIS) to reduce the response time in case of incidents. However, the complex internal structure of buildings on fire may make search and rescue difficult in emergency situations. Search is the act of firefighters' looking for something (e.g. the location of potential victims). Search is possibly one of themost dangerous activities on the fire ground. Sometimes the visibility is zero, and the environment is really hot. Because of limited operating time in the building, the key to a successful search is how quickly firefighters can search. This study is motivated by the need for a micro GIS to represent and analyze 3D spatial data in fire-fighting search operations. The method can minimize the searching time for potential victims. The developed method generates a 3D geometric network model from 2D building plans. To search a whole floor within the building, the genetic algorithmis used to find the optimal locations of rescue teams to deploy. In addition, when firefighters need to search an area in order to find the victims, the ant algorithm is applied to find the shortest path that passes through each room of the area. Finally, the model is implemented to perform fire-fighting search analysis froman underground station.

articleTitle: Application of DPX in Wideband Signal Detection
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In the circumstance of complex electromagnetism, the systems for signal detection need the abilities of wideband collection and processing, high probability of intercept and capture, and meanwhile fast and exact analysis. Then, the wideband signal detection approach based on Digital phosphor technology (DPX) is proposed in this paper for complex electromagnetic environment. This method analyzes the DPX image of the received signal, and can accurately measure the frequency domain signal parameters of multiple signals. Also, the method for signal detection based on cumulative spectrum, which was made for DPX after FMM, is introduced. Furthermore, the performance of detecting the emitter signals using this method is systematically analyzed under different conditions - single signal, double signals and multiple signals existing in the same receiver band. When there is more than one signal, the relationship of frequency position is divided into separation, cross and containing. All the resolvent for every situation are particularly explained at the same time. Next, the corresponding simulation tests are presented, where the accumulation time of DPX is set as 100ms. There are three broadband signals in the frequency band. One of them doesn't match the frequency mask and the other two signals do. The frequency of the two matching signals crosses to each other. Every 100 tests are done under the SNR of 5dB, 10dB, 15dB and 20dB, respectively. Finally, the result analysis and conclusion are discussed followed. The simulating results has demonstrated that the multiple signals existing in the same time period can be analyzed effectively by adopting the method proposed in this paper, which improves the capability of detection.

articleTitle: Application of Q420 Large Size Angle Steel in Power Transmission Tower
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The steel tower applying large size angel steel which limb width exceeds 200mm is characterized with good integrity of material, clear force transmission, simple node structure, saving bolts and filling plate, convenient assembly and erection etc advantages. Technical and economic advantage of Q420 large size angle steel tower has been validated in ±800kv ultra-high DC Jinping-Sunan power transmission line engineering. It has been become a tendency to use Q420 large size angle steel to substitute angle steel tower with large design carrying capacity of common combined specification (limb width is 200mm and below). This paper makes thorough analysis and summary on application condition, application characteristic, technology and economy of application, design and research of application, application principle etc of Q420 large size angle steel.

articleTitle: The Research on Compaction Characteristics of Cement Soil
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to understand the cement soil compaction characteristic, through indoor compaction test methods, study on the different amount of cement soil in dry and wet compaction test. The results showed that in the standard compaction power, the optimum moisture content and the maximum dry density of cement soil present a certain regularity with different cement quantity. When the cement quantity and compaction work at the same time, the optimum moisture content and the maximum dry density are significant differences in the dry and wet compaction conditions. It is of practical significance to the geotechnical engineering construction of using cement soil construction or reinforcement.

articleTitle: Discussions on Design of Nail-Shaped Cement Soil Bidirectional Mixing Pile of a Pumping Station
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Nail-shaped bidirectional soil-cement mixing pile, as a new foundation reinforcement technology, has been successfully applied in Jiangsu, Zhejiang and other places. The application of nail-shaped cement soil bidirectional mixing pile in the construction of the Huangshansi Drainage Pumping Station is the first attempt of this process in the water conservancy projects in our province. Through analysis of geological exploration data, it is determined that the process of nail-shaped bidirectional soil-cement mixing pile is used to reinforce the foundations of intake gate, retaining walls at both sides of fore bay, sink tank, water culvert, flare wall, etc of this pumping station. The composite foundation bearing capacity calculations, settlement calculations and filed mixing core sampling intensity tests and analysis have shown that this design is rational. As this process is technically advanced and economically rational, the authors advise to promote the use of this process in other similar projects.

articleTitle: Studies on the Differences of County Economic Development Level and the Water Resources Coordination in Central Yunnan Economic Zone
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: 42 counties in Central Yunnan Economic Zone was regard as research unit in this paper. Principal Component Analysis and the evaluation models of the coordination degree have been used to analyze spatial pattern and time variation characteristics, which include both the county economic development level and the coordination degree of county economic development level and water resource in Central Yunnan Economic Zone. The result shows: (1)From 1999 to 2009, the difference of county economic development level has enlarged as if waves. The spatial structure in this region evolved from pole nucleus type to Pole-axis type gradually. At the same time, The difference of coordination has been gradually enlarged.(2)For the coordinated development of all regions, some measures should be taken such as strengthening the radiation effect of growth poles, optimizing the regional spatial structure and promoting the coordinated development of industrial structure.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of Inertia Resonance Probability Screen Grate Bar Based on FEA and Modal Experiment
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The grate bar is one of the important parts of the inertia resonance probability screen system, which is the main component of coal unloading system in the power plant. Therefore, the dynamic characteristic of the grate bar is studied in this paper. Based on the 3D model, the theory modal analysis of the inertia resonance probability screen grate bar was conducted with ANSYS software and the experimental modal analysis was carried out through LMS Test. Lab Impact Testing system. The results of the theory analysis are in good consistency with those of the experimental analysis, which shows that the finite element model built in this paper is reasonable. This paper provides theoretical reference for vibration and noise reduction of the inertia resonance probability screen grate bar.

Author Keywords: Inertia resonance probability screen grate bar

articleTitle: Study on Anchorage Technology of the Umbrella-Shape Soil Anchor
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The existing soil anchor of steel strand encapsulated by cement has many disadvantages such as longer anchorage length, more construction process and not timely bearing load. Compared with the existing soil anchor, new umbrella-shape soil anchor has lots of advantages: simple structure, convenient construction, high bearing capacity, timely anchoring soil. Umbrella-shaped soil anchor is composed by anchor head and jacking device. Anchor head has two anchor plates, a V-shape connection plate. Jacking device includes push rod and fan-shaped slide block. The jacking force is the summation of the side friction resistance and the frontal resistance. The result of experiment about the jacking force shows that the change of the frontal resistance is not obvious with the increase of the jacking distance and the frictional force increases linearly with the jacking distance. The calculation formula of the jacking force has practical value. The anchor plate bears the passive earth pressure in soil. Anti-pull force balances to the passive earth pressure.

Author Keywords: Structure of the Umbrella-shape Soil Anchor

articleTitle: Research on Population Size Forecasting Method for Emergency Evacuation at School
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Emergency evacuation is an important means to reduce casualties in coping with emergencies. Before issuing evacuation orders, forecasting the population size is the basis of all the evacuation plans. In previous studies, researchers usually use resident population or a fixed value instead of the population size of evacuation, without considering the diversity of the number of evacuees at different times. Based on a statistical analysis of the number of people going in and out at school accommodation area, according to the changing rule of the number of evacuees at different times, this paper presents a method using conversion factors to calculate the number of evacuees in a specific area, and verifies differences in gender and education also can cause the fluctuations of the number, which provides methodological guidance for forecasting the population size in emergency evacuation.

articleTitle: Modern Agricultural Park Problems and Countermeasures in Planning Perspective
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: From the necessity of developing modern agriculture Park this article summed up the types of contemporary agriculture Park. Combinning with the problems of current modern agricultural Park in practice, the author summarized the causes in Planning management and design, and put forward some countermeasures, in order to provide reference for future work.

articleTitle: Heat Effects on PEG/PAMmixed Flocculant and the Treatment of Wastewater Produced in Vanadium Extraction from Stone Coal
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this study, a series of heating methods were used to help dissolve a mixed flocculant Polyethylene glycol/Polyacrylamide(PEG/PAM). And this flocculant was used to treat wastewater produced in vanadium extraction from stone coal. In order to research whether or not the heating solubilization methods would lower the removal effect of pollutants in wastewater, three heating methods especially microwave at a range of temperature had been acted on PEG/PAM, and removal efficiency of pollutants in wastewater were compared when adding PEG/PAM before and after heating. The results show that heat treatments of PEG/PAM mixed flocculants almost had no effect on removal of As, Fe and pH of yielding water, but had a small effect on removal of V, Cd and volume of floc produced. Even though, they slightly affected the treatment effect of wastewater, for we can accelerate the dissolution of PEG/PAM mixed flocculants through heating them to save dissolving time and container volume without reducing the treatment efficiency.

Author Keywords: Wastewater Produced in Vanadium Extraction from Stone Coal

articleTitle: The Application of BIM in the Completion Phase
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: First, it is introduced that the BIM technology in the paper in order to solve the problem of built drawings and the completion of settlement in the completion phase. Then, verifying the feasibility of BIM technology in the completion phase through judging whether that matches two conditions. The first condition is whether the completion model with BIM is integrity or not. The second is the BIM technology has applied to the design and construction phases. Last, the paper proposed a strategy for the built drawing and the completion of settlement in traditional completion phase, based on creating the completion model with BIM and designing the process to the completion of settlement with BIM technology.

articleTitle: The Core Module and Implementation of Intelligent Distance Education Platform
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper, We do some exploration and research in the fifth-generation intelligent distance education platform, and propose the architecture model of the intelligent distance education platform. We also present a complete text paper strategy which is consisted of defining attributes of Questions, the definition of parameters of test paper, and difficulty and discrimination of transformation algorithm. It gives the system model of Intelligent answering system, puts forward the concept of intelligent search engine, and gives the overall structure of intelligent search engine and also designs a personalized intelligent search engine based on the educational resources and environment. In addition, we propose multidimensional tracking model of distance education quality, and implement a distance education quality monitoring and tracking system based on computer supported cooperative work (CSCW).

articleTitle: Comparison on Application of DCS and FCS
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper discusses the performance characteristics of DCS and FCS, and presents a comparison and analysis of system reliability, maintenance requirements, signal transmission way and costs, etc. thinking that FCS with many advantages is the industrial control mainstream and has broad prospects for development. Despite of disadvantages, DCS still has the considerable vitality.

articleTitle: Quantitative Retrieval of Chlorophyll-a Concentration of Taihu Lake Based on Satellite HJ-1Multispectral Data
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With combination of satellite HJ-1 multispectral CCD data and synchronous ground monitoring data on water quality, combining the visible light red band (select the one that has a high correlation with measured chlorophyll-a concentration) and near-infrared band, this paper takes Band4/Band3 as arguments, establishing linear model and multinomial model respectively, furthermore makes a comparative analysis of them. The results show that the band combination method for inversion is feasible, based on the comparison of the two models, it is concluded that polynomial model has better effect. And by using ArcGIS software and polynomial modelmakes chlorophyll-a concentration profile.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of Resistance Strain Sensor Experiment Platform Based on NI-WSN
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to improve the level of experimental teaching of resistance strain sensor in higher vocational college, an experiment platform based on NI-WSN is reconstructed. First, the theory of wireless sensor networks is introduced. Second, the basic principle of resistance strain sensor is introduced. Then, the system structure is introduced. The resistance strain sensors and computer are connected with NI device. So the measured signal is sent to the computer, which can be analyzed and processed the data obtained from the above. It not only provides a convenience for students ' experiment, but also makes implementation of network laboratory into possible. It improves the detection principle practical ability of students greatly, data analysis of experiment is more clear and accurate, save the education cost, and the teaching effect has been greatly improved. It is the reconstruction of the existing experiment equipment in our college. This is what is new in the paper.

articleTitle: Applications of Communication Technology in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Smart grid is the inevitable trend of development of grid technology, and it will lead the development of future grid. The smart grid has become a competing focus area for countries in the promotion of green energy-saving awareness. This paper briefly described the characteristics of the smart grid, and applications of communication technology in the smart grid. With the development of smart grid technology and communication technology, the contact between them will become increasingly close.

articleTitle: The Simulation Research and Modeling on Leveling System of Hydraulic Static Pile Driver Fuselage
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Fast high-precision leveling of Hydraulic Static Pile Driver Fuselage is the key factor for ensuring the construction efficiency and pile quality. To meet job requirements of hydraulic static pile driver, this paper designs a parallel control hydraulic control system based on the PLC large electro-hydraulic valve and the small diameter proportional directional valve, then, Establishes the mathematical model of the hydraulic system and executes simulation analysis, and the system stability conditions is obtained at last.

articleTitle: Study on Damage Diagnosis of Steel Grid Structure after Fire
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The space grid structure is one of styles in largespace buildings. The damage analysis of space grid structure is an important part for repairing and strengthening after fire. A practical engineering was taken as the research object, and the development of members' plastic strain during fire was studied by using ABAQUS. In addition, the paper defines three damage indexes D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, which were calculated based on equivalent plastic strain, displacement and the equivalent displacement separately. Through comparing the analysis results with the evaluation in the field after fire, the results show that D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> is better to judge the damage of structures after fire.

articleTitle: Research on Seismic-Resistance Performance of Frame Structure with High-Strength Concrete Core-Reinforced Columns
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: To study the seismic-resistance performance of high-strength concrete core-reinforced column frame structure, Push-over analysis on a 7-story building example is performed and the capacity curves and performance characteristics of the frame structure under rare earthquake with 9-degree intensity are obtained, and the seismic resistant performance of structure is accessed from vibration period, story drift, the process of failure, and the mechanism of hinge-forming. The results show that the frame structure with high strength concrete core-reinforced columns still has a good seismic resistant performance while reducing the section dimension of columns, as its story drift, the mechanism of hinge-forming meet the requirements of existing codes and specifications.

articleTitle: Research on the Evolution of Maritime Safety Based on the Theory of Self-Organization
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper analysed the maritime safety system based on the self-organization system theory, built the evolution equation of sequential parameter, and proposed that each subsystem in the nonlinear interaction system worked together, The system is promoted to a more stable and more safety level with the synergetic effects. competition and cooperation effect which is generated by the sequential parameters dominates the other fast variables. The purpose of this paper is to discover the pattern of evolution of the maritime safety system, and provides a different theory and methodology to get a more safe and more clean environment of the maritime industry.

articleTitle: Multi-class Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation of Semiconductor Wafer Manufacturing Line Real-Time Production
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A multi-class fuzzy comprehensive evaluation (FCE) was introduced to evaluate the performance of semiconductor wafer manufacturing line real-time production in order to improve the quality of scheduling. Basing on the factory physics and semiconductor production characters an index system of quality of semiconductor wafer manufacturing scheduling was established. According to the system, a model of fuzzy evaluation of wafer production was established. Using the fuzzy evaluation, the evaluation model was given as well.

articleTitle: An Identification Approach for KGEs of Machine Tool
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The definitions of impact factor and key geometric error (KGE) were given and a new method for identifying KGEs was proposed. Taking one machining center as example, the mapping relation model of the machine tool geometric error and comprehensive error was built up with the theory of multi-body system, by calculating and comparing the impact factor, 16 KGEs which affected the accuracy of the machine tool were identified finally. The demonstration shows that geometric error factors which have relatively significant influence on comprehensive spatial error of the machine tools can be identified effectively, thus important theoretical basis is provided for improving accuracy of machine tools reasonably and economically.

articleTitle: Hydrodynamics Simulation on Deflector Program of Super Pump Station for Potable Water Supply
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A computational fluid dynamics (CFD) model is used to assess the effect of pump layout program on flow field in Ditch-V pump station for potable water treatment. The model is based on the CFD code Fluent and exploits several specific aspects of the potable water application to derive a computational tool much more efficient than the corresponding tools employed to simulate booster pump station projects. To research the flow field of deflector program in super pumping station with many restriction factors such as large flow quantity, high pumping lift and three different water supply directions, an incompressible turbulent fluid velocity field model and multi-hydraulic model was established. Then flow field was calculated and analyzed using control volume method. Therefore, the objective of this study was to determine the size of the deflector program in the water supply. The present model is adjusted against data from a real pump station and then it is used to assess the significance of influent structure and diversion variation. It is found that the flow pattern in transition section of symmetric trapezoidal layout program was smooth, and had little water loss. Flow pattern near the bottom in the fore-bay was smoother, while vortex and roll back flow was formed near the front surface of the pool. Some program improvements were made during numerical simulation including increasing the length of canals, changing configuration forms and adding diversion cone. Numerical simulation results indicated that the inlet drift angle below the pump was generally less than 4°. Flow field near the suction pipe was smooth and uniform.

articleTitle: The Conception and Its Application of the Internet of Energy-Saving and Emission-Reduction (IE&E)
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Low-carbon development is a new method of human ecologic civilization and is an important countermeasure to cope with global climate change. With the rapid development of information technology, how to support low-carbon development by information technology is a meaningful subject to study. This paper put forth the conception of internet of energy-saving and emission-reduction (IE&E) and its framework, key technologies. IE&E is new application in the area of energy-saving and emission-reduction based on internet and internet of things. IE&E is a new internet system which has special function and structure compared with internet and internet of things, as it integrates information flow, material flow, energy flow and notion flow. Its purpose is for energy-saving and emission-reduction by information technology, and it will be used for the government decision-making and enterprise' energy-saving and emission-reduction. The framework of IE&E includes perception layer technology, network layer technology, application layer technology and common technology. The key technologies of IE&E are the dynamic monitoring technology and spatial information technology. At the end of this article, countermeasures to promote the development of regional low-carbon with IE&E are set forth.

articleTitle: Increasing Employees' Awareness and Enhancing Motivation in E-Government Security Behavior Management
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Human factors and employee computer usage behavior have been a threat to information security in E-government in China. This paper describes key theories and researches about some factors influencing employees' information security behavior. It also describes how those theories will play an important role in government information security management. Finally, a summary of belief model was developed specifically to understand and predict employee computer usage behaviors.

articleTitle: The Delineation of Prime Farmland Based on the CLUE-S Model
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Based on the analysis of existing prime farmland delineation and the principal of CLUE-S model, the paper will explore a new method of prime farmland delineation. The paper firstly makes use of CLUE-S model to a case study. According to Lin Dong District, the result indicated that on quantity aspect, the difference between simulation and planning value 0.64%.on quality aspect, the part of low quality is slightly decreased, the part of medium quality increased a little, the part of high quality is largely unchanged the overall quality has not declined. The conclusion of the study is that this new method of delineation prime farmland using CLUE-S model is certain scientific and feasible and the method is useful exploration to delineate prime farmland.

articleTitle: Concrete Arch Dam's Foundation Interception Range Analysis
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: There is big difference in the foundation size selection of the concrete arch dam considering the upstream reservoir water load, so the 3-D FEM is constructed with the typical high arch dam in 300 m class in this paper, to analyze the displacement and stress under the condition that foundation depth and left and right banks foundation size are fixed, with the upstream and downstream foundation size changing, and the condition that the foundation depth, left and right banks and upstream and downstream foundation size take the same value and increased correspondingly. Analysis shows that: (1) when the water pressure only loads on the dam, the stress and displacement tend to be stable with the increase of the foundation size. (2) considering the upstream reservoir basin water load, the stress tends to be stable with the foundation size increasing, the displacement tends to be stable with the increase of the upstream and downstream foundation size under the condition of the foundation depth and left and right banks foundation size are fixed, while the displacement can't tend to be stable under the condition of the foundation depth, left and right banks and upstream and downstream foundation size take the same value and increase correspondingly. (3) the actual foundation size is limited, if the foundation depth and left and right banks foundation size are fixed and taking the same value and no more than 40 times of the dam height, the displacement and stress of the dam has been able to meet the engineering precision or achieve stability when the upstream and downstream foundation size select 5 - 10 times of the dam height.

articleTitle: Reinforced Abutment Stress and Deformation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Reinforced flexible structure, suitable for large deformation, in high grade highway bridge and road junction wide application. Most current engineering construction before, and not to the structure stress and deformation prediction effectively, put forward the construction of guidance. In this paper, ANSYS finite element software, the introduction of contact element, through to the plane strain problems and 3 d entity simulation and practical engineering data collection, in view of the abutment force and deformation, reinforced abutment design and construction to provide the guidance.

articleTitle: Association Rule Based-on Niche Genetic Algorithm for Benchmarking Management of Electric Power Company
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Benchmarking management always plays an important role in electric power company, but the application of benchmarking rarely involves data mining. For resolving this issue, an association rule mining model for benchmarking management using niche genetic algorithm is developed. Based on the establishment of benchmarking indicator system, the data are gathered form Jilin Electric Power Company. With niche genetic algorithm, the association rule is optimized to maximize its support degree. Experimental results show that the performance of our approach is more promising than GA and the extracted association rules enable electric power company to find shortfalls and provide reference for the leader decision-making.

articleTitle: A Cloud-Based Signage Network System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper begins with a brief introduction of digital signage and information distribution system, and then proposed a new cloud-based wireless signage network system, and described designing process of the system. Finally, it gave out the future prospects of the application of the system.

articleTitle: Study on Energy-Efficient Retrofit of Public Buildings in Ningbo City
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Due to the high energy consumption of existing public buildings in the hot summer and cold winter zone, it is necessary to implement energy-efficient retrofit of the large-scale public buildings. In this paper, the energy-efficient retrofit measures have been studied based on the bioclimatic characteristics in Ningbo City, which is located in the hot summer and cold winter zone. The development of building energy efficiency as well as the climatic characteristics in the hot summer and cold winter zone have firstly been introduced in this paper. So, the energy consumption of existing public buildings and the dominant factors that influence the energy consumption have been analyzed using climatic characteristics in Ningbo. Finally some energy-efficient retrofit measures have been proposed according to the bio-climate in Ningbo City.

Author Keywords: hot summer and cold winter zone

articleTitle: Energy-Saving Research of Pile Hammer Based on Pressure Feedback
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: For comprehending correlations between moving components of hydraulic pile hammer better, research and analyze its movement rule, model four-sect movement characteristic of pile hammer, introduce dimensionless parameters such as ratio of period to falling acceleration time and ratio of maximum rising speed to maximum falling speed, make simulation of system oil supply at different movement parameters, define realizable the minimum oil supply via comparison and analysis, provide energy efficiency research of pile hammer with theoretical foundation.

articleTitle: Research on the Early-Warning for Construction Project Cost Risk
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The operation of construction project is a system engineering with dynamic characteristics, its completion usually affected by great uncertainty and risk, especially the cost risk. This paper aims to conduct theoretical and empiric analysis on the construction project cost risk issues caused by uncertainties and mismanagement, establish early-warning system of construction project cost risk, set up mathematical model to get early-warning indicators so as to estimate the risk level accurately and take measures in time to control the cost risk, and ensure the smooth implementation and completion of the construction project.

articleTitle: Research on the Low Power Design Method for the Embedded Multi-core Processor
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: MIPS, MIPS/W, MIPS/□, as processors' performance parameters, are determined by integrated circuits' process parameters such as working voltage V, working frequency f, chip area S and so on. Based on the research of multi-core processors, under certain IC process technology, with the constraints of power consumption P, chip area S, working frequency f, and with the setting that the tasks' parallel degree is 1, the function between the response time T and the number of cores N is deduced, and a design method for reducing the embedded multi-core processors' power consumption through multi-core architecture is proposed. Considering the difficulties in IC process technology's development, the significance of this method will be emphasized.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis on Performance of Diffuser Aim at Entrance Bucket at Different Installation Site
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Aiming at entrance bucket at different installation site, inner flow field of diffuser was simulated and analyzed, get graphs of static pressure coefficient (Cp), atmospheric pressure coefficient (Cpa) and efficiency (n). Though analysis and get rule of performance of diffuser aim at entrance bucket at different installation site, the rule provides theoretical foundation on design of fanner diffuser.

articleTitle: The Study of the Far Field Test System Based on Scanning Method
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The far field reflects the LD beam intensity distribution on the space geometry. This article mainly aims at the disadvantage of high cost which exist in the traditional LD far field test, the scanning method is found with 51 microcomputer, the 51 microcomputer controls level and vertical motors driving laser and photoelectric detector, laser rotate some angle, photoelectric detector and scan 180°, and combined with MATLAB software, the 3D light intensity distribution of LD will be drawn, so as to complete the far field test of LD, Comparison between test results with scanning method and the CCD testing method on the far field, the results are basically identical.

articleTitle: An RTM Based Distributed Simulation System for Guide Robot
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A distributed simulation system was developed in this paper to enhance the robot system integration and development for guide robot via using RTM (Robot Technology Middleware) technology, which is an open software platform for robot systems. The RT (robot technology) system of an adapter, a controller and the robot, together with other CORBA objects was developed to connect the graphical programming interface with the 3D simulator to set up a network based simulation system. Simultaneously, the application of the distributed simulation system also confirms the controlling of the real robot utilizing the RT system. RT-Middleware can obviously accelerate the software component development and the system integration, which of course will lower the cost of the development of new robot application systems.

articleTitle: Influence of Color Perception on Computer Identifying Images
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Color affects people's visual feelings and emotions in life. Color gives people a strong and direct feeling and leaves a deep impression easily. This thesis studies the relationship between color recognition and color visual perception, and deeply researches visual intuitive feelings when users indentify computer color information, and provides significant clues for the users. This thesis analyzes physiological characteristics of color vision, physiological mechanism of color vision, sensitivity source of color perception, insensitivity source of color contrast, researches the stimulation of color to users' physics and psychology as well as the complex psychological reaction and explores right color perception from visual physiology and psychology, summarize design law of computer digital color so that users can quickly and correctly understand and identify the color information.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of PC/104-Compatible Interface and Traffic Store Hardware in a Class 4MVB Controller
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper introduces the design and implementation of essential modules in a class 4 Multifunctional Vehicle Bus (MVB) controller. The MVB controller is responsible for polling and storing the information collected by up to 4096 different sensors deployed in a carriage of high-speed trains. Working under strict real-time constraints, the MVB network controller consists of both firmware running on FPGA and software executed on an ARM processor. The operation of the card is under hostile electromagnetic environments. This paper consists of firmware design of the interface module to the industrial computer, command processing unit module and memory controller module. The designed modules offer full support for dynamic configuration, which significantly lower the complexity of system management. In addition to completely meeting the real-time and functional requirements specified by IEC61375, the circuits are carefully designed to support fault tolerance and fast recovery. The network controller has passed the protocol conformance test and 15-day fault-free field test on the sub-way trains.

articleTitle: Cooperation Game in the Management of Cross-Border river Water Resources -- Nu River -- Sal Wenjiang as an Example
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The reason for issue in the management of crossborder river Water Resources, which In the final analysis is distribution of benefits and costs in the management of the Water Resources. When the distribution of benefits and costsharing is not balanced, The various basins countries will adopt a different strategy starting from their own interests, then water resource management cooperation will not be able to carry out. We took Nu River -- salWenjiang for an example, and analyzed distribution of economic benefits and environmental cost allocation, then pointed out that the constraints of water resources management cooperation, finally built a cooperative game model.

articleTitle: Damping Analysis on High-Rise Concrete Frame Structure with Viscous Damping Walls
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Through the study of viscous damping wall at home and abroad, and the main contents of this paper, the calculation formula and the mechanical model, so as to lay a good foundation for calculation and analysis. Secondly, the analysis to determine the model structure, the structure of the modal analysis in without control, period, frequency and vibration modes of the structure determined. Finally, in order to study the viscous damping wall in high-rise reinforced concrete frame structure vibration control, In this paper on the basis of modal analysis, setting viscous damping walls in the corresponding location, using the method of FNA in the software of Sap2000, carries on the analysis on the vibration of structure under different conditions, through the comparative analysis, this paper obtains: the viscous damping wall has significant damping to the structure, and the damping effect increases with the number of viscous damping wall, Additional damping force of viscous damping wall increases with the increase of earthquake acceleration, through comparative analysis of different working conditions, the additional damping wall centralized configuration in the below of the structure, can achieve more damping effect.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Small Wind Generator Fast Charging Controller
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper describes a small wind generator controlled by a MCU to charge the battery, the charger is suitable for power below 500w generator equipment, it has a simple and reliable structure, fast charging, prolong battery life characteristics.

articleTitle: Study on Heavy Metals Pollution in Lanping Jinding Lead-Zinc Mine
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: To survey of heavy metals pollution in Lanping Jinding lead-zinc mine, based on pollution features of different areas, the contaminated soil area was divided into four zones which were polluted by tailings, mine drainage, settling dust in wind and spreading minerals during vehicle transportation respectively. Meanwhile, the model of soil environmental geochemical baseline was constructed by applying a normalization procedure. Depending upon it this article assessed the health risk of heavy metals pollution in Lanping Jinding lead-zinc mine. The assessment results show there is minimal Hg or As or Cu pollution and major Zn or Pb pollution in Lanping Jinding lead-zinc mine. The research shows the mining activities will inevitably bring heavy metals pollution which mostly is part of mined metals, there is highly health risk in Lanping Jinding lead-zinc mine environment.

articleTitle: Equipment Performance Requirements of the Multi-Functional Roof-Bolter, Present Situation and Development Trend
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Roof-bolter is a very important drilling equipment in anchor bolt support engineering construction, which affects the quality and speed in supporting engineering seriously. The different support engineering should choose different models of roof-bolter. Domestic roof-bolters are split-type, torque small, body bulky, inconvenient mostly, and foreign roof-bolters are advanced functionality and performance, but expensive. This paper deals with the geotechnical anchorage engineering application characteristics and requirements of drilling equipment, the roof-bolter research status, multifunction roof-bolter technical condition and its development trend, analyzes the gap between domestic roof-bolter with foreign roof-bolter. It is of great significance to develop new multifunctional roof-bolter in China.

articleTitle: Research on Water-Related Issues in Urban Road System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The urban road system is not only one of the most important urban infrastructures but also the important composition of urban ecological system. The road systems in many cities are suffering from various water-related problems, such as road water logging, increased drainage load resulted from concentrated runoff, waste of rainwater resource due to failure replenishing of the surface runoff to the groundwater system during the rainstorm period. The road waterlogging would affect its traffic function, even result in temporary regional traffic gridlock, and impair the quality and service life of the road works. The road surface runoff could contaminate the surrounding water environment, and under disturbance of vehicle wheels the dust accumulated on the road would pollute urban air when drying up. The analysis showed that the water-related problems are mainly resulted from manmade factors such as low design standard of road drainage system, poor environmental protection facilities for rainwater storage and infiltration, high-raised green belt, and the weaknesses of road building technology. Countermeasures were proposed, such as raising road drainage standard, innovating and popularizing road building materials and technology, and lowering the elevation of the green belts. Case study showed that the application of the pervious asphalt concrete as paving material and the adoption of lowering green belts, could significantly ease the street water logging, reduce the runoff pollution and urban drainage load, and improve the rain resources utilization.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis and Calculation on the Heat-Bend Moulding Typical Value of the Thin Cut Closed Ring
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The 3D solid model of the thin cut closed ring is established, and the meshing procedure of the thin cut closed ring is analyzed with the software ANSYS. The meshing forces and stresses and the x direction displacements and y direction displacements are calculated, and the radial displacements are calculated through matrix operations, too. Corrected model of the thin cut closed ring is established. The radial displacements along the thin cut closed ring are recalculated, then the 3D solid model of the thin cut closed ring is remodified. The heat-bend moulding typical values with error less than 0.03mm are obtained after two approximation calculations. It plays a guiding role in precise design and manufacture of the thin cut closed ring.

articleTitle: The Survey and Study on Pedestrian Evacuation in Beijing Underpass of Subway-Mall
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Nowadays, there are 14 subway lines have been put into operation in Beijing. Some underpasses of the subway station can lead straight to malls. In consideration of the underpasses of subway-mall usually have high pedestrian volume and are in different business situation, there will be certain hidden troubles in fire control. As the research object in this paper, to obtain the basic parameters of pedestrian characteristics, large-scale investigation of pedestrian features had been carried in four different and typical underpasses of the subway station. By the results of statistical analysis, the models of safety evacuation of the four different underpasses are established by using emergency evacuation simulation software STEPS (Simulation of Transient Evacuation and Pedestrian Movements) and the safety evacuation time in fire scenario have been obtained. As an actual example of pedestrian safety evacuation analysis for the underpass of subway-mall, the scientific bases for pre-plan evaluation and performance-based fire protection design are provided in the paper.

articleTitle: Innovative Ideas Study on Low-Carbon Urban Planning under Global Climate Change
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Cities are the main sources of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions and other greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, and low-carbon urban planning can provide effective and essential methods to control them during the construction and operation process of cities. The aim of this paper is to explore innovative ideas of low-carbon urban planning in our country and to examine the scenarios toward the realization of sustainable cities. This paper discusses the theories and practices of low-carbon urban planning. Finally, future development direction in China is been proposed.

articleTitle: The Design of Client Software for Self-Contained Turbulence Observation Instrument
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Aiming at the communication between the turbulence observation instrument and PC, the client software is designed for the turbulence observation instrument by using Matlab and VC++ hybrid programming method, in order to provide a solution to the problems for the high sampling frequency, the large amount of data, complex data processing of marine turbulence observation. Under the Windows operating system, VC++ is adopted to complete framework customization and interface development, Matlab is used to complete large amount of turbulence original signal extraction and splicing with its powerful matrix calculation and data manipulation and numerical analysis function, and Matlab is also used to calculate the result of turbulent kinetic energy dissipation rate. Testing and sea trial results show that the software is reliable, easy to operate, suitable for self-contained turbulence observation instrument.

articleTitle: Intercity Rail Transit Pricing Method to Optimizing Comprehensive Transportation Travel Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this work, we propose and study a Multi-target model of the methods of intercity rail transit pricing. The model studied in multi-path and multi-mode aims at both high efficiency of travel time and energy consumption. And the operating profit of rail operation organization is considered as the pricing constraints. Finally, we study some economic circle of China as a case. The calculation results demonstrate that the variations of ticket price have significant influence of traffic structure. The result indicates that the system travel time decreasing with the intercity rail transit fare down as well as the system energy consumption. When adjust the intercity rail transit fare to 55.8yuan, in contrast with the initial fare, the system travel time and energy consumption respectively decrease 7.8%and 2.1%.

articleTitle: The Detecting System of Powder Chamber Volume with Artillery Stowage Software Realization
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The detection system of Powder chamber volume with artillery in the paper of data acquisition, storage, processing and software design, in full consideration of the whole test system after the possible problems in the process of detection, the MCS - 51 MCU assembly language programming and modular structure design method achieve the powder chamber volume detecting system of software design.

articleTitle: Design and Application of CAD-CAM Data Interface in Electronic Assembly Production
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: For the wide application of CAD software in current electronic industry, the paper puts forward an idea of designing a kind of data interface between CAD and CAM systems, in order to achieve data sharing and data integration for various equipments in electronic assembly production. Taking component mounting/insertion machines as target equipments, this paper analyzes the data set to be processed by this data interface. Then we describe structure and format of data in a PCB source file generated by Protel, one commonly used CAD software, and discuss how to use the data interface to implement extraction and conversion of production data from a source file. The practical application proves that this data interface can greatly enhance the efficiency of the electronic assembly production.

articleTitle: Research of Internal-Combustion Engine with Timely Adjustable Displacement
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The maximum power of the internal combustion engine of traditional vehicles was designed to meet the requirements of running at the limit load. When then design was determined, the car's displacement could no longer be adjusted. However, the limit load was not often. That's means the internal combustion engine's maximum power had a great surplus. Therefore, at most of its time, the internal combustion engine was forced to work in low-speed, low-load condition, which was very detrimental to energy conservation. In this paper, a new type of internal combustion engine was designed innovatively based on its traditional structure. This new type of internal combustion engine could timely adjust its displacement according to its actual load, which fundamentally eliminated its performance defects of high fuel consumption and serious pollution in the low-load condition.

articleTitle: A New Powertrain of Two Speeds for Pure Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A power train with two speed gears was developed for driving pure electric vehicles. This new pure electric power train mainly includes one electric motor, a planetary gear set, a fork and sleeve mechanism and the main differential, which are formed in one integration mechanism. The fork and sleeve mechanism was added to this integration power train system for providing three different operation positions according practical conditions, its three operation positions are corresponding to three operation modes, which are high speed position, low speed position and neutral position. With this new mechanism, the power train system can reduce electric volume and increase driving torque, which can benefit vehicle layout with high energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on Longitudinal Gradient at Mountain Highways Based on Driver's Physiological Reactions
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper studies the relationships of various vertical grades at longer slope mountainous terrain highways on the driver's heart rate. This paper analyzes the vertical grade effects by measuring the driver's heart rate and the vehicle speed using the auto-recording heart rate instrument and motive GPS respectively. The research results suggest that the profile grade at the long slope alignment should not be more than 5% for mountain highways and signing improvements, which may reduce accidents in such terrains.

articleTitle: Research Progress on Coupling Beams
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Coupling beam, as an important force bearing member of connecting the wall limbs, is paid much attention to in research. Based on the research results about it at home and abroad, the types of coupling beams are summarized, including different reinforcement arrangement coupling beams, steel coupling beam and composite coupling beams, and the characteristics of them are also analyzed. Finally, the research need to be done is prospected.

articleTitle: The Temporal Transferability of Parameters of Reservoir Long-Term Optimal Operation Models Based on BP ANN
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Initial parameters are the main influence factors of training time in a specific artificial neural network (ANN) model of which the structure has been determined. Under the background of long-term reservoir operation of The Three Gorges, Back Propagation (BP) ANN models were built to obtain optimal operation rules. Simulation experiments were carried out to compare the difference of training times between two schemes of initial parameters calibration, which are randomizing generation and transferring parameters calibrated from previous training under similar situation. Using feasible degree and efficiency improving degree to evaluate the temporal transferability of parameters when the new training samples were added with time continuously. Based on the outputs of flood season, dry season and a whole year, the results show that in a certain time span, the temporal transfer of parameters is feasible and the efficiency is improved significantly, seasonal differences are shown in results, the performance of transferability tends to be weaken down with time.

articleTitle: Introduction of a Supercritical Kerosene Test Bench Based on One-Stage Electric Heater with Large Current
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A kind of supercritical kerosene heat transfer test bench was introduced in this article. It uses large current to heat the stainless steel tube directly and then the kerosene flowing inside the tube can be heated. A kind of needle valve is used to adjust the kerosene mass flow rate and a kind of backpressure valve is used to adjust the pressure inside the test tube. Insulating materials are laid at the two sides of the tube to prevent electrical leakage. Heat flux is calculated by measurements of the voltage and current. Kerosene is rapidly heated to high temperatures while the wall temperature is below the safety limit by increasing the tube length and thickness. The electric heater could effectively simulate the heat flux of a scramjet engine chamber with a maximum power of about 28KW. Kerosene within 15g/s could be quickly heated to 1000K with this system.

articleTitle: The Development of Transient Throttle Controller Based on MotoTron Development Platform
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The rapid prototyping development technology for the transient throttle controller based on the Motohawk development platform was introduced. The mathematical model was set up for the transient throttle controller. Based on it, a PID control algorithm was proposed and verified in MATLAB/SIMULINK. A rapid prototyping development platform was built up using MotoTron technology. The precise control was realized by the calibration test based on strategy transplant and download. The transient conditions established was produced in the end.

articleTitle: Design and Impementation of Real Estate Information Management System Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper studies how effectively apply the Geographic Information System (GIS) to the Chinese city property management, in order to research and develop the real estate management information system and help government conduct management. Based on ArcGIS9.3 systems and databases lightweight embedded workflow engine, applying multi-layered architecture mixed of B/S and C/S, unifies housing business data, property GIS data, property mapping data, file scanned images and other data on the same database platform, which is capable of conducting a number of urban housing management including GIS information housing property, transactions and maintenance. The system has been tested in Xi'an, China with good effect.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of QoS Routing Protocol for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this work, we consider the problem of providing QoS routing in wireless sensor network. Due to the dynamic nature of wireless network, it's a challenging issue to implement QoS routing in multi-hop network. We make following major contributions in this paper. First, we propose and implement a QoS providing framework based on DiffServ model. Second, we implement bandwidth and ETX measurement module in backbone of wireless sensor network. Third, we design and implement a bandwidth-constrained shortest routing calculation algorithm. Fourth, we implement the QoS routing protocol in our test bed and a lot of test work has been done to test the performance of the protocol.

articleTitle: Revising Shunde: The Different Technical Approaches to the Future of a Large Chinese City
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The paper talks about a research on a fast growing Chinese city. It reviews the international urban planning competition for the new urban area in Shunde, and compares the different technical approaches to look at the future development of a post-industrial city. To compare them with a study on the current local urban issues, and to find out the philosophies behind the morphologies, is the main purpose of the paper.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on Application of Nano-Concrete to Reduce Roughness Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to research on the application of nano-concrete to reduce roughness coefficient, and considering that roughness coefficient and calculating it are fundamental issues in hydraulic engineering. Also, analyzing the correct evaluation of flow rate and interaction with other hydraulic parameters such as velocity, shape and type of section, and flow pattern, is one of the most important problems in fluid mechanics, and considering that the possibility of minimizing roughness on designing of hydraulic structures and irrigation networks in order to increase velocity and then the flow rate at different sections, are subjects which have been noted by researches and industrial entrepreneurs since years ago. the author of the article had done a series of experiments, the effects of using silicate nano-particles in the floor coating of the channels have been studied in a hydraulic laboratory flume. Through this experimental research, we could had known that adding Nano-Silicate to the concrete mixture will cause the active SiO2 to mix with the free calcium hydroxide available in the micro holes of the concrete and produce unsolved calcium silicate, and eventually cause the structure of the cement to become more dense and become less penetrable causing the concrete to be more resistant. By using this product, we can produce smooth and homogenous surfaces in the upper surface that can increase the flow rate and velocity of fluid in channels, clarifiers and crests of dams.

articleTitle: Study on the Cost Management of Project Items in the Whole Process
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This thesis will do comprehensive analysis on the factors that affect the construction cost in the phases of decision, design, bid, construction and completion and final account. It has pointed out the main problems existing in the cost management of all the phases, and discussed the problems, then brought out the corrective measures.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Criteria Correlation of Heat Convection between Air and Wires in Icing Conditions
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: By analyzing the heat balance equation of the heated wires, the theoretical formula of heat transfer coefficient including critical anti-icing current was obtained. The convection heat transfer was calculated through experimental study in the icing environmental condition. The criteria correlation of the Nusselt (Nu) and Reynolds (Re) numbers under the certain environment temperature with different wind speeds was established. A comparison between the experimental and calculation results from the correlation criterion shows they were in reasonable agreement with maximum error below 5%, and also the correlation criterion is compared with certain empirical correlations found in the literature.

articleTitle: Retaining Structures with Double-Row Piles used in Super Soft Soil Foundation Pit
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Foundation pit in Nansha Region, Guangzhou was adopted to introduce the control factors in super soft soil when using retaining structures with double-row piles. The design and construction plan of double-row piles used in super soft soil were introduced.
