The actual construction effect indicate the retaining structures with double-row piles is feasible in super soft soil, and improvement of foundation pit using mixing pile is necessary for soft soil region.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulations on a Transonic Axial-Flow Compressor Rotor Under Clean and Distorted Inflows
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The effects of circumferential distortions in inlet total pressure on the flow field in a low-aspect-ratio, high-speed, high-pressure-ratio, transonic compressor rotor are investigated in this paper. The flow field was studied numerically with and without inlet total pressure distortion. 3-D steady, unsteady numerical simulations have been conducted to determine the effects of circumferential total pressure inlet distortion on a transonic axial-flow compressor rotor. Overall performance (total pressure ratio, adiabatic efficiency and stable operating range) within inlet distortion has been investigated and compared with the results with clean inlet flow: dropped in mass flow, adiabatic efficiency, and decreased in surge margin. Detail analyses of the flow field in the rotor show: Circumferential flow appears at the border of the distorted region, and flows inside to the distorted region. When entering the distortion, the blade passage faces a positive pre-swirl, on the countary, when leavinging the distortion, the blade passage faces a negative pre-swirl, which increases its incidence angle and loading.

articleTitle: The Whole Process Analyses of the Concrete Cover Corrosion Cracking Based on Virtual Crack Model
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Based on virtual crack model and the following hypothesis: (1)supposing that there are two symmetrical radial initial cracks at concrete and steel interface position, (2)considering that the corrosion crack starts to extend when the difference of crack tip stress intensity factors caused by rust expansion force and cohesive force reaches concrete fracture toughness, the concrete cover corrosion cracking process was simulated with the finite element method, the full curve of concrete cover rust expansion force and crack propagation process was calculated at the same time. The conclusions drawn can provide reference for the durability design of RC structures.

articleTitle: On Methods to Calculate Average Tidal Current Velocity
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In coastal, estuarine and bay waters, tidal current is the basic sea water movement and one of main hydrodynamic factors. Affected by bottom topography, coastline and islands, the tidal current assumes itself to-and-fro movement, that is, the flood current and ebb current are basically in the opposite direction, with difference of about 180°. One of the important indexes to depict to-and-fro tidal current force is tidal average current velocity during flood tide or ebb tide. Integrating measured tidal current process in practical sea area, this paper carries out studies and comparisons on three methods to calculate tidal average current velocity during flood tide or ebb tide and three methods to calculate tidal average current velocity in a complete tidal cycle. The study show that there exist differences in the results from different methods. It is suggested that tidal average current velocity during flood tide or ebb tide be calculated by integral average method and tidal average current velocity in a complete tidal cycle by weighting average method.

Author Keywords: average tidal current velocity during flood tide or ebb tide

articleTitle: Tidal Current and Sediment Numerical Modeling of Flow Cutoff in the South Branch of the Oujiang Estuary
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A numerical model of tidal current and sediment movement under the combined action of wave and current are set up with irregular triangular grid. The model is verified with in situ data, and the results show that the calculated water elevations at 19 stations, currents, suspended sediment at 19 vertical lines and seabed evolution are all in good agreement with measured data. This numerical model is applied in the tidal current and sediment movement simulations in stopping flow transport through the South Branch of the Oujiang Estuary and the feasibility to cut off the flow in the South Branch of the Oujiang Estuary is demonstrated by numerical simulation experiments. The results show that flow cutoff in the South Branch by heightening the present submerged dyke is technically feasible as far as its impact on hydrodynamic sediment environment is concerned.

articleTitle: Analysis of Joints Made up of Steel Beam and Rectangular Concrete Filled Steel Tube Column
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With the widely application of concrete filled steel tube (CFST) in buildings, how to make the CFST and steel beam connected reasonable becomes one of the key problems in research. According to the relevant research results at home and abroad, the types and the characteristics of each type of joins made up of rectangular CFST and steel beam are introduced, including inner diaphragm joint, outer diaphragm joint, Outer rib plate joint and so on. Finally, the key problems need to be further studied are promoted.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Water Environmental Safety Situation in Kunming during the Last Decade (2001 -- 2011)
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Evaluation model and evaluation methodology of comprehensive index about water environmental safety are adopted to evaluate the water environmental safety situation in Kunming between 2001 and 2011. The evaluation results show that: from individual evaluation results, we could conclude that problems in ecological safety, water quality safety and water quantity safety begin to emerge in Kunming, from comprehensive evaluation, the comprehensive index of water environment safety in Kunming declines year by year, which indicate the water environmental safety situation in Kunming is not optimistic. How to solve water environmental problem becomes one of the important issues in sustainable development of Kunming.

articleTitle: Investigation on Separation Interference of Typical Multi-Body Vehicle in Supersonic Conditions
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A set of quasi CAV model composed of a carrier model and a internal store model was designed consulting opening documents, and it was used to study the multi-body interference during separating by grid force measurement at supersonic in 0.6m×0.6m transonic wind tunnel. The results show that the aerodynamic characteristics of the loading model would change dramatically during the separation. Two factors induced this dramatic change of its aerodynamic characteristics. The first comes from the unbalance development of wake flow and the head shock wave during the loading model moving from the wake flow region to free stream flow region. And the second comes from the huge change of interference region induced by the asymmetric base.

articleTitle: Design and Practice of QD2702 Drive Cover Horizontal Three Surface Combination Drilling
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: On the analysis of process diagram, this paper introduces the design of QD2702 starter drive cover horizontal three surface combination drilling machine and points out design method and design process of the general modular machine. In practice, the application of this kind of combination machine makes the production greatly meeting the market demands. Adopted way of combining in general parts and special parts makes the design process quickly. In that way, it not saves the cost and time, but ensures the process quality of the workpiece.

articleTitle: Research on FDI Impact on Economic Growth of Hebei Province Since Joining the WTO
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The purpose of this paper is empirically study the foreign direct investment (FDI) and the economy continued to grow the relationship between, that not only the current period has a positive effect of FDI on economic growth, but also the successive phases of FDI on economic growth have different positive effects. This article is established considering the lag time series regression analysis model, and an empirical analysis of 2001-2011 data of Hebei Province.

articleTitle: A Quasi-Real-Time Approach to Investigate the Damage and Fracture Process of Concrete Using X-ray Tomography
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In most concrete CT experiment, the detail information of damage and fracture process is achieved by non-real-time approach, and CT method is always regarded as a qualitative method. In our study, a quasi-real-time method is invented using our experiment instruments. Based on the experiment result, the average CT number is used to analyze the damage and fracture process of concrete specimen, and the theory of damage and fracture process is improved. The different characteristic of fracture form of different loading state is investigated both on the macro and micro aspect. This study provides a convenient and fast method to analysis the concrete qualitatively and quantitatively in the engineering practice.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Combustion Regular Gasoline Engine Acceleration Transient Conditions
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Testing on the the AJR-type gasoline Santana 2000 sedan, processed and analyzed experimental data obtained from two acceleration transient operating conditions that one is increasing speed and constant torque, another is constant speed and increase the torque. Compared with the corresponding steady-state conditions, summed up the burning regulation of the gasoline engine at the transient operating conditions: The mean indicated pressure and the maximum combustion pressure is greater than the corresponding steadystate conditions under the two acceleration transient operating conditions. The mean indicated pressure and maximum combustion pressure fluctuations with increasing engine speed, under the increasing speed and constant torque condition, decreased after increasing, its maximum value was in the intermediate stage of the acceleration process. Increased torque and constant speed conditions the mean indicated pressure and the maximum combustion pressure increases gradually with increasing torque constant speed, its maximum at the maximum torque.

articleTitle: Study on the Gearbox's Time-Variation Dynamics Model in Angular Domain
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Aiming at the relation of gearbox's parameters and rotating angle, this paper puts forward the gearbox's dynamics Model in Angular Domain, and the parameter conversion from time Domain to Angular Domain can be achieved, by this means, Unsteady-State in time Domain will convert into Steady State in Angular Domain, it will play an important role in analyzing gearbox's Unsteady-State characteristics.

articleTitle: Extension Comprehensive Evaluation on Modular Design Schemes
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The evaluation of modular design schemes is an essential part of modular design process in order to decide which scheme will be the ideal one. The existed evaluation methods were not suitable for evaluating the attributes which the ideal value is a section. The comprehensive evaluation method based on the extension theory was presented, and the correlation function and the normative correlation degree were defined to calculate the distance between a point and a section. Moreover the evaluating system was established and the evaluating process was described. This method greatly improved the evaluation veracity and reliability. In the end, the approach is illustrated with a missile example concerning the selection of the aim design scheme.

articleTitle: Study on the Thermal-Humidity Reliability of High Power LED Module
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: LED lighting becomes the forth generation green lighting. However, in terms of LED development and large-scale application, the reliability of LED has become one of the technical bottlenecks. This paper carried out the research on the thermal-humidity reliability of high power LED module by the means of experiment and simulation, which mainly aims at the reliability problems existed in high power LED products. Thermal-humidity experiments which takes high power LED module with 10W as the experimental sample and simulation analysis based on FEM (Finite Element Method) software ANSYS are carried out. The results show that, high temperature is the main factor which affects the thermal-humidity reliability of high power LED module.

articleTitle: On Ant Colony Algorithm Preferance in Planning Rural Distance Education Sites
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The rational distribution of rural distance education sites related to smooth developmemt of rural distance education which had greater significance to eventual realization of the optimal allocation of state educational resources. First the article analyses the preferences of ant colony algorithm in rural distance education sites designment. Then by using improved ant colony algorithm, it uses the methods such as adjusting weighting factor and updating residence time to optimize the layout of rural distance education sites comparedly and it consideres significantly distance education requirement of areas which cultural foundation is relatively weak in optimized processes. After practice, the result demonstrates that using improved ant colony algorithm to optimize the layout of rural distance education sites can obtain the optimal solution or near optimal solution of planning problems effectively and quickly which has certain reference value to planning and designing rural distance education sites.

articleTitle: Theory Varification of Introducing Renewable Energy into Energy-Deficient Rural Area -- Take Qira Country as Example
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This research presents the technology to introduce renewable energy into the local power system of rural area in Qira County, Hotan Prefecture, Xinjiang, China. Purpose of this research is to reduce dependent degree of local residents on conventional energy. The simulations are managed by System Simulation Device and Mat-Simulink, the introducible limitation of four renewable energy are considered by voltage fluctuating margin and actual situation of local power system. Based on this research, local hybrid power system may be established. The result of this research shows that renewable energy may cover 36% electrical load of Qira County, which implies big energy and environmental efficiency, it is expected to introduce the results from this research to other areas and countries in southern Xinjiang.

articleTitle: Optimization Research on the Combined Dies to the Production of the Forming Auto Frame
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to form process of different kinds of the auto frame on one die. The combined die structure were introduced. The problem of producted variety of the auto frame and large investment to manufacture die were solved. It is possible to form frame of different type quickly. The problem of the auto frame were low yearly yield and couldn't be produced by handwork were solved well. It was a way that spent less money in manufacturing a die. The die was designed and manufactured for small batch produced. It had a good reference function. A die is used to produce auto frames. It works well and we can use it conveniently. The auto frames of different type are produced quickly and the product quality is well.

articleTitle: Tracking and Position Study for Unmanned Semi-Submersible Vessel Based on Stereo Vision
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Tracking and position technology in unmanned semi-submersible vessel recycle is very important. Based on the current semi-submersible vessel technology and stereo vision measurement technology, Simulation experiment platform of the semi-submersible vessel is established, Through the stereo camera subsystem, the mark balls on the mast of semi-submersible vessel are tracked and photographed. After image processing, three-dimensional coordinates of the mark balls are calculated. According to the topology logical relationships of those mark balls, a novel algorithm of mark balls matching is proposed, then the Semi-submersible vessel coordinate is founded, and the rigid body transformation between it and the mother ship is calculated. Experiment result shown that the proposed method is effective and robust.

articleTitle: Analysis on Seismic Property of Steel Frame
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The finite element analysis on single plate steel frame on the different seismic waves, earthquake acceleration are conducted. The results showed that the vertex displacement and base shear increase with the earthquake acceleration increasing on the same seismic wave, hysteretic behavior of Steel frame is very good. Steel frame has a good seismic property.

articleTitle: The Influence of Microblogging on the Innovation of Social Management
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Microblogging, as a new network media, is playing a positive role on guiding public opinion and on dominating utterance. It offers a new type of tool for social management, such as 'Government Affairs Microblogs' and 'Supervision of Government Microblogs'. Meanwhile, it brought some practical social problems. Overall, the positive role that microblogging could play is very important to a benign development and innovation of the social management.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Hybrid Excavator Loading System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A hybrid excavator loading system has been built by analyzing the typical working condition of 7-tons hybrid hydraulic excavator. This hydraulic loading system can simulate volatility load successfully and its maximum loading power can be more than 40KW. Then set up the hydraulic loading system by AMESim. On this basis, simulate the typical working condition and maximum loading power condition. The results show that this system can meet the design requirements and achieve good simulation of hydraulic excavator's load.

articleTitle: Sediment Problem Related to the Expansion Project of Tianwan Nuclear Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The sediment problem related to the expansion project of Tianwan Nuclear Power Plant was studied. Firstly, the hydrology and sediment environments in the ocean area near the project are analyzed. Secondly, the equations and difference method of mathematical model are introduced. Thirdly, based on the observed data in 2010, two-dimensional model of wave, tidal current and sediment transport is used to study the tidal field and Terrain erosion and deposion field. The results show that, it is feasible to implement the expansion from the view of tidal current and sediment.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Integrated Manufacturing System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: CIM makes a great change with information integration in the operation process of manufacturing enterprise. The composition and functions of CIMS are elaborated at first, then data mining technology and database technology and product data management technology of computer information integration are analysed, development trends of the CIMS are prospected finally.

articleTitle: Management Essentials for Urgent Repair of Highway after Disaster -- Taking a Tunnel of a Highway as an Example
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In recent years, various disasters have taken place frequently, and then highway blocking has happened from time to time. In order to be open to traffic as soon as possible, the project management should take the corresponding measures not consistent with the normal construction. This paper mainly studied the project management of urgent repair of highway after disaster(This paper uses "this kind of project"), analyzed the characteristics of urgent repair of highway after disaster, main tasks of project management, and proposed the measures to improve the ability and level of project management of this kind of project based on the actual situations and project management experience, so as to perfect the this kind of project and create greater benefits for people.

articleTitle: A Self-Adaptive and Energy Efficient Routing Approach for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper proposes a self-adaptive and energy efficient routing approach for a wireless sensor network. In our approach, every sensor node maintains a table of neighbor nodes' attributes, including energy left, least hop count toward sink node and current state, a sensor node chooses neighbor nodes as data relay nodes according to energy left, hop count and failure rate factors, and a sensor node sleeps when idle for saving energy. In order to guarantee the QoS of the whole network, acknowledgement and retry mechanism are used to make sure data is sent successfully. Furthermore, a sink node collects and evaluates failure rate of the network regularly to support slow mobility. When the failure rate is above the threshold that is determined by different application situation, the network topology will be rebuilt. The simulation experiment shows that our adaptive algorithm is scalable and efficient.

articleTitle: A Web-Based Hybrid System for Evaluating Marketing and e-Commerce Web Site Performance
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In the globalised markets with changing customer demands, linking manufacturing or production with sound marketing strategies and effective marketing performance management becomes increasingly important. In this paper, a Web-based hybrid system, WebMarP (created by the authors), for evaluating marketing and e-commerce Web site performance is introduced. The proposed novel approach integrates the strengths of the analytic hierarchy process, Web-based expert system, online fuzzy rules and graphical displays. The software system architecture is outlined with input and output screen samples illustrated. Initial evaluation work is also reported with evaluation findings briefly presented.

articleTitle: Feasibility Analysis of Gob-Side Entry Retaining in Steep Coal Seam
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: It's one of the key factors of utilizing the technology of gob-side entry retaining in steep coal seam that safely and effectively prevent caving rock blocks from rushing into the gob-side entry by sliding downwards along levels. Considering steep coal seam, mining process in fully-mechanize face is numerically simulated, the stress and deformation process of roof strata is analyzed, the difficulty of utilizing the technology is considered, which all are combined with practice in steep working face in Lvshuidong Mine. The feasibility analysis of utilizing the technology of gob-side entry retaining in steep coal seam is obtained.

articleTitle: Study on Updating Method of DEM Based on Large-Scale Topographic Map
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Our institude has a digital elevation model that is based on 2008 of ADS40 aerial photography production. DEM is already too old, in the nearly two years of actual use of this data. It have been found that the data is obviously not in line with the actual situation of the elevation. These problems generate direct result that DEM data is difficult to apply in areas which require the application of the three - dimensional GIS data such as urban planning, mobile base station location. So we must generate new updating procedures of Large - scale topographic maps and digital elevation model(DEM).

articleTitle: Overview of Submarine Pipeline Global Buckling
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Theoretical results of global buckling study only can be used for judging critical buckling force of pipeline, which can not be used for post-buckling analysis. Initial imperfection is very important in global buckling of pipeline. In order to study effect of initial imperfection on post-buckling of pipeline, Finite element method is used. In this paper, FEM of pipeline exposed on seabed is built based on ANSYS, introducing method of initial imperfection is presented and amplitude of initial imperfection and length of initial imperfection are all analyzed, which can be used for design guideline.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Influence of Not Synchronization for Hoisting Extra Large Solder Ball Grid Roof
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Analyze the safety of flexible hoisting the overall roof with Sap200014.0 while constructing the COMAC ministry of installed plant. Find the influence of the overall structure stiffness under kinds of hoisting step and the bigger step which the structure can stand. The numerical simulation is carried out and the effect of unequal lifting on structural behaviors is analyzed. Numerical analysis and engineering practicing show that the overall flexible hoisting technique is with sufficient safety and obvious advantage in economy. This method can provide some experiences to the construction and fabrication of the steel member of the project.

articleTitle: Magnification Digital Test Technology Based on Image Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Magnification is an important performance parameter of telescopic optical system, based on the traditional test theory and method, combined with CCD technology, photoelectric automatic focusing technology, precision machinery technology, modern electronic technology, automatic control technology and computer image processing technology, put forward the corresponding digital test method, in order to improve the objectivity, accuracy of measurement. Standard parts was tested on the measurement system, experiments proved that the magnification testing accuracy <;1%.

articleTitle: Analytical Solution to Steady-State Temperature Field of One and Two Freezing Pipes Near Linear Adiabatic Boundary
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Artificial ground freezing method has been widely used in various kinds of municipal engineering projects. But the existing formulas to calculate the temperature field of artificially frozen soil walls are all based on the conditions that frozen soil develops unrestrictedly, while in practical projects, underground structures often exist near freezing pipes, which can affect the development of frozen soil. In this paper, analytical solution of steady state temperature field of one or two freezing pipes near a linear adiabatic boundary is deduced based on mirror image method and potential superposition method. It is reasonable to believe this paper can provide some theoretical guidance to some practical projects.

articleTitle: The Low-Carbon Construction and Operation Technologies of Water System in the Residential District of Mountainous City
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to achieve the low-carbon construction and operation in the water system of mountainous residential district, the key link of greenhouse gas (GHG) emission of water system in mountainous residential district was studied, and GHG emission was analyzed and quantified. According to the key link of GHG emission, trying to transform the traditional mode of long distance transportation of the drainage system and the terminal sewage biological treatment to reduce the GHG emission, therefore, several low-carbon technologies in the mountainous residential district were put forward, including: the low-carbon technology of controlling water supply pressure to limiting flow, the technology of low-carbon and ecological treatment of reclaimed water and carbon sequestration technology, the ecological technology of controlling and reducing the source of rain water in the steep slope residential district, and the technology of recycling use of the non-traditional water source to reduce GHG emission from water system in mountainous residential district. By quantification the reduction of GHG emission, the results shows that, the low-carbon construction and operation technologies of water system in mountainous residential district, achieved more than 30% reduction of GHG emission from water system in mountainous residential district.

articleTitle: The Plasticity Analysis of the Cast-in-Situ Prestressed Concrete Hollow Slab
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The cast-in-situ prestressed concrete hollow slab is a new type of slab. It combines the unbonded prestressed and the cast-in-situ concrete technology and it has the advantage of long-span, light weight and excellent performance of isolated voice. But the research on the performance of the cast-in-situ prestressed concrete is not so more, at present investigation is mainly focused on non-prestressed concrete hollow slab. The plasticity analysis of side supporting and column supporting cast-in-situ concrete hollow slab is introduced respectively. Then the simulation of the two examples are made with ANAYS finite element analysis software, some conclusions are obtained as following: based on yield line theory, the plasticity limit analysis of prestressed concrete hollow slab is reasonable. The plasticity limit load of hollow slab structure is much larger than design value by elastic design method, in the example the plasticity limit load is about four times as the design value. It should reduce the design value of the slab bending moment under meeting the normal using limit state. If the membrane effect is not considered, the reduction factor of bending moment should be 0.8 to 0.9, whereas it should be 0.7 to 0.8.

articleTitle: Design of Profiling on the Stator Curve of Double-Action Pump
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Though analysis motion on stator curve of double-action vane pump to profiling, calculating out profiling curve by analysis, providing a kind of rapid and convenient method to machine the profiling, and this method has good commodity.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Collapse Vibration Caused by Demolition Blasting
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: High-rise buildings dumping to the ground caused by blasting demolition will generate collapse seismic waves, which will influence or even damage to surround or underground construction in the course of its propagation. With the constantly increase of city buildings' height and volume, the increasingly complex blasting environment and the improved people's awareness of environment, the collapse vibration harm has drawn increasing attention. In order to study the propagation and attenuation law of collapse vibration caused by demolish blasting and the dumping effect of different size dumping ditch, taking the demolition blasting of a 32m high chimney as engineering background, the collapse touchdown course of chimney is simulated in this paper using LS-DYNA3D limited element software. Comparing the simulation results with the actual test data, the stress and deformation characteristics of chimney and soil are gained during the dumping touchdown process of the chimney. By analyzing the vibration velocity peak of the collapse seismic waves which through different dimensions dumping ditch, the factors affecting the dumping effect of dumping ditch are obtained. The study showed that: the "length" and "depth" of dumping ditch are the key factors that affect the dumping effect. The study results can provide a reference of preparing dumping measures for blasting demolition works.

articleTitle: Manufacturing Method of the Purple-Clay Teapot Mold Based on Reversing Engineering
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Except the manual shaping, the other methods are needed for a particular mold to make purple-clay teapot. Traditional manufacturing method of purple-clay teapot mold is heavy and low-efficient human work. Reversing engineering has been applied in many industry fields. In this paper, reversing engineering technique is applied into a purple-clay teapot mold manufacturing process. Then, the machining simulation of the mold is finished in CAD. The results show this technique is an advanced and efficient method to make purple-clay teapot mold. This method can also be used in other pottery product mold.

articleTitle: Study on Wastewater Chemical Fingerprint Database for Identifying the Pollution Source of Illegal Discharge
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to improve environment supervision enforcement ability against secretly illegal discharge, the present paper explores the optimization design of Wastewater Chemical Fingerprint Database (WCFD) based on Access. The characteristics of various pollutants are analyzed on the basis of the wastewater data from factories surrounding Tongzhou North Canal and the river water data. WCFD has friendly operation interface and is convenient to store, manage, consult the data and trace back the pollution source of illegal discharge.

articleTitle: Generation and Undercut of Tooth Surfaces of Helical Noncircular Gears
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A general mathematical model for generating tooth surfaces of helical noncircular gears is established. Two basic parameters and a first order differential equation characterize this model. The condition for determining the cusp of tooth surfaces is also presented. Transverse pressure angle and normal length are introduced to deal with the model. The different tooth surfaces could be generated logically and systematically by using this model and defining transverse pressure angle as a function of the two parameters. It is believed that the model may provide a simple logical method for the design of helical noncircular gears.

articleTitle: Ultimate Moment of Unbounded Prestressed Concrete Pier
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The calculation formula for the ultimate flexural capacity of the unbonded prestressed concrete bridge pier has been derived, the relationship between the ultimate bearing capacity and prestressing tendon area, the regular reinforcement area, the strength of concrete and other influence factors has been analyzed. The ultimate flexural capacity of the unbonded prestressed concrete bridge pier is studied based on the plastic-hinge method. Then the influence of different factors on the ultimate flexural capacity is analyzed. The results show that, the increase in the area of regular reinforcement and the strength of concrete can enhance the ultimate flexural capacity. Moreover, the ultimate bending moment increases first and then decreases, with the increasing of the prestressing tendon. Thus, the most effective method to increase the ultimate flexural capacity of prestressed concrete bridge pier is to increase regular reinforcement ratio, and to control the number of prestressing tendon simultaneously.

articleTitle: Application and Research on Foundation Monitoring using ISODATA Based Fuzzy Cluster Analysis Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Fuzzy clustering analysis is an effective mathematical classification method. ISODATA clustering analysis method is more scientific, which can eliminate human error. With the help of ISODATA clustering analysis, we can classify the monitoring points more accurate, scientific with the classification of the slope by the direct factor in affecting the stability of the foundation pit, which improves efficiency, and reduces workload.

articleTitle: The Research Achievements, Issues and Strategies on the Study in Domestic of the Urban Development in Modern Swatow
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In recent years, the research of modern Swatow are very fruitful from a humanities perspective but in the same time lack of physical research on the city and the buildings. On the other hand, although the field work done by the scholars of urban planning and architectural history have built up a good foundation for deeper study, there are still many key issues left unresolved. This article will review the research achievements and the left problems in the study of the urban construction in modern Swatow, put forward suggestions, broad the research field for the future study in a wider historic view.

articleTitle: Sichuan Vocational Transportation Specialty Group Construction of Research on Localization
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Transportation has entered in a critical period of enhancing the quality and level of service, and it also has got into the mode of development of transition. Setting of professional group should work closely with the current and future transport development plan in Sichuan, to pinpoint the position of higher vocational education in the transportation industry and regional economic development. This paper relies on connotation construction, from the view of resources optimization, to enhance school characteristics, and to build up a localization professional group in Sichuan Vocational transportation broad categories.

articleTitle: Determination of Thermal Conductivity of Inorganic Salts at the Liquid/Solid Phase Transition Point
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Based on the relationship between the speed of the moving interface and the thermophysical properties of two phases during melting and solidification processes, a measuring apparatus was designed to determine the thermal conductivity of inorganic salts. Using sodium nitrate as the sample, an experiment was carried out to determine its thermal conductivity at the melting point. However, it was difficult to realize the one-dimensional conduction in phase change chamber, which caused the inaccuracy of the data of thermophysical properties from the analytical solutions. So the combination of experiment test and numerical simulation was applied. Compared the experimental result and corrective result of thermal conductivity of sodium nitrate with the value recommended in reference errors are less than 9%and 2%.

articleTitle: Software Development of Comfort Degree Monitoring System for Intelligent Environments
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With the development of intelligent environments, The human have increasingly demanding for comfortable living environments. The three major factors affecting occupants' comfort are thermal comfort, visual comfort and air quality. This paper presents a comfort degree monitoring platform for intelligent environments based on ZigBee wireless sensor network that measures the environment's parameters and actively controls the corresponding equipments according to the information collected and users' preferences. The software programming of wireless sensor network node adopts TinyOS operating system that can quickly compile the application-specific software by component programming methods. The Mini2440 development board is chosen as the hardware platform of host computer that communicates with the gateway module in master node by USB interface. The software design of host computer adopts SQLite database and Qtopia. The monitoring interfaces of the system include mode selection interface, operation status monitoring interface, data query interface, device control interface and trends Interface. The monitoring platform presented in this paper is flexible, powerful, and scalable, which can be applied to the other monitoring fields with minor modifications.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Tracking Algorithm Embedded Level Set
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to accurately and timely learn the changes of the target appearance, and effectively describe the object, tracking algorithm embedded level set is proposed in this paper, and the theoretic and experimental verification are researched, results show that: compared with the classic integrated tracking, integrated tracking embedded level set has more outstanding in dealing with complex background. The level set function owns its outstanding characteristics in the description of the target contour, and greatly improve the accuracy and robustness of the integrated tracking.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling Technology of Virtual Maintenance Process Based on Petri Net and AOE Network
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper probes into the model based on senior Petri net and AOE network from the practical and feasible point of view, using the computer simulation method to determine the maintenance process, for the optimization of the virtual maintenance process. First of all, the model of virtual maintenance process based on Petri net and AOE network is explained. Secondly, the paper takes the virtual dismantling and assembling of a transmission box as an example, combining the two technologies, designing modeling methods and steps for the parts' dismantling and assembling and analyzing the characteristics of the relevant time with the critical path method. The realization of the process of dismantling and assembling proves the effectiveness and advantage of the modeling method.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling and Simulation Analysis on Speed Control System of Asynchronous Motor Based on Vector Frequency Conversion Technology
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: On the basis of analysis of the principle of frequency control of motor speed, and on motor unified theory, the dynamic mathematical model of three phase asynchronous motor is established under three-phase coordinate transformation, To analyse this dynamic mathematical model, a simulation model is established under Matlab/Simulink and may simulation studies are performed to verily the feasibility of the proposed vector controlled drive. The results not only indicate the validity of the dynamic mathematical model and simulation model, but also show that by adjusting simulation parameters in each model, perfect simulation waveform is got.

articleTitle: Studying on the Recycled Concrete of Performance and Prospect
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With the continuous deepening of environmental awareness, Re-use of building materials attracts great attention to our field. Through the analysis and research of a large number of domestic and foreign literature, this paper mainly focused on the four performance comparison and analysis which are Compression Strength, Frost resistance, Drying shrinkage, Impermeability and chloride ion permeability. From the comparison and analysis we can draw the conclusion of reliability on the economy and performance of recycled concrete. Thus, combining environmental protection and the sustainable development of the constructional industry, this paper puts forward that the technological development of recycled concrete topics still need further study. It also points out the development of recycled concrete application contribute a lot to the fundamental solution to the ecological environment caused by wasting of massive concrete, increasing shortage of natural aggregate. At the same time, it also shows that the prospects of recycled concrete development.

articleTitle: GIS Application in Construction Engineering
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: For its complexity, engineering construction schedule design is limited by various factors. Simulation-based engineering construction schedule takes critical path method network as frame and calls complex cyclic operation network simulation model enclosed in advance for its simulation nodes. Cyclic operation network simulation model takes charge of simulating stochastic duration of activity and efficiency of resources, while critical path method model performs proiect scheduling. This combination avoids the shortcomings of both models. Furthermore, geographic information system (GIS) technique is utilized to visuallze the construction processes which are otherwise difficult to be understood by static results described. Application in practical proiect verifies the feasibility and advantage of the technique.

articleTitle: Components of Soil Respiration and Its Monthly Dynamics in Rubber Plantation Ecosystems
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Our objective was to quantify four components and study effect factors of soil respiration in rubber plantation ecosystems. Providing the basic data support for the establishment of the trade of rubber plantation ecosystem carbon source/sink. We used Li-6400 (IRGA, Li-COR) to quantitate four components of soil respiration in rubber plantation ecosystems at different ages. Soil respiration can be separated as four components: heterotrophic respiration (Rh), respiration of roots (Rr), respiration of litter layer (Rl) and respiration of mineral soil (Rm). The soil respiration rate (Rs) showed significant seasonal variation. The maximum soil respiration rate of the whole year appeared in August, and the minimum in November or December. The components of soil respiration rate order showed as: heterotrophic respiration?respiration of roots?respiration of litter layer?respiration of mineral soil. The soil respiration rate was highly significant correlation (p<0.01, Q10=1.13~2.37) with 0~10 cm soil temperature in dry season, and significant correlation (p<0.05, Q10=1.10~1.77) with 0~10cm soil temperature in wet season. And soil respiration rate was not significant correlation with soil water content of 5 cm (p=0.05). The soil respiration components of four kinds forest ages accounted for the percentage contribution to the flux of annual carbon emissions (Rs) as: Rh: 35.28~52.75%, Rr: 21.73~39.97%, Rl: 17.13~19.63%, Rm: 6.605~10.27%%, respectively. The soil respiration rate carbon flux of 5a, 10a, 19a and 33a respectively were 10.03?10.34?11.96 and 11.09 thm-2a-1. And the annual carbon flux of soil respiration increased with stand ages increasing in rubber plantation ecosystems

Author Keywords: rubber plantations; stand age; soil respiration; components; effect factors

articleTitle: Analysis of Status and Development Trends of Digital Ocean
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Digital Ocean is of great strategic significance for the development of the country, its powerful data acquisition ability and spatial analysis ability to provide support and security to safeguard the national marine rights and interests, the reasonable exploitation of marine resources. Current situation and development trend of the digital ocean is analyzed and forecast. Based on the geographical information system (GIS), global positioning system (GPS), aerospace remote sensing system (RS) research on the key technology and virtual reality technology, the application of digital ocean, focuses on Digital Ocean Technology in coastal development and management, marine fishery, marine environment and disaster field pest monitoring, marine resources development and management etc.

articleTitle: An Integrated Model of Eliminating Early Failures for Flexible Manufacturing System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: To eliminate the early failures and improve the reliability of flexible manufacturing system (FMS), the model of eliminating early failures for FMS is proposed in this paper. Firstly, Weibull two-fold mixture model is chose to establish the bathtub curve model of FMS, and division between early failure phase and normal operation phase is identified. Secondly, the formation of early failures and mechanism of early failures elimination are studied, and an integrated model of eliminating early failures for FMS is established, with some specific process and implementation of reliability design and analysis layer, reliability test layer and early failures elimination layer. Finally, an example of key function unit in FMS is shown to illustrate the applicability and validity of the model.

articleTitle: Aclome: Agile Cloud Environment Management Platform
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With the proliferation of virtualization and cloud related technologies, computing, storage and network resources provided by physical devices are virtualized and integrated into a resource pool. For cloud resources tenants, they can apply these resources for use in a self-service style. The resources applying process is much simpler than ever. However, for the data center administrator, in confronting with the infrastructures cloudified by hypervisors and cloud enabling tools, the data center is becoming much complex and prone to error. In this paper, we propose a hypervisor and cloud neutral agile cloud environment management platform: ACLOME. It aims to simplify and automate the process of dynamic cloud environment management. According to the type of issues related to cloud environment management, there are two kinds of uniform portals provided in ACLOME: Management Center and Business Center. The two kinds of portals aim to solving resources provisioning and management issues of cloud environment management in a more simple and agile way.

articleTitle: Progress in Flood Risk Assessment at Regional Scale
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Global climate changes and human activities have a profound impact on disaster environment and formation mechanism of waterlogging disaster, exacerbating the uncertainty of waterlogging disaster and highlighting complexity and difficulty coping with the water disasters of farmland. A large number of researches on risk assessment and prediction of flood disaster have been carried out at home and abroad, and this study concluded the research progress of this direction in recent years in terms of six aspects including the connotation of disaster risk, comprehensive assessment of flood risk based on index system, the numerical models of flood disaster risk assessment, the regularity analysis of different carriers, the influence of environment changes on flood disaster risk and uncertainty of flood disaster and finally analyzed problems in the research and the future directions of development.

articleTitle: Energy Consumption Monitoring Systemin Discrete Manufacturing Plants
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Discrete manufacturing system related to machine tools, automobiles, ships and aircraft industries, etc., having the features of dispersed energy consumption, large aggregate, and heavy pollution, which makes monitoring system of energy consumption in discrete manufacturing plants is of great significance for low-carbon manufacturing. To analyze the energy consumption of discrete manufacturing processes, the energy consumption description model was built, which divided energy consumption into Direct Energy(DE) and Indirect Energy(IE). Furthermore, the monitoring system was constructed based on the energy description model, which included three sub-systems: information collection sub-system, transmission sub-systemand statistics and analysis sub-system. The three sub-systems can adapt to different requirements of energy consumptionmonitoring. Considering the complexity of layout in workshop, we provide various types ways of information transmission. Energy consumption statistics and subsystem analysis are not only able to support the real-time monitoring of energy consumption information but also provide a guarantee of comparison and analysis about each process and each condition of energy consumption. For other industries, the energy consumption monitoring system also has a certain reference.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Man-Machine Interface for UPFC-FCL
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Unified power flow control with fault current limiting (UPFC-FCL) is a novel FACTS device which can protect the series converter from being destroyed by fault current of the system. In this paper, man-machine interface (MMI) based on NI Measurement Studio with Microsoft Visual Studio is proposed, which can monitor the status and adjust the parameters of UPFC-FCL when it is running. The data is transferred between MMI and controller via USB. The test results indicate that the MMI illustrated in this paper has a friendly interface with rich functions such as status monitor, running control, fault feedback, operation record and data analysis.

articleTitle: The Design of Variable Gain Wideband Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to effectively solve the control problem and to make people remotely transmit multimedia information quickly and accurately. This paper has proposed a design method of adjustable gain wideband amplifier. The method mainly adopts the reasonable cascade connection and impedance matching, and comprehensively improves the gain bandwidth and the output amplitude of voltage, using a variety of measures to reduce noise interference and to restrain the self-excited of high frequency. After the class adopt capacitive coupling, interference is reduced and the system dynamic acceptable range is improved. In the realization of the system noise index does not worsen the situation, can achieve the performance index of the adjustable gain range. Proved by the experiment, the method of this system is reasonable and controllable in practice.

articleTitle: The Goal Matching Algorithm Histogram-Based Color Correction and Space
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The goals match is one of the key issues that need to be resolved based on the multi-camera video surveillance system. The target match existing problems for current algorithms based on color features is proposed based on the histogram of the target color correction and spatial matching method. First color correction to remove the camera and light the influence of the environment on the target color of the sequence of images collected, after extracting the target space in the HSV space histogram and a similarity measure. Experimental results show that the proposed method is robust, light, body posture and perspective to achieve better target match.

articleTitle: Research on a Multilayer Distributed Online Monitoring System of 10kV High Voltage Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of on-line monitoring for 10kV high voltage switchgear, a design of data acquisition, processing and communication based on a multilayer distributed structure is proposed. This system is composed of data acquisition and communication unit, distributed monitoring unit and remote monitoring terminal, with Ethernet communication scheme to enhance transmission rate and interoperability. Advantages of ARM and FPGA in the on-line monitoring field are explained, and on this basis a dual-core embedded main control unit is designed. The Timing control of FPGA to receive multi-channel data and the hardware and software settings in ARM to send data by Ethernet are detailedly introduced. The Ethernet packets sent by ARM are received by the industrial personal computer, which is responsible for the man-machine interface and data storage. Experiment shows that several electrical and mechanical variables can be real-time monitored by this system. The system's stability and accuracy in data processing are also verified in the experiment.

articleTitle: Expressway Emergency Resources Demand Forecasting Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Expressway traffic accidents seriously threaten the personal property security. And emergency resources are the basis and premise of accident rescue. Thus the emergency resource demand prediction of expressway is of great significance. The influence factors of emergency resource demand is analyzed in this paper, and neural network programming is carried out on the highway emergency resource demand. Finally, combining trained of neural network and case analysis, it achieves emergency resource demand projections for the new case of the emergency center. The results show that the BP neural network can form the inherent law of highway emergency resource demand after training, self-learning and self-adaptation, and the results can meet the prediction error precision. So the results of neural network prediction can provide scientific allocation of expressway emergency resource with reasonable reference.

articleTitle: Analysis on Available Capability of Accommodating Wind Power in Shandong Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Status of wind power's development and accommodation is introduced in Shandong power grid. Available capability of accommodating wind power in spring of 2013 is analyzed under the condition of load, power interchange, generation and power grid prediction. Based on wind power prediction, actual wind power accommodation capability is carried out through wind power restriction caused by constraint of power transfer and peak-load regulation. Finally, the corresponding countermeasures are proposed in aspects of technology, management and planning according to the actual condition of Shandong power grid.

Author Keywords: available capability of solutionsareputtedforwardinlinewithactualsituations of accommodating wind power

articleTitle: The Impact of International Greenhouse Gas Emission Constraints on Coal-Fired Power Plant in China-Based on LCAModel
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The Coal-fired power industry accounts for more than 80% of total power generating capacity in China. However, the coal-fired power stations produce approximately 10% of the global total carbon dioxide emissions. This paper uses Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) method to calculate carbon emissions of a typical coal-fired power station in China. The result shows that carbon emission per Kilowatt-Hour (kWh) of the power plant is 1.018 kilogram. Besides, it is assumed that carbon tax will be imposed on power plants in China in the future. Supposing carbon tax rate is 20~200 Yuan/ton, the cost of power plant will increase 0.0204~0.2036 Yuan/kWh. As a result, the international greenhouse gas (GHG) emission constraints will have great negative impact on China's coal-fired power plant.

articleTitle: Design and Research on Active Power Filter in Three Phase Four Wire System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With the development of the electronics, harmonic problem became more serious. The paper presents the novel active power filter (APF) of three phase four wire system base on three phase four legs converter. The electrical parameters of APF is analyzed, and this paper give the design method. The harmonic current detection and pulse width modulation strategy of the APF are presented in this paper. Finally, the APF performance is validated by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Research on Gas-Solid Fluidized Bed Agglomeration Early-Warning Technology
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to monitor the agglomeration in gas-solid fluidized bed, the voiceprint characteristics should be accurately extracted. Acoustic signals created by the polymer impact on the inner bed wall of the fluidized bed reactor were monitored with pasting piezoelectric ceramic sensors on the outside wall of fluidized bed reactor, transmitting the charge with long shielded cables and audio sampling. The original signal collected during the period of the fluidized bed working condition from normal to agglomeration was decomposed into seven sub-signals. When the particle size in the fluidized bed increases, the energy percentage of d6, d7 wavelet scale will rise. The energy percentage of the d6, d7 wavelet scale can be the representative of the particle size change in the fluidized bed, which can be used as the voiceprint characteristics to monitor the fluidized bed agglomeration fault.

articleTitle: Study on the Matching Design of an Extended Range Electric Vehicle Powertrain System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Extended-Range Electric Vehicle (E-REV) is one of the most feasible transitions from fossil-powered cars to pure electric vehicles, since the technologies of battery need further development. A possible solution of E-REV is introduced in this passage, which also provides methods of designing and selection of key components in the powertrain system. The design is based on the performance requirements, including driving motor, battery system and range extender.

articleTitle: Design Electric Closed-Loop of Multidrive NC Servo Control System Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Design of electric closed loop power feedback test is designed based on LabView. A Siemens S120 variable frequency drive module and an electric closed loop power feedback system on one DC bus are used. By using profibus, S7-300 PLC can exchange data with S120, at the same time, speed/torque signals are collected by PLC for PID closed-loop control. And then S120 inverter module is controlled by PLC output to accurate the control of speed/torque. High-speed serial module communicates with LabView system host computer for date exchange. The test system runs successfully, and the control feasibility of the system is verified. Utilization of power is more effectively by using electric closed loop feedback, and it has certain significance to driving control system test.

articleTitle: Research on Cutting Resistance Torque of Soil in Auger Drilling
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Feeding and rotary motion's influence on real cutting thickness and real cutting angle was considered. A parameter m, which is called feeding-rotary speed ratio, was introduced. By employing McKyes-Ali's three-dimensional soil failure pattern and its limited equilibrium mechanics equations, a new formula of cutting resistance torque in auger drilling was deduced. Theoretical and experimental researches show that, the relationship between feeding-rotary speed ratio and cutting resistance torque is nonlinear. The existence of m makes the real cutting angle, real cutting thickness and real failure angle change, which leads to the differences between theoretical cutting resistance torque and the one without considering the influence of m. The differences between two theoretical values, that are related with mechanical parameters of soil, structural parameters of drill and pre-loaded pressure of upper soil, do not show a definite regular pattern as m changes. The distribution of test data shows a higher goodness of fit with theoretical value 1, whose correctness was thus proved. The research has important significance in determining the cutting resistance torque and drilling parameters in rotary drilling of soil.

articleTitle: Study on Virtual Simulation Method of Toxic Gas Diffusion Accidents in CIP
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper introduces a virtual simulation method of gas diffusion in the Chemical Industry Park (CIP), the CIP scene in 3D was established on the basis of the real terrain. To ammonia leakage and diffusion for example, the process of leakage accident was realized in virtual reality by means of embedded the toxic gas diffusion mathematical model to 3D scene. The whole process of the accident can be viewed from a different perspective. The entity model in 3D scene was created by Creator, the construction of the accident scene and render was accomplished by the Vega API. The special effects in the scene were achieved with the help of particle system technology. The research results show that the virtual simulation method can effectively simulate accidents in the 3D scene and it is great significance during the emergency plan drills and accident process analysis.

articleTitle: Tuple Compress Based Outlier Detection on Uncertain Data of Mutually Exclusive Relation
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Outlier detection techniques have widely been applied in medicine, finance, information security and so on. These techniques have been well studied on deterministic data. But, in some important application domains such as sensor networks, moving object tracking and data cleaning, uncertainty is inherent in data due to various factors. Furthermore, those uncertain data may have mutually exclusive relation. How to detect outliers on uncertain data of mutually exclusive relation is a new challenge. In this paper, a new definition of outlier on uncertain data is defined. A tuple compress based outlier detection method is proposed. Experimental results show that the proposed approach can efficiently detect outliers in data set.

articleTitle: ANSYS-Based Simulation of Welding Temperature Field
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper propose an ANSYS system based on finite element method to simulate welding temperature field. The ANSYS system can help avoid large amount of time and resource consumption to accumulate experiences in the traditional method which is based on experiments. The system can efficiently determine parameters to control temperature field, and effectively analyze and identify the impacts of welding heat on products in welding design and welding production, and finally give a proper solution.

articleTitle: Synergy Detection of High Velocity Dim Targets
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper analyzes the characteristics of high velocity, dim targets, and aimed at these characteristics, the detection capability of low frequency(LF) radar(VHF, UHF band)and igh frequency(HF) radar(X band)is discussed. Because LF radar has a better detection capability, but its angular accuracy is poor, however, the HF radar has a high angular accuracy, thus a method of detecting high velocity, dim targets through sensor fusion of these two kinds of radar is proposed. Because RCS of the target is quite low in the HF region, in order to improve the SNR, a way of coherent integration which is suitable for high velocity targets is resented. This paper provides a structure of sensor fusion based on these two kinds of radar, and the specific procedure of synergy detection is discussed.

articleTitle: Analytical Solution of Three-Dimensional Steady State Temperature Field of Single-Piped Freezing
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Artificial ground freezing (AGF) method has been widely used in various kinds of municipal engineering projects. But existing formulas for calculation of the temperature field of artificially frozen soil walls are limited because they are all based on the conditions of the plane. Analytical solution of three-dimensional steady state temperature field of single-piped freezing in an infinite region is deduced based on potential superposition method, where the heat flow along freezing pipe changed parabolically. The heat flow along freezing pipe changed linearly and uniformly is also contained in this analytical solution.

articleTitle: The Research of Network Transitional Technology fromIPv4 to IPv6
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Internet has experienced decades of rapid development, as the cornerstone of the entire network the IPv4 also has become very mature. However, due to its own limitations, it has been gradually exposed many shortcomings, so IPv6 designed by IETF as an alternative to IPv4.This paper put forward three major transition technologies: dual-stack (Dual Stack), tunnel (Tunnel), the address protocol conversion (NAT-PT) and the experimental model of the three technologies, which provide a useful reference for future IPv6 network design.

articleTitle: Grey Correlation Analysis of Tropical Cyclone Landing Time
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The ratio of natural disaster and tropical cyclone economic loss is above 85% in Zhejiang recently. It has a realistic meaning that studying development situation of tropical cyclone in order to analyze factor's relevance and find main factor. According to the grey correlation analysis work principle, studying tropical cyclone landing time distribution is put forwards into application in this paper. This paper choose the sum of tropical cyclone in Zhejiang as study object, calculate correlation coefficient and correlation degree of the tropical cyclone sum and appeared time, determine disaster main period so as to provide a timely solution.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Azo Dye Decolorization in Saline Solutions by a Halotolerant Strain and Effect of Various Salts
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The biodecolorization of the monoazo-sulphonic dye Acid Orange 7 (AO7) under high salinity conditions by means of Halomonas sp. WF was investigated. The results showed that a conventional substrate-inhibited model could be applied to describe the decolorization process with the concentration range from 50 to 1000 mg l-1. On the other hand, in order to study the effect of various salts that are normally present in textile waste streams, a systematic study was carried out using 10 different salt solutions. Most of the ions had no obvious effect on decolorization rate, whereas nitrate had an inhibitory effect. The rates of decolorization were found to fit to first-order kinetics. The impact of sudden salt shock during decolorization process was also examined. The final product, sulphanilic acid (SA) was characterized by LC-MS spectroscopy. The other compound resulting from AO7 breakdown, 1-amino-2-naphthol (1A2N), was not detected most likely because of its low stability.

articleTitle: The Research on Forest Fire Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The happening of forest fire has the characteristics of inevitability and chance. How can we effectively control firing disaster and make use of forest fire it is urgent to implement dynamically monitoring for forest fire. This paper, which analyzing comprehensively fire spreading model and some influenced internal & external factors, is concentrated on how to study fire spreading regularity and Fire simulation base on the knowledge of Maths and computer by means of GIS and RS, The system can monitor fire point in real time and extract forest fire in initial information through meteorological satellite ground received station that has been built.

articleTitle: Methods of Mapping Model Data to Teamcenter
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Methods of mapping the product model made by NX into teamcenter are studied. NX and teamcenter tool are launched by Siemens PLM software. NX has good performance in product data modeling, furthermore teamcenter specializes in product data management. The concepts of multi-CAD integrated environment, data structure, and NX Manager of teamcenter are introduced. NX Manager is the bridge of data exchange between NX and teamcenter. A practice case proves the feasibility of the methods.

articleTitle: Collaborative Design Based on Workflow Reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With the continuous development and promotion of Computer Integrated Manufacturing Systems (CIMS), the connection between collaborative design and workflow technology becomes more and tight, collaborative design, adapting workflow management technology, can reduce the human factors of the business process to improve the efficiency of coordination and control among activities, and to achieve maximizing the efficiency of products' collaborative design process. This paper introduces the theory of collaborative design and workflow technology, analyzes the effect of collaborative design management systems, which use workflow management system to solve the control problems of collaborative design management process. On the basis of analysis of the demand for collaborative design system, a model of collaborative design based on workflow reconfiguration is proposed.

articleTitle: The Rheology Discipline Analysis for Unsteady Flow of High Concentration Slurry in Pipe
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The flow properties of the start, stop, fluctuation and other unsteady flow stage are very important for high concentration slurry transportation. This text will analyse the change rule of the resistance, velocity and flow plug of high concentration slurry, as well as derive three equations for calculating the minimum driving pressure, the Average pressure loss and the stopping time under the viewpoint of dynamics. This model can effectively predict the average pressure loss and the stopping time. This text can also provide a reference for designer about the efficiency reliability of paste conveying system as well as pipe block problem caused by driving force.

articleTitle: Monitoring System of Intelligent Micro-Grid of Renewable Energy in Energydeficient Rural Area -- Take Qira Power System as Example
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Along with the accelerated pace of urbanization, the city scale of Qira Country has been expanding, which makes rapid growth of regional electricity load and existing network can not meet the growing demand of electricity for economic and social development. To meet the problems existed in Qira network, developing renewable energy and building an strong network with intelligent function to ensure overall capacity of electricity supply in future. This research respectively presents the village and township micro-grid considering information collecting, interconnect structure. Operational method under five typical situation of energy supply is managed to meet intelligent control. The micro-grid system may automatically control the system performance to make fully use of renewable energy, which shows very good function in saving labor force and improving the electric quality in rural area.

articleTitle: Improved Adaptive Seam Carving for Image Retargeting
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this work, we propose a novel improved adaptive seam carving technique to image retargeting. Experimental results demonstrate that, when compared with the previous seam carving techniques, the proposed one efficiently prevents distortions in the regions of interest (ROIs) and leads to significantly better result image quality. Two importance factors were introduced into the gradient energy metric with which more flexible control of relative extent of content preservation between different image regions can be achieved. One factor is frequency-tuned saliency map, and the other is Canny edge detector. When computing the gradient magnitude, the Sobel operator was considered. In addition, we search for the least energy seam using bi-directional seam operations. In this way, we delete or insert the seam with the minimum energy in all the possible vertical seams and horizontal seams leaving the least damage to the content of the image.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Algorithm in Assessment of Power System Voltage Stability
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In recent ten years, the problems related to voltage stability arise frequently worldwide.
