The intelligent algorithm, represented by fuzzy logic, neural network and genetic algorithm, has many applications in the analysis of voltage stability problems. This paper will mainly introduce such application.

articleTitle: 3D Object Classification Based on Local Keywords and Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper, we develop a novel method of 3D object classification based on Local Keywords and Hidden Markov Model. Hidden Markov Models are a widely used methodology for sequential data modeling, of growing importance in the last years. In the proposed approach, a geometric feature vector based on Relative-Angle Context Distribution of surface points is extracted. The local keywords are generated from clusters of histogram of Relative-Angle Context Distribution. Then each object is separated by combined model and in each bin we can acquire a local keyword. These local key words are arranged in a sequential fashion to compose a sequence vector which is used to train a HMM. Analysis and experimental results show that the proposed approach performs better than existing ones in database.

articleTitle: Effect of Dispersity of Multi-Walled Carbon Nanotubes on Compression Strength of Cement
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs) and single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) have widely been used to reinforce the cement or to monitor the safety of concrete through its electrical properties. As carbon nanotubes have the property of easy aggregation, its dispersions in cement and concrete play a decisive role in enhancement and conductivity. In this paper, the dispersity of MWCNTs in water and in cement paste, as well as its effect on the compressive strength of composition with MWCNTs and cement are investigated, using ultrasonic dispersion and three kinds of surface active agents Polycarboxylate Superplasticizer (Ad), Poly Vinyl Pyrrolidone (PVP) and washing powder (WP). The dispersity of MWCNTs in water which is shown in numeral photo is analyzed by observation while cement paste is analyzed by scanning electron microscope (SEM). The results show that MWCNTs is easy to agglomerate both in water and in cement paste and exhibits poor reinforce ability if single Ad is used as advisable surface active agent, even though librated by ultrasonic. Assisted by ultrasonic, PVP and WP can promote dispersions of MWCNTs both in water and cement paste obviously. Therefore the PVP increases the compressive strength. The WP decreases the strength evidently because more air bubbles were brought inside the cement paste and the dimension of hole was heightened, the density of hardened cement then lowers remarkably.

articleTitle: A Design of One Kind Spring Layer Lift Intelligent Garage
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A concept of an intelligent stereo garage that lifts the cars between floors is established to increase the utilization and to reduce the manufacture cost of this intelligent stereo garage. The method that a car-picking mechanism shared by several parking floors is used in this garage, which increased the utilization of the garage over 1.2. A four-grade serial mechanism which moves between parking floors and picks up the car is designed. The control system is designed simultaneously to meet up with the requirements of storing and picking up the car automatically. In order to improve the design of the garage, a scaled model of this garage is made and the function of parking cars automatically with high utilization is verified.

articleTitle: Study on Seismic Wave Propagation Characteristic of Deep-Hole Loose Blasting in Coal Mine
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: According to the distribution of faults in coal face, deep-hole loose blasting scheme is formulated and vibration monitoring is conducted. Obtained seismic wave attenuation rule of deep-hole loose blasting, HHT method is adopted for vibration signal decomposition to research the characteristic of spectrum and the energy distribution of the signal. Research results show that seismic wave propagation characteristic of deep-hole loose blasting accords with hard rock spread rule in Safety Regulation for Blasting, the linear component of the ligature between survey point and explosion source is the largest in the three direction components of vibration velocity, which is resulted from the difference of energy loss between different kinds of seismic wave in propagation process, the duration of blasting vibration is about 150 ms, main energy is concentrated in the low-frequency area of less than 100 Hz, and energy can be divided into several "sub-bands" with frequency distribution. According to attenuation law, the biggest single shot charge of deep-hole loose blasting in the site can be calculated inversely, and measures for reducing blasting seismic hazard in construction are proposed, which would provide a reference for the construction.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation and Experimental Analysis of Roadway Surrounding Rock Loose Circle under Blasting Vibration
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: By the finite element method, blasting vibration about deep roadway is simulated in the blast driving process. By regression analysis about the effective stress peak value of the element the results show that the numerical simulation not only reveals the situation of blasting in rock roadway but also shows surrounding loose scope. By detecting instrument of the sonic wave, the change law of loose circle is obtained under dynamic loading of tunnel blasting around the ahead of tunneling in coal mining. Result of the simulation is agreement with the result of the experiment, which provides theory base for the choice of blasting parameter in soft rock driving. That has engineering significance to the blasting driving construction and supporting design.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research of Remote Attestation Based on Trusted Computing
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The trusted computing technology are developing gradually, and was applied in the network. So the trusted network is been proposed and researched, and method of remote attestation is the key technique in the study. According to current situation of study, outline several system of the trusted network nowadays, and analyzed the basic ideas and implementations of several typical remote attestation methods, compared and analyzed their advantages and disadvantages. At the same time pointed out the applicable occasions of several remote attestation methods, putted forward some insufficient for these remote attestation methods, and pointed out the direction for the future of remote attestation.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Dynamic Risk Assessment Model for Tunnel Construction of Thin Layered Rock
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: As a result of the risk and uncertainty of underground engineering itself, a large number of risks had effected the tunnel construction which is complex between mutual relationship, Established risk dynamic assessment system of tunnel construction on thin layered rock, from risk factors as geological conditions, construction methods, technology and management to assess and manage the risks dynamically, that could reduce the risk level from high to low effectively and to reach security, stability construction requirements. Specific case of dynamic risk management and assessment system of thin layered rock in tunnel construction could proof it validity.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model and Empirical Study for Innovation Efficiency of Software Industry
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: As a typical knowledge-intensive business services industry, software enterprises' competitiveness is impacted profoundly by innovation efficiency. According to the characteristic of software industry, considering R&D investment and enterprises' scale as inputs and the number of patents as outputs, the paper builds a evaluation system. And then based on DEA, a model is built to evaluate the innovation efficiency of software industry. After that, empirical research was done on the innovation efficiency of 72 software enterprises between 2004 and 2010. The result shows that the innovation efficiency of service enterprises is higher than that of software enterprises.

articleTitle: Integrated System of ERP and MES Based on DHNN Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: To overcome the information silos problem in application of multiple manufacturing systems, an integrated system of ERP (Enterprise Resources Planning) and MES (Manufacturing Execution System) based on DHNN (Discrete Hopfield Neural Networks) evaluation is presented. First, the information needed to be integrated is given, key technologies of database integration were studied, and the data warehouse of these two heterogeneous systems was established. Then the integrated system was evaluated by DHNN method. The evaluation result shows that this integration system is better than ERP or MES and it can improve the efficiency of production in manufacturing enterprise.

articleTitle: The Design of ERP in the Multi-tier Architecture
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This article introduce the advantages of Multi-tier architecture indicate the Multi-tier architecture will be the tendency of the future software architecture. And indicate the overall functional structure of the multilayer architecture and ERP. Finally, discuss the specific method of ERP.

articleTitle: A Method for Improving Positioning Accuracy of SAR Imagery Based on RFM
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With the rapid development of the sensor technology, it become possible for us to acquire SAR remote sensing image in the same region, In this paper a method for improving positioning accuracy of SAR imagery based on RFM are investigated. At the same time it associated with model construction, parameter solution and refinement of RFM model are extensively studied, and its block adjustment method was established. Through the experiment of a few SAR imagery covering some places of hunan region in China The experimental result shows that the positioning accuracy can be greatly improved in the case of absence of ground control points.

articleTitle: A Novel Algorithm for Multi-Path Test Data Generation
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Automatically generating test data to cover multiple paths is a challenging problem. This paper presents a new niching PSO algorithm, called MNPSO, to deal with this problem. In MNPSO, all particles are dynamically divided into several sub-populations and each sub-population has its global best position. The best positions of each particle are recorded for sub-populations. Test data is generated for one target path in each sub-population and the center of each sub-population is its global best positions. The results of experiments showed that MNPSO improved the efficiency of multi-path test data generation and multi-path coverage.

articleTitle: The High-Precision Control of the Large Hydraulic Straightening Machine
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With outside disturbing effects, large hydraulic straightening machine's total load changes intricately and its precision is less than ideal requirements when being straightened. This paper preposes the fuzzy control strategy, and realizes high-precision control of the straightening machine.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Reynolds Number Simulation of Supercritical Airfoil
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The Reynolds number influences on aerodynamics of a typical supercritical airfoil were analyzed in this paper. The simulation of Reynolds number was achieved through wind tunnel test and numerical method. The maximum experimental Reynolds number reached 10 million per airfoil chord, while the numerical simulation could reach 50 million per airfoil chord which is the same order as flight Reynolds number of a transport airplane. Simulated angles of attack and Mach numbers varied from 0° to 8° and from 0.6 to 0.8 respectively. Results showed that wind tunnel test compared well with numerical method. It is also shown that the upper surface pressure distribution such as shock location and intesity was apparently dependent of Reynolds numbers, while the lower surface pressure distribution was not so sensitive to Reynolds number. It is sugested that Reynolds number is an important factor during the design of aircraft.

articleTitle: The Numerical Simulation and Analysis of Working Face Ground Pressure in Gently Inclined Thin Coal Seam
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Numerical simulation, combined with field observation, has proved effective on measuring the main roof weighting step, while theoretical calculation and empirical formula are found to be inadequate for the working face. Considering the mining situation in Xiaohezui Mine, discrete element method is adopted to numerically simulate the working face mining pressure, and according to it, field observation on the pressure is taken, which guarantee safe production on a theory basis.

articleTitle: Research on High-Pressure Chemical Churning Pile in Loess Tunnel Foundation Reinforcement
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: High-pressure chemical churning pile is used to reinforce soft soil foundation. Pile, pile soil and mattress layer constitute composite foundation which has large strength and small settlement. In the paper, reinforcement mechanism of high-pressure chemical churning pile is analyzed, strength calculation formula of composite foundation that using high-pressure chemical churning pile to reinforce loess tunnel foundation is given, finite element model of settlement calculation is established. The author analysis the influence of pile length, pile diameter and pile spacing on composite foundation maximum settlement, and draws the conclusion that increasing pile diameter and pile length and decreasing pile spacing can reduce the maximum settlement of composite foundation. The paper lists the project using high-pressure chemical churning pile to reinforce loess tunnel foundation. It proves that high-pressure chemical churning pile is an effective method in loess tunnel foundation reinforcement.

articleTitle: Study on the Number and Placement for Moisture Monitoring Sensor in Lettuce with Substrate Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A continuous monitoring tests for substrate moisture content were carried out in different depths of lettuce field under drip irrigation in greenhouse. Based on the observation data of the moisture probes laid at fixed points, the correlationship between substrate water content in different depths were analyzed, a better method for installing water monitoring points in substrate profile under drip irrigation is selected by R type hierarchical clustering method. Comprehensive analysis the substrate physical properties and the activity root zone of lettuce showed that the moisture sensors buried in 5 and 15 cm for monitoring the substrate moisture content in the depths of 0~15 cm were reasonable.

articleTitle: Research on Image Recognition Algorithm for a New Type of Intelligent Ammeter System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to solving the problem of the image skew, partial character and decimal fraction calculation that effect the computation accuracy and speed. This article put forward a new algorithm including meter digital image preprocessing and digital identification. Preprocessing algorithm is based on texture feature to position roughly at first, then using the morphological method to position it accurately, in the end, using Hough transform and Wavelet analysis to correct image and remove the interference and separate the single digital from the complex background. In the Digital identification, it uses the different algorithms to the whole and the partial digital image. The whole digital image uses the Wavelet analysis and another uses the digital recognition algorithm which is based on pixel and scale. To verify the algorithm by the 800 meter image, the veracious rate is 99.6% for single digit recognition, the veracious rate is 98.1% for whole meter image recognition, and the speed is double faster more than using traditional algorithm. The results show that the algorithm has great practical value.

articleTitle: Polysilicon Slice Dislocation Defects Segmentation and Area Statistics Based on Curve Fitting
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The quality of the polysilicon slice affects the efficiency of polysilicon solar cells directly, dislocation defects exist in the polysilicon generally, a large number of dislocation defects have a greater impact on efficiency of solar cells. On the basis of photoluminescence defects detection, this paper proposes a new method that progressive scan image to obtain the grayscale curve of each row, and do curve fitting for each grayscale curve to achieve defect segmentation, by comparing the segmentation results obtained by quadratic curve and Gaussian curve fitting, proves that the quadratic curve fitting can be better for defects segmentation. At last, get the proportion of defective area in total slice area. Experiments show that the method of quadratic curve fitting is efficiency and accuracy for dislocation defects segmentation and counting defects area ratio.

articleTitle: Design of Embedded Video Monitoring System Based on S3C2440
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This system used the C/S structure, the client uses S3C2440 processor as the core, the embedded Linux as the operating system, by setting the cross compiler, transplantation, uboot transplantation, kernel cutting and transplantation, the file system of production such as the establishment of the development environment, video capture process is complete the image acquisition and compression processing, the image transmission procedures for image transmission, realize the embedded video monitoring system for portable video acquisition and transmission requirements. The system has the advantages of small volume, low power consumption, low cost, stability etc.

articleTitle: Aerodynamic Optimization of a Simplified SUV Model
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The aerodynamics characteristics of square Mira model were researched by simulation and wind tunnel test. The velocity distribution, pressure distribution, drag coefficient and the aerodynamic characteristics around model were achieved. With contras the results of simulation and wind tunnel test, it validated the veracity of simulation. Based on results, the back spoiler was added and the fixing angle was changed. The drag coefficient was achieved. The conclusions provide reference for how to reduce drag coefficient of SUV.

articleTitle: Cause Analysis on the Course Change of Tibet Niyang River's Main Stream
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Main stream of river changes frequently, and major trough swings often, which bring great danger and bad effects to the flood prevention and protection work even the regular life and property of local people. We take the Niyang River as an example, do deep research on the reasons why the main course in Bayi town changes frequently and the influencing factors. It reveals main mechanism of action of causes and brings out the related control and solving measures and scheme. The research result can guide the local water conservancy work and provide scientific references and basis for the changes of rivers' courses and the control of the situation of related river in foreign countries.

articleTitle: Phase Transformation in the Process of Ni52.97Mn23.58Ga23.45 Powders Prepared
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The changes of phase transformation temperature and structure of Ni<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">52.97</sub>Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">23.58</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">23.45</sub> in the progress of the alloy powders preparing have been investigation. The Ni<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">52.97</sub>Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">23.58</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">23.45</sub> particles exhibit an intergranular fracture mode in the process of the first hammer crushing. After been balling, the particles turned into flake-shape powders which the mean size was about 20 'm. With the differential scanning calorimetry testing, phase transformation peak of hammer crushing particles turned to sharper after being annealed, but the phase transformation temperature little changed. When the particles were balling to powders, the phase transformation peak disappeared. After being annealing, the powders phase transformation peak appeared although the phase transformation temperature was lower 7-10K than the annealed particles'. The crystal structures of particles and powder also were the mixtures of the martensitic phase and austenitic phase.

articleTitle: Vibration Sensor with Floating Gate Based on Standard CMOS Process
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A vibration sensor with floating gate based on standard CMOS and post-CMOS processes is presented. The vibrating membrane is released with one simple metal sacrificial layer removal step, which is very cost-efficient and fully CMOS compatible, enabling monolithic integration of circuitry. Test results show that the proposed sensor can work properly, and have good frequency linearity with the test shaking system, which exhibits prefect linearity up to 99.94%.

articleTitle: Application of an Economic Cost Target Analysis Model of the Co-Operation Waste Water Treatment Plants of Small towns
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A Co-operation Waste Water Treatment Plants (CWWTPs) model is introduced to solve such problems as dispersed locations, small scale, funds shortage and difficult management in Waste Water Treatment Plants(WWTPs) of small towns. In this model, a main plant can drive other subsidiary plants to cooperate and then, show higher efficiency and less operation costs. To affirm the economic benefit of CooperationWasteWater Treatment Plants of small towns, a cost computing model is foundered to compare economic cost targets as labor cost, purchase cost, construction cost etc. of Co-operation Waste Water Treatment Plants to that in traditional mode. It can be used to judge the probability of forming Co-operation Waste Water Treatment Plants in some small towns. Applying examples are given as well.

articleTitle: The Research on Detecting System of Powder Chamber Volume with Artillery Stowage
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper mainly gives one kind of the detection system of the powder chamber on cubage. It is a multi-sensor sub-system which are composed of the encoder of increment, the piezoelectricity sensor, controlled by the AT89C51 processor, equipped with essential designs in machinery such as motor drive. This system can realize the powder chamber's dynamic and real-time detection. It also can be as one kind of dectection method which be useful to shooting range and other departments.

Author Keywords: powder chamber volume singlechip of AT89C51

articleTitle: Development of the Remote Record and Control of Gas Meter Based on M-Bus Networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Described the working principle and measurement methods of the remote record and control gas meter. Use the technology of M-Bus networks and GPRS wireless data transmission to achieve the function of remote control and transmission of data of the gas meter, given the construction of the interface circuit of gas meter and M-Bus and the networks of remote transmission of data of household meters. Use the modern computer communications technology of GPRS and internet, achieve the communications of the networks of the household meters of data transmission of community with the company of charges, management and operation.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal Dynamics of Phytoplankton-Fish System with Holling Type-II Functional Response and Harvest Effect
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In the paper, the spatiotemporal dynamics of a phytoplankton-fish system with a Holling type-II functional response and harvest effect are investigate mathematically and numerically. Mathematical theoretical works have been pursuing the investigation of the stability of the equilibrium point of the phytoplankton fish system. All these results are expected to be of use in the study of phytoplankton-fish ecosystems.

articleTitle: Research on No Changement Frequency Controllable Hydraulic Impactor Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Based on the equivalent force principle, hydraulic impactor principle and the motion characteristics were studied. According to the principle, a frequency controllable hydraulic impactor without changement was designed. The hydraulic impactor hit number was controlled by changement and impact energy and frequency were controlled by changing the rated pressure of system. The parameters of the impactor were calculated by MATLAB software programming. Finally, software AMESIM was used to build system modeling and simulation to verify the calculation results. As the calculation results matched the simulation results, it could be concluded that the impactor was reasonably designed.

articleTitle: Modified Boussinesq-Type Water Wave Model Based on Fourth-Order Runge-Kutta Method
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: It is very important to adopt reasonable discrete way for Boussinesq-type equation which is often used to simulate offshore wave field. In order to obtain the accurate numerical results, we present the finite different numerical model for the modified Boussinesq equations which are introduced by Beji and Nadaoka. In the numerical model, the difference of first order derivative in space has fourth-order accuracy, that of two order derivative has second-order, and the fourth-order Runge-Kutta method is used for the difference in time. The numerical model is validated by the classical experiment which has been conducted to study the wave propagation on a elliptic type shoal, and the related phenomena in wave propagation has been reproduced, such as light, refraction, diffraction and reflection, etc. The mean square wave height value in the computing domain could be calculated by statistical surface elevation in two period after wave development steady. The numerical wave height agree well with that of the eight sections in the experiment, it is shown that the wave propagation on complex topography could be simulated by this numerical model.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Fracture of Wind Turbine Blades
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Blades are the basic elements of the impeller, the only device of wind turbines for energy. In Chinese wind farms, the most commonly used blades are of three-blade structure. With the popularity of wind power market, the operating environment has been covered by a low-temperature, moisture, high salt spray, sand and other situations, accompanied by the occurrence of blade breakage, which does not only cause the huge economic losses but also directly affects the availability of the unit. So it is necessary to have the correct understanding of the causes of the blades fracture and to process the pretreatment. The following is the analysis of the actual breakage of the running blade.

articleTitle: Test Research on Electrostatic Decay in Fuel Tanks System Filled with Reticulated Polyurethane Foam
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to explore the electrostatic decay characteristics of fuel tanks system filled with reticulated polyurethane foam, the small scale of "circular impingement" test is conducted. Through fitting the electrostatic voltage vs. time with the nonlinear least squares fitting, the parameters of the test formula are solved, and the empirical expression of electrostatic decay of fuel tanks system filled with reticulated polyurethane foam is concluded, which accords with classic exponential decay physical model fairly.

Author Keywords: fuel tanks system filled with reticulated polyurethane foam

articleTitle: Characteristics of Fiberboard Manufactured from Recycle Paper Sludge
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper presents the results on a study to use recycle paper sludge for fiberboards production. 20-40 mesh paper sludge fiberboard and unclassified paper sludge fiberboard were fabricated. Four factors, panel density, adhesive content, pressing temperature and time, were used. The bending strength, internal bonding and thickness swelling were investigated. The results indicated that the mechanical properties of the boards were positive affected by the panel density. The 20-40 mesh paper sludge fiberboards gave superior internal bonding and thickness swelling than the unclassified paper sludge fiberboards. The bending strengths of the unclassified paper sludge fiberboards were much more than those of 20-40 mesh paper sludge fiberboards. The internal bonding and thickness swelling of all type fiberboards satisfied fully the requirements set by GB/T11718-2009 standard.

articleTitle: Preparation and Microwave Absorption Properties of Carbonyl Iron/ La1-xSrxMnO3 (x=0.3, 0.4 and 0.5) Composites
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With different weight ratio of carbonyl iron powder and La<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>Sr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> (x=1.3, 0.4, 0.5) powder have been prepared by physical method. The structure, morphology and microwave absorption properties have been investigated. The results show that the ratio of carbonyl iron powder to La<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>Sr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> has great influence on reflection loss. The optimal absorption property can be obtained when the weight ratio of the carbonyl iron powder to La<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.06</sub>Sr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> is 30:1, which is attributed to the balance of the electric-magnetic match.

articleTitle: Application of Direct Seeding Cultivation within Ridging and Plastic Film Mulching to Cold Soaked Mud Fields in Southwest of Hubei
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Southwest of Hubei, a mountain with high-elevation (1500 m above sea level), distributed lots of cold soaked fields which have a low productivity of rice. In order to raise its productivity, a method of cultivation was tested that is direct seeding cultivation within ridging and plastic film mulching. The results showed that the technique can play a bit to exalt tiller node, increase the effective soil nutrients in cold soaked mud fields, improve economic structure, and develop the technical effect of rice yield. Finally, for its best application in agricultural practice, it gave some suggestion relevant to agricultural machinery use, economic cost and technical standards.

articleTitle: The Research on Algorithm of Multi-sensitive Based on Personal Anonymity
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Paper first analyzes the major technical database of existing privacy and privacy requirements in more sensitive attribute data released under the scenarios studied in the publishing process more sensitive data privacy issues, pointing out that a single individual more than the corresponding records and the corresponding personal data published anonymously in the privacy protection model number of key issues need to be addressed, including information disclosure risk measure, information loss measure and control the dynamic semantic tree, and induction, summed up the release of existing multi-attribute data privacy-sensitive technology characteristics.

articleTitle: Dual-Band of Light Intensity Detection Equipment for Photosynthetic Based on the Solar Elevation Angle
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Illumination is one of primary effecting factors on photosynthesis. Plants absorption spectrum are mainly concentrated on 400~460nm of the blue-purple light and 600~700nm of the red-orange light, while existed light detection equipment can't detect red and blue light intensity by a single sensor at the same time. This paper proposes a photosynthetic required band light detection equipment based on the solar elevation angle, which uses digital visible light sensor and takes single chip microcomputer as core processor. A function relationship of red and blue light intensity and solar elevation angle was established, combined with intensity of visible light, time and latitude. The equipment also supported field data storage by SD card and data transfers through RS232 interface. The experiment results show that equipment can realize red and blue light intensity detection effectively.

articleTitle: Study of Numerical Calculation Method about Plane Problem
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A new FEM is given in which the planar continuum is replaced by the planar frame. Firstly the planar continuum is subdivided into the planar rectangular element with 5 nodes and 15 degrees of freedom, and then the rectangular element is transformed into the cross-frame element, thus replacing the planar continuum by the planar frame. Nodal force in the cross-frame element under loading is calculated. By means of virtual force method, the cross-section deformation of the beam is calculated, and then the new nodal force is calculated by using the deformation in the cross-frame element. By superposing the nodal forces of the same cross-frame element, nodal force in the planar rectangular element is obtained. Numerical analysis is carried out to test the method and result s show that the method is feasible.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Matching of Ship Form and Fishing Net for Trawlers
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The matching relationship between ship form, fishing nets and mean catch per haul of trawlers was investigated. According to the connection of these parameters, Index-weight method is used to formulated an optimization model of ship forms of trawler by taking the ship length, molded breadth and depth, block coefficient and ship speed as optimal variables and net present value, fishing effect coefficient, investment payback period, fuel consumption per ton of fishing, cost per ton fishing as economical evaluation indexes of ship forms. A case study is given which a large middle-water trawler is working on course of South American water, and the results show that the optimal trawler's type is in keeping with the present-day trawlers' types that have good economic benefit.

articleTitle: Mobile Target Tracking Based on WSN and Calibration of Environment Parameter
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: A method of mobile target tracking based on RSSI for wireless sensor networks application is adopted. This method realized target tracking by mobile target emitting radio in wireless sensing field periodically and EKF is used to get better target tracking accuracy. It is low cost of hardware. At the same time, research is done on calibrating of environment parameter and least square is used to extract the environment parameter. Finally, an experiment is conducted to validate the value of this mobile target tracking method.

articleTitle: Monitoring System Design and Implementation Based on the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper introduces the present situation of the development of the electric vehicles and the interface of remote monitoring system of electric vehicles based on the Internet of things, then tells how to code for these functions. This paper mainly solves the problem of the interface. The difficulties are the integration between java and php as well as the second development of discuz. The main work which the paper accomplished are: java program (data receiving end service) should realize multi-duties parallelization processing on the system server, bbs display in addition to website system.

articleTitle: An Affordance-Based Product Shape Design Method
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Product shape is the key information carrier in the communication between consumer and product. To investigate shape characteristics and user's function judgment to the product and meet the requirements for functionality and aesthetic of product shape, an affordance-based product shape design method is proposed. Based on the analysis on the relationship among functionality, component, shape and affordance, a hierarchical model of product shape design property is presented, an affordance-based product shape vaccine abstraction method is proposed, and the adaptive immune genetic algorithm is used to build innovative design. According to this method, a Computer-Aided Intelligent Product Design System (CAIPDS) was implemented as a prototype. By applying it to the design of the cup, the affordance and its corresponding vaccines are constructed, and the shape design could be generated and evaluated rapidly. The result of design is satisfying and the proposed affordance-based product shape design method was verified.

articleTitle: An Elastic-Plastic Constitutive Model of Cement-Stabilized Soil
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper proposed a damage evolving variable corresponding with a meso-damage constitutive model established on the base of macroscopic and meso-scopic testing on cemented soil in the situation of saturated with water. Untrained triaxial compressive tests were carried out on cemented soil to investigate the effects of confining pressure, fly ash and cement ratio on the strength and stiffness of cemented soil. As the cement content increase, the strength and the initial stiffness of the soil increase. The stress-strain curves are highly dependent on the confining pressure. The experiment results indicate that as the confining pressure increases, the strength and the stiffness of the material increase, whereas, the rate of softening decrease with increasing confining pressure. Failure modes of the material vary from brittle to ductile depending upon the level of cementation and the degree of confinement. Not only initial density of water but also initial damage of cemented soil has influence on damage evolving variable. Compared with experimental curves of cemented-soil, it is shown that the damage constitutive model has in good coincidence with the testing results.

articleTitle: The Application of Background Prediction Based on Block RAM in Image Correction
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In the field of digital communication, gray level is used to describe the data of a pixel point in an image. A pixel point should be judged defected or not by the data surrounded and if defected, the gray level of these defects should be compensated by its background through FPGA to correct the defects of an image, this process is named background prediction. The correction of data is based on their storage thus RAMs, which are the abbreviations for Random Access Memories, are used. In this passage two different algorithm of background prediction is listed as examples to introduce the function and importance of block RAM in the storage and calculation of image data.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Pavement Temperature Features of Bridge Deck and Road Pavement
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The objective of this paper was to comparatively analyze the difference of pavement temperature of bride deck and road pavement. The asphalt pavement temperature of road pavement and bride deck were tested in Guozigou area of Xinjiang, China. And the air temperature, wind speed, humidness and sunlight radiation were collected. Further, the distribution features of asphalt pavement of bridge deck and road pavement were comparatively analyzed. At last, the predictive model of pavement temperature field for bridge deck and road pavement was set up. The results show that the pavement temperature and air temperature change synchronously. The pavement temperature of bridge deck is usually 66 <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">~</sub>13°C higher than the air temperature, and keeps close to it in winter. Compared with road pavement temperature, the temperature of bridge deck is characterized by being higher lowest-temperatures in winter, greater in temperature changes and lasting for longer time when it keeps its high temperature in summer. The predictive model of pavement temperature field for bridge deck and road pavement is proposed utilized linear function with five factors, namely air temperature, wind speed, humidness, sunlight radiation and pavement depth. The developed model was proved to be more accurate and closer to the measured temperature compared with LTPP and SHRP model.

articleTitle: Application of Element-Free Galerkin Method for Axis-Symmetric Heat Transfer Problems
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: With the MLS (moving least squares) interpolant for the shape function construction, the element-free Galerkin method can be very useful for those mechanical problems of which the meshing or remeshing is very troublesome. In this paper the element-free Galerkin method is applied on the axisymmetric heat transfer problems. The basic theory is proposed, as well as the numerical procedure. For common axisymmetric problems, the 2D background cells are used for the discretization of the physical zones. When the problems can be simplified as 1D axis - problem, relative deducing is also given. Relevant numerical problems are presented. It can be seen that element-free Galerkin method can provide great convenience and high accuracy for this kind of problems.

articleTitle: Application of the Fractal on a Quasi-Dimensional Turbulent Combustion Model to SI Engines
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In this paper, a quasi-dimensional turbulent combustion model for SI engines was thoroughly studied. The fractal expression of the turbulent flame speed was incorporated into the combustion model. The research reveals that the Gibson scale is more applicable than the Kolmogorov scale. As a phenomenal description of combustion process, the fractal is also an effective tool.

articleTitle: Distillation-Iron and Carbon Micro-Electrolysis-A/O Biochemical Process for Treatment of High Concentration Organic Polyester Wastewater
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Distillation-iron and carbon micro-electrolysis-A/O biochemical process was adopted to treat high concentration organic polyester wastewater. The result of the treatment shows that a large amount of organic compound was separated, CODcr of the outflow was about 10, 000 mg/L in average and the removal rate reached over 90% after treatment by distillation and iron and carbon micro-electrolysis. And after A/O biochemical treatment, the outflow was achromous, clear and translucent and free of peculiar smell, the removal rate of organic compound reached above 90% and CODcr of the outflow was about 19.6 mg/L, which is significantly lower than the national discharge standard of 100mg/L.

articleTitle: Study on Anti-Slide Pile Spacing in Slope Reinforcement Using Anti-Slide Pile with Geocell and Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Anti-slide pile spacing is a very important parameter in slope reinforcement engineering, it affects investment of the reinforcement engineering and slope safety. In order to determine reasonable pile spacing, this paper establishes the calculation model of slope reinforcement using anti-slide pile with geocell. According to the elastic foundation beam theory, the paper analyses the force situation of geocell and its anti-sliding force calculation formula in slope reinforcement, at the same time, according to soil arch effect, anti-slide pile spacing calculation formula of slope reinforcement using anti-slide pile with geocell is established. The paper analyses the effect of geocell height, depth and length on anti-slide pile spacing. It is concluded that geocell length has the largest effect on anti-slide pile spacing, depth is the second and height almost has no effect.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction Model of Land Ecological Security in Jinggangshan Nature Reserve
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In recent years the view of Jinggangshan is enchanting by its unique mountainous landscape and revolutionary cradle, which offers many attractions for tourists at home and abroad. Develop continuously along with the tourism industry, the blind development of land resources in the drive for economic interests has been leading to serious degradation of its land ecosystem mountainous and causing serious crisis of land ecological. So establishing and completing the early warning of regional land ecological security is a fundamental act to keep away the land ecosystem deteriorating. Through analyzing the evolution law of Jinggangshan land ecological security, a systematic index system of the special landforms state of Jinggangshan for the early warning indicators is presented, and then, the corresponding evaluation models are established by using the analytic hierarchy process.

articleTitle: Research on the Effect of Geocell in Slope Reinforcement Using Anti-Slide Pile with Geocell
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Geocell is a new type of geotechnical material, in order to illustrate its effect in slope reinforcement using anti-slide pile with it, the paper firstly establishes the calculation model of slope reinforcement using anti-slide pile with geocell. According to the elastic foundation beam theory, the paper analyses the force situation of geocell and its anti-sliding force calculation formula in slope reinforcement, at the same time, according to soil arch effect, anti-slide pile spacing calculation formula of slope reinforcement using anti-slide pile with geocell is established. Then through the finite element model, the paper compares no reinforcement, only using anti-slide pile with using anti-slide pile and geocell, from the result, we can conclude that the slope stability can be increased if we reinforce slope using anti-slide and geocell, when the slope stability coefficient is unchanged, if adding geocell, the pile spacing can be increased or the pile section can be decreased. So the investment can be saved in slope reinforcement.

articleTitle: Motion and Wave Loads Prediction of Hybrid Monohull Considering Viscous Effect
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Hybrid monohull is a kind of special monohull with a built-up appendage on the bottom of the bow. The appendage can produce a large damping force (moment) which conclude obviously viscous damping to greatly upgrade the ship's longitudinal motion performance. In this paper, the RANS method is used on calculating the hydrodynamic coefficients of different ships with and without the built-up appendage. By comparing with the calculating results using potential theory the viscous effect of the appendage is obvious. The longitudinal motion and wave loads of the two ships are predicted. The calculating results of the two ships are compared with each other to analyze the importance of viscous effect for the hybrid monohull. The calculating results are also compared with the model test results to validate the precision of the predicting method.

articleTitle: An Experimental Platform for Measuring Dynamic Characteristic of Shaft in Hybrid Power System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Dynamic testing system for shaft of hybrid power system can monitor the bending vibration and torsional vibration of power shaft in development of hybrid excavator, which can provide experimental basis to examine the dynamic characteristic of shaft. Furthermore, in the normal work of a excavator, dynamic monitoring system can show the working condition of shaft timely. When vibration performance is abnormal, it can issue warnings to stop work of excavator, so as to reduce harm to shaft and to prevent the incident caused by the fracture of working power shaft. In present paper, a dynamic testing system for hybrid power shaft was developed, and its components was mainly introduced. Moreover, the torsion vibration characteristics of the flexible-jointed hybrid power shaft were tested and analyzed.

articleTitle: Hybrid Power System Shafting Vibration Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Finite element model of diesel engine shafting and motor shafting were established. With finite element calculation, the first 5 order modal frequency and vibration shape of diesel engine shafting and motor shafting were obtained. Based on diesel engine shafting model and motor shafting model, hybrid power system shafting finite element model was established, and the first 10 order modal frequency and vibration shape were obtained. Calculation results show that every modal frequency of hybrid power system shafting is declined compared with ordinary power system. Reason for the decline is motor shafting modal frequency is significantly less than diesel engine shafting. The 1 order vibration shape of hybrid power system shafting is torsion vibration. Hybrid power system shafting vibration experiment table was established and shafting vibration testing were carried out. Torsion vibration experiment results show that f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> and 2f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> are two peak frequency of shafting torsion vibration frequency spectrum, shafting peak frequency is less than shafting 1 order modal frequency 212 Hz and shafting torsion resonance can be avoided. Bending vibration experiment results show that bending vibration energy is focuses in x direction and y direction. Hybrid power system axial vibration can be ignored.

articleTitle: The Application of Multi-paradigm Modeling in Social Computation
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Recently, the research on irregular emergent events management had become the hot field in complex system modeling and simulation. In order to solve the social computation in irregular emergent events, A-C-P (Artificial Society, Computational Experiments, Parallel Execution) is the best solution. We bring the multi-paradigm modeling theory to the modeling and simulation for artificial society. Model transformation is used to cover the multi-field in artificial society, Co-simulation is used to connect the heterogeneous system in computation experiments. We give the Multi-Paradigm Modeling based computation experiment framework. The advantages of the application are summarized in the end.

articleTitle: The Damage Analysis of Usu Bridge under Seismic Load
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to obtain the dynamic response of Usu bridge the compression damage model of concrete materials and the finite element method are used in this paper. The frequency and the main vibration mode of Usu bridge are calculated. The damage distribution and the location of maximum damage of concrete structures under the four kinds of seismic load are obtained. The results show that the maximum damage of bridge deck occurs in close to support position, the maximum compression damage of the main tower occurs in the upper tower root place. Therefore, in the construction and maintenance process note the influence of seismic load of in these positions.

articleTitle: CTE Concept in the Teaching Practice in Communication Theory
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: CTE philosophy and communication principles of teaching practice, to adjust the teaching objectives in the teaching process, combined with the new target set classroom activities, fully demonstrated to the learner-centered teaching methods, to foster students 'ability to learn, to enhance students' independent thinking and innovation capability.

articleTitle: Realization of Environmental Inspection and Early Warning in Computer Information System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Environmental inspection, management and early warning play an important role in environmental protection. Their main purpose is to collect, handle and evaluate contamination from different sources, and the result of which will offer an overall reflection of conditions of current contamination, analyze influential factors and indicate their regular changes and tendency. Being a means to environmental management, the computer information management system can automatically inspect and control environment without people's care, involvement on the basis of offering fast and accurate information. This paper deals with the methods to realize environmental inspection and early warning in the computer information system, and focuses on problems to be solved by this system and the system's formation as well as methods to establish it.

articleTitle: Regression Testing Prioritization Based on Model Checking for Safety-Crucial Embedded Systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The order in which test-cases are executed has an influence on the rate at which faults can be detected. In this paper we demonstrate how test-case prioritization can be performed with the use of model-checkers. For this, different well known prioritization techniques are adapted for modelbased use. New property based prioritization techniques are introduced. In addition it is shown that prioritization can be done at test-case generation time, thus removing the need for test-suite post-processing. Several experiments for safetycrucial embedded systems are used to show the validity of these ideas.

articleTitle: The Smart Distribution Grid Pilot Project in China
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The distribution automation is totally complicated system, and it including primary and secondary equipments in power system. Because of the trouble of the project, it requires the information integration from the related system in enterprise. Develop the construction in pilot area for distribution automation, quest the realization mode in distribution automation from the target of smart grid and prove the related standard are providing solid foundation for monitoring and controlling in distribution network. It is the cornerstone for the construction of distribution automation in smart grid.

articleTitle: A Class of Descent Nonlinear Conjugate Gradient Methods
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This thesis further study descent conjugate gradient methods based on the modified FR method and the modified PRP method give the class of conjugate gradient methods formed by the convex combination of the MFR method and the MPRP method. This class of methods enjoys the same nice properties as those of the MFR method and the MPRP method. Firstly the methods generate sufficient descent directions for the objective function. This property is independent of the line search used. Secondly if exact line search is used, the methods possess quadratic termination property. Thirdly if Armijo type line search is used, then the methods are globally convergent when used to minimize a general nonconvex function. Finally, we do extensive numerical experiments to test the performance of the members in the class with different parameters. And then compare the performance of one of the method in the class with the MFR method and the MPRP method.

articleTitle: Effect of a New Kind of Covering Material on Soil of Chinese Pine Plantation in River Beach
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper study the effect of a new kind of covering material on soil of Chinese pine plantation in river beach. The result indicates Eco-mat can decrease the soil temperature in the top 15 cm layer during the investigative time, and the surface soil temperature change significantly and decrease 10.3-13.8°C than without Eco-mat, the daily temperature difference of different deep soil under the munching always is lower than without Eco-mat, The soil water content of 0-20 cm under munching is over 44.3 % significantly than without Eco-mat. However, soil water content of below 40 cm layer is no great changes with or without Eco-mat, Weed growth can be controlled after paving Eco-mat, the height, biomass, abundant of weed are all less than without Eco-mat. The weed species under the munching decrease 40 % and the weed biomass under the munching decrease 99 %.

articleTitle: Study on Decision Model of Right-Turning Vehicle Accept the Gap of Straight-Going Bicycles Based on Photogrammetry
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Firstly, in this paper, the gap is quantized by the distance and the parameters of mixed traffic flow, e.g. acceleration, velocity, density and space headway, are collected by the photogrammetry. Seconondly based on the dominant factor analysis of right-turning vehicle accepts the gap, the logistic regression model of the right-turning motor vehicle navigating the gap of straight-going bicycles is built. Lastly, the model is tested and proved effective.

articleTitle: Research on the Crawling Mechanism of Giant Hydraulic Press at a Low-Speed Running State
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: This paper studied on the giant die forging machine's nonlinear dynamic characteristics at the low speeds through theoretical analysis and experimental verification. In the discussion of hydraulic cylinder, the author cited the Stribeck nonlinear friction and came up with an idea that oil pressure fluctuation can lead to a crawling phenomenon. stribeck nonlinear friction can generate limit cycle oscillations which could impact hydraulic press's stability at a low-speed state at the same time the oil pressure fluctuation can be fitting by cubic curve whose role is similar to a nonlinear spring. When the pressure fluctuated, it worked as a hard spring or soft spring, and then it would cause a phenomenon that speed would sudden jump up or down. So, giant hydraulic machine's crawling is caused by fluctuated pressure and nonlinear friction.

articleTitle: Network Teaching Platform of College Physical Experiment Course Suiting for Credit System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Under environment of Visual Studio 2010, the network teaching platform of college physical experiment course suiting for credit system is designed and built with ASP.NET language(C# language is used at backstage), which can offer college physical experimental course a brand-new and fully open teaching mode. Via online course selection system, students can choose experimental content, appoint experimental time and select teacher independently. The network teaching platform constructs an open learning environment for students which make the college physical experimental teaching expended both in time and space. With influence and radiation effect of teaching system of the network teaching platform, the college physical experimental course can get shared teaching resources that teachers can reference for teaching, and the students can also get a self-learning environment.

articleTitle: An Orchard Management Systemwith RFID-Based Apple Tree Identify Detection
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: At present orchard production management in our country mainly focuses on the process of circulation traceability and supervision, while little attention is paid to the production process, and all kinds of information collection work is mainly completed by hand, which obviously is not standard, of poor record, time-consuming and has great blindness and randomness. An intelligent system is put forward in this paper to solve the supervision problems in apple production process of Shanxi province. The system took one tree as monitoring unit based on RFID technology, embedded technology, the. net Framework technology, database technology and wireless transmission technology. Electronic archives for each apple tree were set up and the whole record orchard production was realized to standardize the management of production process. With this system, the information transparency of the apple production process can be enhanced and the orchard production management level be improved to enhance the quality and yield and guarantee the safety of fruits.

articleTitle: The Construction of Low-Carbon Economy Evaluation Index Systemin Ta Hsing-an Ling Region
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Low-carbon economy represents an important index for measuring the sustainable development of a region. The primary goal of this study is to quantitatively express the level of development of the regional low-carbon economy. We take Ta Hsing-an Ling for instance and combine with characteristics of forest area to build evaluation index system of low-carbon economy on the basis of regional carbon emissions intensity calculation from 4 aspects of the 16 indexes: energy consumption and economic development, social science and technology, environmental management. Using the gray comprehensive evaluation method for evaluation and the results show that from 2001 to 2010, the low carbon economy development index in Ta Hsing-an Ling is between 0.3376~0.7096 and has an upward trend. The level of the development of low-carbon economy is better than the national average and in a good condition.

articleTitle: Industrial Automation System Integration Assessment of Large-Scale Steel Enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The assessment of industrial automation system integration (IASI) is of great significance both to the administration and to the enterprise. This paper studies the current situation and development trend of IASI of Chinese large-scale steel enterprises. Locally weighted regression (LOESS) is adopted as a data analysis and visualization tool along with other conventional descriptive statistical methods. The results may be instructive for policy making and business strategy.

articleTitle: Barrier Coverage with Mobile Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: In order to save the mobile sensor network energy and improve the barrier coverage with mobile sensor network to adapt to the environment. The virtual force principle is applied in low power RF (Radio Frequency) wake-up mobile sensor nodes and obstacles. Some of sensor nodes are in the state of work, the others are dormant. When the sensor network is damaged, the dormant sensor nodes can be waked up timely and mobile to the damage place to restore the barrier coverage. Analysis by simulation, it can effectively save the network energy consumption, improve the service life of the network and the network capacity to adapt to the environment.

articleTitle: Effects of a Kind of Palm Covering on Photosynthetic Characteristics of Chinese Pine Plantation
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: The photosynthetic parameters of Pinus tabulaeformis plantation were measured after covering forest land by palm mat for two growing seasons. The result indicates the daily maximum photosynthetic rate and the photosynthetic rate in the photosynthesis saturated point increased by 30% and 10.6%~44.3% respectively compared with the CK, the transpiration rate and stomatal conductance increased to some extent, while the light compensation point and the water use efficiency between the treatment and CK were no significant differences.

articleTitle: Research on the Temperature Rise Period of the Household Metered Heating System
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Using the Heat Balance method to study the operational regulation of the central household-based heat metering heating system, puts forward the concepts about the temperature rise heating coefficient and temperature rise heating time, and deduces the relation between them. Using the relation to get the data table of the temperature rise heating coefficient and temperature rise heating time under one indoor and outdoor temperature.

articleTitle: Numerical Calculation of Radial Sliding Bearing Dynamic Characteristics at a High Speed
publicationTitle: 2013 Fourth International Conference on Digital Manufacturing & Automation
abstract: Along with the machine to high speed, large scale, power direction and effects of fluid boundary slip, More and more journal bearings operate in turbulent regime. the conventional finite difference method adopted to derive oil-film dynamic coefficients of aerostatic bearings call the Reynolds equation for four times, Only unit division is fine enough in order to achieve the desired accuracy, the unsteady renolds equation has to be solved generally by the method which are rather time consuming in the nonlinear dynamic analysis of sliding bearing. in the paper, the theory of variational inequality and the method dimension-reduction were used to calculate oil-film forces and the dynamic coefficients of journal under the turbulent regime MeaIlwhile some effective techniques are used to save the computing time. which can well reveal the nonlinear dynamic characteristics of journal bearing of the complex turbulent flow conditions. The numerical results show that compared with the results of the finite difference method's algorithm and CFD software's using base on dynamic mesh model the computing time of this algorithm can be saved more than 99% under the precision guaranteed.
